gm.title: Description
lines: This winged scout watches for elemental incursions. An aarakocra can attack in a dive or throw a javelin from the air.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A feathered humanoid with a bird’s beak, talons and broad wings.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Perception +5, passive Perception 15. Aarakocra and Auran.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Dive Attack. A melee weapon attack deals 3 (1d6) extra damage if the aarakocra hits after flying at least 30 ft. in a straight dive toward the target.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Talon. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Summon Air Elemental. Five aarakocra within 30 ft. of one another can perform an aerial dance. Each spends its action and movement on three successive turns and maintains Concentration during the dance. After the last dancer finishes its third turn, an Air Elemental appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. of the group. It is friendly to the summoners and follows their spoken commands. It stays for 1 hour, until it dies, until all five summoners die, or until any summoner dismisses it as a bonus action. Each summoner must finish a Short Rest before it can perform the dance again. When the air elemental returns to the Elemental Plane of Air, aarakocra within 5 ft. of it may go with it.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Monster Manual (2014), p. 12, with official errata.

lines: Dive Attack. While flying, it must dive at least 30 ft. in a straight line toward the target. A following melee weapon hit adds 3 (1d6) damage.

An Air Elemental then appears in an open space within 60 ft. It obeys them for 1 hour or until it dies, all summoners die, or one dismisses it as a bonus action. Each summoner needs a short rest before dancing again. Aarakocra within 5 ft. of the elemental can follow it back to the Elemental Plane of Air.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A violet-skinned aberration in studded leather, with facial tentacles and a pair of shortswords.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Studded leather armor. Saves Dex +7, Cha +7. Skill Perception +5. Psychic resistance. Condition immunities: blinded, charmed, frightened, grappled, restrained. Darkvision 60 ft., truesight 10 ft. Passive Perception 15. Languages: Common, Deep Speech.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Aberrant Form. A creature other than an Aberration that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the zealot must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or take 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
Weirdly Pliable. The zealot and its equipment can pass through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Psychic Rend attack and two Shortsword attacks.
Psychic Rend. Melee or ranged spell attack +7, reach 15 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit 14 (3d6 + 4) psychic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or become Stunned until the start of the zealot's next turn.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6). The zealot emits magical psychic energy in a 60-ft. cone. Each creature in the cone must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence save or take 22 (4d8 + 4) psychic damage and become Stunned for 1 minute. A stunned target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Psionics. Charisma, save DC 15. These spells require no components.
At will · Detect Thoughts, Minor Illusion.
1/day each · Arcane Gate, Hunger of Hadar.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Void Warp (Recharge 5–6). The zealot and its equipment teleport to an unoccupied space it can see within 120 ft. Each other creature within 30 ft. of the space it left makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure it takes 18 (4d8) force damage and is pulled to the unoccupied space closest to the void. On a success it takes half damage. The void then vanishes.

gm.title: Encounter

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Insatiable Greed. The overlord detects gold within 1,000 ft. It knows the direction of the largest concentration and the direction in which any detected gold is moving. Any layer of clay or lead blocks detection along that path.
Magic Resistance. The creature has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Immortal Nature. The creature needs no food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Innate Spellcasting
lines:
Charisma sets the spell save DC at 15. These spells require no material components.
1/day each. Confusion, Crown of Madness, Suggestion.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Claws attacks.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, the overlord regains HP equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.
Storm of Crows (Recharge 6). Center a 20-ft.-radius sphere of spectral crows and harpies on a visible point within 120 ft. It is lightly obscured and difficult terrain. It lasts 1 minute or until the overlord loses concentration as if concentrating on a spell. A creature that first moves into the sphere on a turn or starts its turn there makes a DC 15 Constitution save. It takes 16 (3d10) slashing plus 16 (3d10) psychic damage on a failure, or half of each on a success.

gm.title: Description
lines: A defensive mage who can ward an ally against damage and drive enemies back with a blast of force.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Arcane Burst attacks.
Arcane Burst. Melee or ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (3d10 + 4) force damage.
Force Blast. Each creature in a 20-ft. cube originating from the abjurer makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 36 (8d8) force damage and is pushed up to 10 ft. away from the abjurer. On a success, it takes half damage and stays in place.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Intelligence (spell save DC 16).
At will. Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Message, Prestidigitation.
2/day each. Dispel Magic, Lightning Bolt, Mage Armor.
1/day each. Arcane Lock, Banishment, Globe of Invulnerability, Invisibility, Wall of Force.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Arcane Ward (Recharge 4–6). When the abjurer takes damage or sees a creature within 30 ft. take damage, it can create a barrier around the creature taking damage. The barrier reduces that damage by 26 (4d10 + 4), to a minimum of 0, then vanishes.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Amphibious. The aboleth can breathe air and water. Mucous Cloud. While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by transformative mucus. A creature that touches the aboleth or that hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is diseased for 1d4 hours. The diseased creature can breathe only underwater. Probing Telepathy. If a creature communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature’s greatest desires if the aboleth can see the creature.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. The aboleth makes three tentacle attacks. Tentacle. Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become diseased. The disease has no effect for 1 minute and can be removed by any magic that cures disease. After 1 minute, the diseased creature’s skin becomes translucent and slimy, the creature can’t regain hit points unless it is underwater, and the disease can be removed only by heal or another disease-curing spell of 6th level or higher. When the creature is outside a body of water, it takes 6 (1d12) acid damage every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to the skin before 10 minutes have passed. Tail. Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. Enslave (3/Day). The aboleth targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the aboleth until the aboleth dies or until it is on a different plane of existence from the target. The charmed target is under the aboleth’s control and can’t take reactions, and the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance. Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can also repeat the saving throw when it is at least 1 mile away from the aboleth.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines: The aboleth can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn. The aboleth regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn. Detect. The aboleth makes a Wisdom (Perception) check. Tail Swipe. The aboleth makes one tail attack. Psychic Drain (Costs 2 Actions). One creature charmed by the aboleth takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, and the aboleth regains hit points equal to the damage the creature takes.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Skills History +12, Perception +10 Senses Darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 20 Languages Deep Speech; telepathy 120 ft.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Amphibious. The aboleth can breathe air and water. Eldritch Restoration. If destroyed, the aboleth gains a new body in 5d10 days, reviving with all its Hit Points in the Far Realm or another location chosen by the GM. Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair). If the aboleth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. Mucus Cloud. While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by mucus. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the aboleth at the end of the aboleth’s turn. Failure: The target is cursed. Until the curse ends, the target’s skin becomes slimy, the target can breathe air and water, and it can’t regain Hit Points unless it is underwater. While the cursed creature is outside a body of water, the creature takes 6 (1d12) Acid damage at the end of every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to its skin before those minutes have passed. Probing Telepathy. If a creature the aboleth can see communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature’s greatest desires.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. The aboleth makes two Tentacle attacks and uses either Consume Memories or Dominate Mind if available. Tentacle. Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of four tentacles. Consume Memories. Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature within 30 feet that is Charmed or Grappled by the aboleth. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The aboleth gains the target’s memories if the target is a Humanoid and is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this action. Dominate Mind (2/Day). Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the aboleth can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the aboleth dies or is on a different plane of existence from the target. While Charmed, the target acts as an ally to the aboleth and is under its control while within 60 feet of it. In addition, the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance. The target repeats the save whenever it takes damage as well as after every 24 hours it spends at least 1 mile away from the aboleth, ending the effect on itself on a success.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines: Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature’s turn, the aboleth can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The aboleth regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns. Lash. The aboleth makes one Tentacle attack. Psychic Drain. If the aboleth has at least one creature Charmed or Grappled, it uses Consume Memories and regains 5 (1d10) Hit Points.

gm.title: Description
lines: Aboleths live in deep waters and remember their kind’s ancient rule. They use telepathy to learn what intruders want and bargain for obedience.

gm.title: DM tactics
lines:
Opening move. If the party approaches the water together, use Enslave on a visible creature within 30 feet. If they close to melee, use Multiattack.
Between turns. A charmed target gives the aboleth a choice between healing with Psychic Drain and spending one legendary action on Tail Swipe.
Player options. The shoreline matters. A character with reach can strike from 10 feet away to avoid Mucous Cloud. Damage gives an enslaved ally another save.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. The aboleth breathes in air and water.
Mucous Cloud. While the aboleth is underwater, a creature that touches it or hits it in melee from 5 ft. or closer makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, it can only breathe underwater for 1d4 hours due to disease.
Probing Telepathy. If a creature telepathically communicates with the aboleth and the aboleth can see it, the aboleth learns its greatest desires.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Tentacle attacks.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning. A creature must also make a DC 14 Constitution save or contract a disease. For the first minute it has no effect and any magic that cures disease can remove it. After that minute the skin turns slimy and translucent, the creature can regain HP only while underwater, and only heal or another disease-curing spell of 6th level or higher removes it. Outside a body of water it takes 6 (1d12) acid damage every 10 minutes unless its skin is moistened before that interval elapses.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning.
Enslave (3/day). One creature the aboleth can see within 30 ft. makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure it is magically Charmed and controlled, loses reactions, and can communicate telepathically with the aboleth at any distance. The charm ends if the aboleth dies or they are on different planes. The target can repeat the save when damaged and, at most once in 24 hours, whenever at least 1 mile away. A success ends the charm.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Three actions per round, regained at the start of the aboleth’s turn. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn. The aboleth cannot use these while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before its first turn if surprised.
Detect (1 action). Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Tail Swipe (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Psychic Drain (2 actions). One creature Charmed by the aboleth takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage. The aboleth regains HP equal to the damage dealt.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
Act on initiative count 20, losing ties. The aboleth cannot use a lair action when incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before its first turn if surprised.
Phantasmal Force. Cast phantasmal force without components on any number of visible creatures within 60 ft. The aboleth takes no other lair actions while maintaining Concentration on it. Any creature whose save succeeds or whose effect ends is immune to this lair action for 24 hours unless it chooses to be affected.
Grasping Tide. A pool within 90 ft. surges. Each creature on the ground within 20 ft. of such a pool makes a DC 14 Strength save. Failure pulls it up to 20 ft. into the water and knocks it Prone. Wait until a different lair action has been used before choosing this again.
Psychic Water. Choose any number of visible creatures in the lair’s water within 90 ft. Each makes a DC 14 Wisdom save or takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage. Wait until a different lair action has been used before choosing this again.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Underground surfaces within 1 mile of the lair are slick difficult terrain. Enemies who drink water from a source within 1 mile vomit it back up within minutes. Both effects fade over 3d10 days after the aboleth dies.
Projected Image. As an action, create an intangible likeness within 1 mile of the lair, either at a spot the aboleth has seen or at one a creature it has Charmed can currently see. The likeness looks, sounds, and moves like the aboleth for as long as it maintains Concentration. It can perceive, speak, and use telepathy from the likeness’s position. Any damage to the likeness ends it.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The lair action does not specify a save DC for phantasmal force. Use DC 14 for its Intelligence save and Investigation check as a table ruling, matching the other lair actions.

gm.title: Actions

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

gm.title: Description
lines: The archlich built the Tomb of the Nine Gods under Omu. He traps adventurers to feed on their souls and built the Soulmonger to sustain the Atropal.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Special Equipment. Acererak carries the Staff of the Forgotten One, wears the Talisman of the Sphere, and controls a Sphere of Annihilation. The staff has 7 charges and regains 1d4 + 3 spent charges at dawn. Undead of CR 2 or lower leave its bearer alone unless the bearer harms them.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Rejuvenation. At 0 HP, Acererak crumbles and leaves his equipment behind. After 1d10 days he re-forms at full HP within 5 feet of his hidden phylactery.
Turn Resistance. He has advantage on saves against effects that turn undead.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Paralyzing Touch. Melee spell attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 10 (3d6) cold damage. The target must pass a DC 20 Constitution save or be paralyzed for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect for itself on a success.
Staff (+3 Quarterstaff). Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage one-handed or 8 (1d8 + 4) with two hands. Both grips deal another 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.
Invoke Curse. Spend 1 charge from the held Staff of the Forgotten One and choose a visible creature within 60 ft. On a failed DC 23 Constitution save, the creature is cursed. It cannot regain HP and has vulnerability to necrotic damage. Greater Restoration, Remove Curse, or similar magic ends the curse.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Acererak prepares wizard spells as a 20th-level caster, using Intelligence (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips at will. Mage Hand, Ray of Frost, Shocking Grasp.
1st level at will. Ray of Sickness, Shield.
2nd level at will. Arcane Lock, Knock.
3rd level at will. Animate Dead, Counterspell.
4th level, 3 slots. Blight, Ice Storm, Phantasmal Killer.
5th level, 3 slots. Cloudkill, Hold Monster, Wall of Force.
6th level, 3 slots. Chain Lightning, Circle of Death, Disintegrate.
7th level, 3 slots. Finger of Death, Plane Shift, Teleport.
8th level, 2 slots. Maze, Mind Blank.
9th level, 2 slots. Power Word Kill, Time Stop.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Acererak has 3 legendary actions. He can choose one option at the end of another creature’s turn and regains expended uses at the start of his turn.
At-Will Spell (1 action). Cast one of the spells listed as at will.
Melee Attack (1 action). Use Paralyzing Touch or make a staff attack.
Frightening Gaze (2 actions). Choose one creature Acererak can see within 10 ft. A failed DC 20 Wisdom save against this magic makes it frightened for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. Once the creature succeeds or the fear ends, this gaze cannot affect it for 24 hours.
Talisman of the Sphere (2 actions). Move Acererak’s Sphere of Annihilation up to 90 ft.
Disrupt Life (3 actions). Each creature within 20 ft. makes a DC 20 Constitution save against this magic, taking 42 (12d6) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.

lines:

Wrath of the Trickster Gods. While a character hosting a trickster god can see Acererak, they gain 50 temporary HP at the start of each of their turns and deal an extra 3d6 psychic damage whenever they hit him with an attack roll.

When it moves or acts, choose which copy does so. An attack or effect that reaches both copies affects the dragon only once.

On death, nearby aquatic populations return to normal over 1d10 days. Existing amethysts remain and new crystals form at their ordinary rate.

Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:

Bite. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:

gm.title: Phylactery
lines: When the body is destroyed, the spirit returns to its gem if the gem and body are on the same plane. If the gem then touches another dragon's corpse, the spirit can animate that body and return as a dracolich. If the gem is on another plane when the body is destroyed, the spirit passes into the afterlife.

On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) Poison damage and a −2 AC penalty until the end of its next turn. The dragon can use this option again starting on its next turn.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · 40 ft., burrow 20 ft., fly 80 ft.

gm.title: Description
lines: This moon dragon tunnels through rock and hoards trophies taken from trespassing crews. When it phases, half its body looks like a dark silhouette.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (2/day). The dragon can turn a failed save into a success.
Tunneler. The dragon can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a tunnel 15 ft. in diameter.
Unusual Nature. The dragon needs no air.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 60-ft. cone make a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure, a creature takes 36 (8d8) cold damage and its speed becomes 0 through the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and its speed stays the same.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Phase (3/day). The dragon turns partly incorporeal while it maintains Concentration as if on a spell. It gains resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage for the duration. This form does not let it pass through creatures or solid objects.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The dragon has 2 legendary actions and refreshes them at the start of its turn. Use at most one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Treacherous Ice (1 action). Pick a point the dragon sees up to 120 ft. away. Ice coats the ground in a 20-ft. radius centered there. It is difficult terrain for creatures other than lunar dragons and lasts 10 minutes or until this option is used again.

gm.title: Lair
lines: The dragon burrows a cave system inside a barren moon. Hidden chambers hold its hoard, often with spelljamming helms taken from trespassing ships. The caves may shelter springs, vents, wild plants, or life adapted to the moon.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more effects near the lair.
Black Frost. This frost coats the ground and kills ordinary plants within 3 miles of the lair.
Haunting Moan. The dragon chooses whether the moan grows louder or fainter as visitors approach. It is audible within 3 miles.
Moon Devils. Funnels of dust and frost intercept creatures within 1 mile of the lair. Each moon devil uses the Air Elemental stat block, acts independently, and deals cold damage in place of bludgeoning.
The moan and moon devils vanish when the dragon dies. The frost fades over 1d10 days and plants can recover.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Boo’s Astral Menagerie, p. 34, with the official Tail attack bonus correction. The lair and regional rules appear on pp. 33–34.

gm.title: Description
lines: This dragon walks the border between waking and dreaming. Around its lair, sleepers may speak with it, and travelers may find paths between planes.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) radiant damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 18 Strength save or fall prone.
Breath Weapon (shared Recharge 5–6). Choose Dream Breath or Moonlight Breath.
Dream Breath. Each creature in a 90-ft. cone must pass a DC 18 Constitution save or fall unconscious for 10 minutes. Damage or an action spent waking the creature ends the effect early.
Moonlight Breath. Each creature in a 90-ft. line 10 ft. wide makes a DC 18 Dexterity save, taking 49 (9d10) radiant damage on a failure or half on a success.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one of these spells using Charisma (spell save DC 19). No material components are required.
At will. Faerie Fire.
1/day each. Calm Emotions, Invisibility, Revivify.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The dragon has 3 legendary actions. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn, then subtract its cost. The dragon regains spent legendary actions at the start of its own turn.
Tail (1 action). Make one Tail attack.
Cast a Spell (2 actions). Use Spellcasting.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, losing initiative ties, choose one option. The dragon cannot use the same lair action two rounds in a row.
Banish into Dream. One visible creature within 120 ft. must pass a DC 15 Charisma save or be sent to a harmless demiplane, stunned there until initiative count 20 next round. It returns to its former space or the closest unoccupied space.
Compulsive Dance. One visible creature in the lair hears a tune and must pass a DC 15 Intelligence save or dance until initiative count 20 next round. It is incapacitated and must spend all movement dancing.
Disorienting Visions. Every creature in the lair must pass a DC 20 Wisdom save or have disadvantage on ability checks until initiative count 20 next round.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
One or more of these effects can occur near the lair.
Dream Communication. The dragon can speak telepathically in the dreams of any language-understanding creature that sleeps, trances, or enters reverie within 6 miles. The creature remembers the conversation on waking.
Planar Transition. Portals within 6 miles link the Material Plane, the Feywild, and the Border Ethereal. Passing through in either direction takes 5 ft. of movement.
On death, nearby portals close at once.

gm.title: Lair difficulty
lines: In its lair, the dragon is CR 16 (15,000 XP).

gm.title: Optional dragon customization
lines: Fizban’s p. 34 permits optional languages, skill or tool proficiencies, and tailored traits. Use the stat block’s listed traits and actions as the default.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons, p. 212 (lair, regional effects and adult stat block).

gm.title: Description
lines: A memory-eating ooze that can mimic its victims through slime-tethered doubles.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Blindsight 60 ft. The oblex is blind beyond this range.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amorphous. The oblex moves through openings as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Aversion to Fire. Fire damage gives the oblex disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.
Unusual Nature. The oblex needs no sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Pseudopod attacks and use Eat Memories.
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
Eat Memories. Choose one visible creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. Constructs, Oozes, Plants, and Undead succeed automatically. On a failure, the target takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage and is memory drained. A short or long rest, Greater Restoration, or Heal ends the drain. While drained, the target rolls a d4 and subtracts the result from its ability checks and attack rolls. Each further drain increases the die by one size through d6, d8, d10, d12, then d20. When the die reaches d20, the target falls unconscious for 1 hour. The effect then ends. The oblex learns the drained creature's languages and gains all its skill proficiencies.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Spellcasting (Psionics). As an action, cast one of the following spells using Intelligence (spell save DC 15). No components are required.
3/day each. Charm Person at 5th level, Detect Thoughts, Hypnotic Pattern.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Sulfurous Impersonation. The oblex produces a double of a Medium or smaller creature whose memories it stole. It looks, feels, and sounds like that creature but smells faintly of sulfur. The oblex can impersonate 1d4 + 1 distinct creatures. A slime tether up to 120 ft. long links each double to the oblex. The oblex occupies its own space and the doubles' spaces at the same time. The tether is immune to damage. If no opening at least 1 inch wide connects the double to the body, the tether severs and the double disappears.

gm.title: Description
lines: An adult red dragon restored to its own skeleton by the spirit bound to its phylactery gem.

gm.title: Template
lines: Apply the printed dracolich template to the Adult Red Dragon. Change its type to undead and add the listed resistances, immunities and Magic Resistance. The book gives no separate red dracolich stat block or CR or XP adjustment. This profile carries over the base dragon's CR 17 and 18,000 XP.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed and Poisoned.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. Roll saving throws against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. The dracolich may first use Frightful Presence. It then makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.
Frightful Presence. Choose any creatures within 120 ft. that are aware of the dracolich. Each makes a DC 19 Wisdom save or is Frightened for 1 minute. A target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that saves or whose fear ends is immune to this dracolich's Frightful Presence for 24 hours.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 60-ft. cone make a DC 21 Dexterity save. Failure deals 63 (18d6) fire damage. Success halves it.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The dracolich has 3 legendary actions and spends them one option at a time at the end of another creature's turn. It regains them at the start of its turn. It can't use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before its first turn if surprised.
Detect (1 action). Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 22 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. The dracolich can then fly up to half its flying speed.

gm.title: Phylactery
lines: When the body is destroyed, the spirit returns to its gem if the gem and body are on the same plane. If the gem then touches another dragon's corpse, the spirit can animate that body and return as a dracolich. If the gem is on another plane when the body is destroyed, the spirit passes into the afterlife.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
If the DM retains the adult red dragon's lair actions, use these options. The template also allows the DM to remove them or substitute new ones.
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one option that was not used the previous round. The creature can't use a lair action while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before its first turn if surprised.
Magma Geyser. Choose a ground point the dracolich can see within 120 ft. Magma erupts in a 5-ft.-radius, 20-ft.-high column. Each creature in it makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) fire damage. Success halves it.
Tremor. Each other creature on the ground within 60 ft. of the dracolich makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or falls Prone.
Volcanic Gas. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. A 20-ft.-radius sphere of gas spreads around corners and is lightly obscured. It lasts until initiative count 20 of the next round. Each creature starting its turn inside makes a DC 13 Constitution save or is Poisoned until the end of its turn. A creature poisoned this way is also Incapacitated.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines: If using the original lair's regional effects, small earthquakes are common within 6 miles of the lair. Water sources within 1 mile are unnaturally warm and sulfurous. Rocky fissures within 1 mile form portals to the Elemental Plane of Fire and admit creatures from that plane. These effects fade over 1d10 days after the dracolich is destroyed.

gm.title: Variant spellcasting
lines: Under the optional dragon spellcasting rule, choose five spells of 5th level or lower. The dracolich can cast each once per day without material components. Its Charisma spell save DC is 19 and its spell attack bonus is +11. The book leaves the spell choices to the DM.

Smoldering Haze. Airborne ash leaves the region within 1 mile Lightly Obscured. A creature other than the dragon or an ally that finishes a Long Rest in the area makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Poisoned for 1 hour.

lines: Speed · 40 ft., burrow 30 ft., climb 40 ft., fly 80 ft.

gm.title: Description
lines: This subterranean gem dragon can dig its own approach through solid rock and use sound to break an intruder’s advance.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Spider Climb. Traverse difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
Tunneler. Burrow through solid rock at half burrow speed, optionally leaving a 10-ft.-diameter tunnel.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) thunder damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d8 + 6) slashing damage.
Debilitating Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 19 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 44 (8d10) thunder damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a success it only takes half damage.

gm.title: Spellcasting (Psionics)
lines:
As an action, cast one of these spells using Intelligence (spell save DC 17). No components are required.
1/day each. Dissonant Whispers, Hold Monster, Meld into Stone, Telekinesis.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines:
Change Shape. Become a Small or Medium creature by magic. Only size changes among the dragon’s statistics. The form ends at 0 HP or when the dragon spends another bonus action to end it.
Psychic Step. Teleport to a visible, unoccupied space within 60 ft.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The dragon has 3 legendary actions. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn, then subtract its cost. The dragon regains spent legendary actions at the start of its own turn.
Claw (1 action). Make one Claw attack.
Psionics (2 actions). Use Psychic Step or Spellcasting.
Telekinetic Fling (3 actions). Choose a visible Small or smaller object within 60 ft. that nobody is wearing or carrying. Fling it at a creature visible to the dragon and within 60 ft. of the object. The target must pass a DC 17 Dexterity save or take 31 (9d6) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, losing initiative ties, choose one option. The dragon cannot use the same lair action two rounds in a row.
Awesome Thunder. Choose a visible creature in the lair. It must pass a DC 15 Constitution save or take 13 (3d8) thunder damage and be stunned until the end of its next turn. The blast is audible up to 300 ft. away.
Beguiling Whisper. Whisper to one creature within telepathy range. On a failed DC 15 Wisdom save, it is charmed until initiative count 20 next round and follows the dragon’s commands as well as it can, except commands that directly harm it.
Stone Passage. Touch stone up to 30 ft. in any dimension and reshape it to open or close a passage through a wall less than 10 ft. thick.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
One or more of these effects can occur near the lair.
Crystal Profusion. Natural stone within 6 miles grows crystals and sapphire veins, particularly underground.
Stony Sight. As an action the dragon can cast Clairvoyance without components on any natural stone formation within 6 miles.
Telepathic Enhancement. A creature’s innate or magical telepathy range doubles while within 1 mile, including telepathy from Rary’s Telepathic Bond.
Thriving Wildlife. Giant Spiders gather within 6 miles.
On death, telepathy returns to normal at once and giant spider populations return to normal over 1d10 days. Existing crystals and sapphires remain and new ones form at their ordinary rate.

lines: In its lair, the dragon is CR 16 (15,000 XP).

Detect (1 action). Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:

Fog. Create fog using the Fog Cloud spell's rules. It lasts until the next round's initiative count 20.
Freezing Wind. Each creature within 120 ft. of the dragon makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 5 (1d10) cold damage. The wind disperses gases and vapors and snuffs exposed flames. Each protected flame, such as a lantern, has a 50 percent chance of going out.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:

Weather. Once per day the dragon can use the effects of Control Weather within 6 miles of its lair, even indoors.
Buoyant Winds. Within 1 mile of the lair, non-evil creatures that fall through no act of the dragon or its allies descend 60 ft. per round and take no falling damage.
Solid Fog. After days or longer of work, the dragon can make clouds and fog in the lair as solid as stone to form objects or structures.
When the dragon dies, weather changes revert as described in Control Weather. The other effects fade in 1d10 days.

gm.title: Variant spellcasting
lines: Under the optional dragon spellcasting rule, choose 5 spells of 5th level or lower. The dragon uses Charisma to cast each once per day without material components. Its spell save DC is 18 and its spell attack bonus is +10. The DM chooses the spells.

Legendary Resistance (2/day). The dragon can turn a failed save into a success.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:

Claw (1 action). Make one Claw attack.
Psionics (2 actions). Use Psychic Step or Spellcasting.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:

Cancellation. End one active spell of 5th level or lower the dragon knows is active in the lair.
Negative Energy Infusion. Up to two visible creatures in the lair each make a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 14 (4d6) necrotic damage on a failure. Until initiative count 20 next round, no creature in the lair except the dragon can regain HP.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:

Negative Energy. A creature finishing a long rest within 6 miles must pass a DC 15 Constitution save to reduce exhaustion or regain spent Hit Dice. Creatures resistant or immune to necrotic damage ignore this effect.
Thriving Wildlife. Giant squid gather and hunt in the sea within 6 miles.
Watery Sight. As an action the dragon can cast Clairvoyance without components on any body of water within 6 miles.
On death, the squid population returns to normal over 1d10 days. Existing crystals and topazes remain and new ones form at their ordinary rate.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The dragon has three legendary actions. Spend them on one option at a time at the end of another creature's turn. Spent actions return at the start of the dragon's turn. The dragon can choose to pass. It cannot use these actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must wait until it finishes its first turn. A creature that assumes the dragon's form gains none of its legendary actions, lair actions, or regional effects.
Detect (1 action). Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make one tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 19 Dexterity save. Failure deals 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and knocks the creature Prone. The dragon may then fly up to half its flying speed (40 ft.).

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, after other creatures on that count, choose one effect. An effect cannot be chosen in consecutive rounds. Skip this action while the dragon is Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, wait until the dragon finishes its first turn.
Freezing fog. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Fog spreads around corners in a 20-ft.-radius sphere and makes the area heavily obscured. Each creature in the fog when it appears makes a DC 10 Constitution save for 10 (3d6) cold damage, halved on success. A creature that ends its turn there takes 10 (3d6) cold damage. A wind of at least 20 mph disperses the fog. It otherwise lasts until the dragon uses this effect again or dies.
Falling ice. Pick up to three creatures the dragon can see beneath the ceiling within 120 ft. Roll a separate ranged attack at +7 against each. A hit deals 10 (3d6) piercing damage.
Ice wall. Choose a visible solid surface within 120 ft. An opaque ice wall appears, up to 30 ft. long, 30 ft. high, and 1 ft. thick. When it appears, each creature in its space is pushed 5 ft. out of it on the side the dragon chooses. Each 10-ft. section has AC 5, 30 HP, fire vulnerability, and immunity to acid, cold, necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The wall disappears if the dragon uses the effect again or dies.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more of these effects around the lair.
Cold fog makes the land within 6 miles lightly obscured. Freezing precipitation falls within the same radius and can turn into a blizzard while the dragon rests.
Ice walls partition the lair. They are 6 inches thick, and each 10-ft. section has AC 5, 15 HP, fire vulnerability, and immunity to acid, cold, necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The dragon can pass through a wall at full speed, destroying the part it crosses.
After the dragon dies, the fog and precipitation fade within 1 day, and the walls melt over 1d10 days.

Evasion. When a Dexterity save would halve damage, Agdon instead takes none on a success or half on a failure. This trait has no effect while he is incapacitated.

gm.title: Reactions

gm.title: Encounter context

A creature can use an action and succeed on a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check to catch Agdon’s scarf. While it holds the scarf, his speed is 35 ft. and he cannot move more than 15 ft. from it. He can try once to pull free as an action, resolved by a contested Strength (Athletics) check. If he loses, he surrenders on the spot. The scarf cannot be removed, even if Agdon dies.

Agony can be targeted only by effects that turn undead. Agony retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being Charmed and Frightened. It otherwise uses the host's statistics and gains none of the host's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.
Possession ends if the host drops to 0 HP, Agony releases it as a bonus action, Agony is turned, or a spell such as Dispel Evil and Good forces it out. Agony reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the host. A successful save or the end of possession grants that creature 24 hours of immunity to Agony's Possession.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

gm.title: Fury shared rules
lines:
Printed source. Furies, pp. 79–80. The sisters appear together and speak all humanoid languages. They try three times to divert a target from atonement before trying to kill them in public.
Defenses. Damage reduction 15/good. Immune to paralysis, polymorph, and mind-affecting effects.
Scourge. The +3 scourge works like a whip that deals 1d4 lethal damage before modifiers. A Fury may substitute it for her claw attacks. Use the attack and ability damage listed for that sister. Rake (Ex) is +9 melee for 1d4 + 1 damage.
Alter Self (Sp). At will as a standard action, a Fury can take the form of an elderly human woman indefinitely. Caster level 10.
Breath Weapon (Su, 3/day). Fill one adjacent square with foul air. Apply stinking cloud as cast by an 8th-level sorcerer, with a DC 16 Fortitude save.
Find Penitent (Su). Furies can locate a target who seeks redemption at the invitation or embrace stage of corruption. The target cannot hide from them, even with magic.
Gaseous Death (Su). At 0 HP, a Fury and her scourge dissolve into smoke. Surviving sisters continue to fight, though the last survivor tries to flee. If a sister survives, the slain Furies return at full HP after 24 hours. To kill them permanently, all three must die within the same 24 hours and an Innocent must deal the killing blows. Their scourges remain after permanent death.
Weaknesses. A good cleric or a paladin can turn each Fury separately by invoking her true name. A turning attempt cannot destroy, rebuke, or command her. A Fury cannot deliberately harm a good creature except with her breath weapon.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The stat block calls the scourge’s effect Wisdom drain and gives a ranged attack, while the combat text calls the effect Wisdom damage and the shared rules treat scourges as whips. Use the printed attack bonus and the specific Wisdom-damage procedure. The attack line calls it scourge of fools. The listed Dexterity score also differs from the Dexterity bonus printed in AC.

gm.title: Description
lines: An exiled mind flayer arcanist bound to undeath by a periapt that holds sacrificed souls.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Medium undead (mind flayer, wizard), typically neutral evil

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Magic Resistance. The alhoon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Turn Resistance. The alhoon has advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Chilling Grasp or Arcane Bolt attacks.
Chilling Grasp. Melee spell attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (4d6) cold damage, and the alhoon regains 14 hit points.
Arcane Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (8d6) force damage.
Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6). The alhoon releases magical psychic energy. Creatures in a 60-foot cone make a DC 16 Intelligence save. On a failure, a creature takes 22 (4d8 + 4) psychic damage and is stunned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one spell without material components, using Intelligence (spell save DC 16).
At will. Dancing Lights, Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Dominate Monster, Globe of Invulnerability, Invisibility, Modify Memory, Plane Shift (self only), Wall of Force.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Negate Spell (3/day). When a creature the alhoon can see within 60 ft. casts a spell, the alhoon can target the caster. A spell of 3rd level or lower fails without wasting the slot or charge.

gm.title: Periapt of mind trapping
lines: The periapt is a fist-sized container made of silver, emerald, and amethyst. At least three mind flayer arcanists create the periapt and sacrifice an equal number of living victims in a three-day ritual. Each alhoon remains undead for the lifespan remaining to its victim, and the rite can be repeated with new victims. When an alhoon is destroyed, its mind enters the periapt alongside the sacrificed souls. Destroying the periapt destroys the minds and souls trapped inside. Its holder has advantage on attacks, saves, and checks against the associated alhoons, and those alhoons have disadvantage on attacks, saves, and checks against the holder. The holder can speak telepathically with the trapped victims or silence them. Alhoons inside can speak telepathically to the holder without permission.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines:

gm.title: Delerium contamination
lines:
Printed source. Appendix C, pp. 222–223.
Add contamination levels from each exposure. A contaminated character rolls 1d20 at the end of each long rest and gains one level on a 1.
Symptoms are cumulative. Level 1 has no symptom. Level 2 halves healing from Hit Dice. Level 3 prevents HP recovery from a long rest. Level 4 halves damage the creature deals with weapon attacks and spells. Level 5 makes it Incapacitated. Level 6 triggers Monstrous Transformation.
After a character gains a level, roll 1d6. On a result at or below the current level, the GM chooses a new mutation or rolls on the printed mutations table. Replace or reroll duplicate mutations.
Contamination does not wear off. Purge Contamination can remove levels and causes Exhaustion. Heal removes all contamination and mutations. Each level removed also removes one random mutation. At level 0, all symptoms and mutations end.
A contaminated humanoid rises as a Haze Husk 24 hours after death. It rises as a Haze Wight if it had at least six class levels or Hit Dice. Raising a creature from the dead reduces its contamination by one level.
Monstrous Transformation. At level 6 or higher, the creature transforms after one round. Replace its statistics, hit points, and Hit Dice with those of a monster the GM chooses. Contamination resets to 0, and the GM controls the transformed creature.
Wish or similar magic can restore one transformed creature, clearing its madness and contamination. Using Wish this way gives the caster a 33 percent chance of losing the ability to cast it again.

gm.title: Optional dragon customization
lines:
Adjust languages, skills or tool proficiencies to suit the individual dragon. Double selected skill proficiency bonuses where appropriate.
Spellcasting. The Monster Manual's optional innate casting rule grants a number of spells equal to the dragon's Charisma modifier (minimum one). Each is usable once per day without material components. A spell's level cannot exceed one-third of the dragon's challenge rating rounded down. Use Charisma for spell save DC and spell attack rolls. Consider increasing CR for stronger spells that deal damage or impose conditions.
Other traits. Consider giving a younger dragon the Change Shape action, granting Flyby or Mimicry, or binding the dragon's essence to an object so it can return after destruction. You can upgrade blindsight to truesight or grant a burrower tremorsense or Tunneler. One example of damage absorption lets a fire-immune dragon recover HP from fire.

gm.title: Description
lines: Translucent purple crystals hover behind its head. The dragon studies gravity, planes and distant worlds and often makes a lair in flooded caverns.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. The dragon breathes air and water.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The dragon can turn a failed save into a success.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) force damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.
Singularity Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 90-ft. cone makes a DC 23 Strength save. Failure deals 63 (14d8) force damage and sets the creature's speed to 0 until the start of the dragon's next turn. Success halves the damage and preserves movement.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines:
Change Shape. Magically assume any Small or Medium creature's form while keeping all statistics except size. Return to dragon form at 0 HP or by taking a bonus action.
Psychic Step. Magically teleport to a visible unoccupied space within 60 ft.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The dragon has 3 legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It can use one option at a time at the end of another creature's turn.
Claw (1 action). Make one Claw attack.
Psionics (2 actions). Use Psychic Step or Spellcasting.
Explosive Crystal (3 actions). The dragon detonates an amethyst at a visible point within 60 ft. Each creature in a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered there makes a DC 23 Dexterity save. Failure deals 18 (4d8) force damage and knocks the creature prone.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
The dragon is CR 24 (62,000 XP) in its lair.
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one option. The same option cannot be used in consecutive rounds.
Beguiling Whisper. One creature within the dragon's telepathy range makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. Failure charms it until initiative count 20 of the next round. It obeys the dragon to the best of its ability, except for directly harmful commands.
Imprisoning Force. Cast Forcecage at the dragon's spell save DC without components. The spell ends early when the dragon uses this action again or dies.
Spatial Projection. Until initiative count 20 next round, the dragon simultaneously occupies its space and one chosen space in the lair large enough to fit it. Choose which body moves or acts each time it moves or acts. An attack or effect that can reach both spaces affects it only once.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Use one or more of these effects around the lair.
Background Check. Once per day the dragon can cast Legend Lore without components to learn about a person, place or object within 1 mile.
Crystal Profusion. Amethysts and geodes form in mud on shores and lakebeds within 6 miles.
Thriving Wildlife. Fish and other aquatic Beasts thrive and reproduce quickly within 6 miles. Foraging in these waters yields double the usual food.
Watery Sight. As an action, the dragon can cast Clairvoyance without components targeting any body of water within 6 miles.
At its death, aquatic populations return to normal over 1d10 days. Existing crystals remain and new ones form at the normal rate.

gm.title: Optional dragon customization
lines:
Adjust languages, skills or tool proficiencies to suit the individual dragon. Double selected skill proficiency bonuses where appropriate.
Spellcasting. The Monster Manual's optional innate casting rule grants a number of spells equal to the dragon's Charisma modifier (minimum one). Each is usable once per day without material components. A spell's level cannot exceed one-third of the dragon's challenge rating rounded down. Use Charisma for spell save DC and spell attack rolls. Consider increasing CR for stronger spells that deal damage or impose conditions.
Other traits. Consider giving a younger dragon the Change Shape action, granting Flyby or Mimicry, or binding the dragon's essence to an object so it can return after destruction. You can upgrade blindsight to truesight or grant a burrower tremorsense or Tunneler. One example of damage absorption lets a fire-immune dragon recover HP from fire.

lines:
As an action, the dragon casts one listed spell using Intelligence (save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks) without components.
1/day each. Blink, Control Water, Dispel Magic, Freedom of Movement, Globe of Invulnerability, Plane Shift, Protection from Evil and Good, Sending.

Legendary Resistance (3/day). The dragon can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Spider Climb. The dragon climbs difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
Tunneler. Burrow through solid rock at half burrow speed and leave a 20-ft.-diameter tunnel if desired.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) thunder damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.
Debilitating Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 90-ft. cone makes a DC 23 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 55 (10d10) thunder damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and avoids incapacitation from the breath.

gm.title: Spellcasting (Psionics)
lines:
As an action, the dragon casts one of the listed spells. The dragon uses Intelligence (spell save DC 20) and needs no components.
1/day each. Dissonant Whispers, Hold Monster, Meld into Stone, Telekinesis, Teleport.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines:
Change Shape. Magically take the form of any Small or Medium creature, keeping all game statistics except size. The change ends at 0 hit points or when the dragon ends it as a bonus action.
Psychic Step. Magically teleport to a visible unoccupied space within 60 ft.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The dragon has three legendary actions, regained at the start of its turn. It can spend them on one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn.
Claw (1 action). Make one Claw attack.
Psionics (2 actions). Use Psychic Step or Spellcasting.
Telekinetic Fling (3 actions). Choose a visible Medium or smaller object within 60 ft. that no creature wears or carries. Hurl it at a creature visible to the dragon within 60 ft. of the object. The creature must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity save or take 42 (12d6) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, the dragon can use one lair action. It cannot choose the same option in consecutive rounds.
Awesome Thunder. One visible creature in the lair makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 13 (3d8) thunder damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. The sound carries up to 300 ft.
Beguiling Whisper. Choose one creature within telepathy range. It must pass a DC 15 Wisdom save or be charmed by the dragon until initiative count 20 next round. While charmed this way, the creature follows the dragon’s commands to the best of its ability, except for commands that directly harm it.
Stone Passage. Touch stone measuring up to 30 ft. in each dimension and reshape it to open or close a passage through a wall less than 10 ft. thick.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
The dragon’s magic causes one or more of these effects around its lair.
Crystal Profusion. Natural stone within 6 miles sprouts crystals and sapphire veins, particularly underground.
Stony Sight. As an action, the dragon can cast Clairvoyance without components, targeting any natural stone formation within 6 miles.
Telepathic Enhancement. Within 1 mile, existing innate or magical telepathy has double its normal range. This includes Rary’s Telepathic Bond.
Thriving Wildlife. Giant Spiders gather within 6 miles.
When the dragon dies, telepathy returns to normal immediately and the spider population returns to normal over 1d10 days. Existing crystals and sapphires remain, and new ones form at their usual rate.

gm.title: Description
lines: The serpent coils around prey and can wreck ships with its bite and tail.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. The serpent breathes air and water.
Legendary Resistance (2/day). The serpent can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Siege Monster. The serpent deals double damage to objects and structures.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack plus either one Constrict or one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d12 + 7) piercing damage plus 6 (1d12) cold damage.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one creature. A hit deals 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage and grapples the target (escape DC 20). The grapple restrains that target and prevents the serpent from constricting another creature until the grapple ends.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (1d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 20 Strength save or be pushed up to 30 ft. away and knocked prone.
Rime Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 18 Constitution save, taking 49 (9d10) cold damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The serpent has three legendary actions, regained at the start of its turn. It can spend them on one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn.
Tail (1 action). Make one Tail attack.
Bite (2 actions). Make one Bite attack.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Saving Throws Dex +7, Con +16, Wis +9, Cha +13 Skills Arcana +11, History +11, Perception +16, Stealth +7 Damage Immunities cold Senses blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 26 Languages Common, Draconic

lines: Legendary Resistance (3/Day). If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage. Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d6 + 10) slashing damage. Tail. Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage. Frightful Presence. Each creature of the dragon’s choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon’s Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours. Breath Weapons (Recharge 5–6). The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons. Cold Breath. The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 90- foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 24 Constitution saving throw, taking 67 (15d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Paralyzing Breath. The dragon exhales paralyzing gas in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 24 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Change Shape. The dragon magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the dragon’s choice). In a new form, the dragon retains its alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines: The dragon can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn. The dragon regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn. Detect. The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check. Tail Attack. The dragon makes a tail attack. Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions). The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 15 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair). If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Paralyzing Breath or (B) Spellcasting to cast Ice Knife (level 2 version). Rend. Melee Attack Roll: +17, reach 15 ft. Hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Cold damage. Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6). Constitution Saving Throw: DC 24, each creature in a 90-foot Cone. Failure: 67 (15d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage. Paralyzing Breath. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 24, each creature in a 90-foot Cone. First Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. Second Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. Spellcasting. The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks): At Will: Detect Magic, Hold Monster, Ice Knife (level 2 version), Shapechange (Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell) 1/Day Each: Control Weather, Ice Storm (level 7 version), Teleport, Zone of Truth

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines: Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature’s turn, the dragon can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dragon regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns. Chill. The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Hold Monster. The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn. Cold Gale. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 23, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line. Failure: 14 (4d6) Cold damage, and the target is pushed up to 30 feet straight away from the dragon. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn. Pounce. The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.

gm.title: Description
lines: This dragon's high frill and chin spikes frame a gleaming silver face. Silver dragons befriend humanoids and collect relics of their history.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Legendary Resistance (3/day). The dragon can turn a failed saving throw into a success.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. The dragon may first use Frightful Presence. It then makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 17 (2d6 + 10) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit 19 (2d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage.
Frightful Presence. Choose any creatures within 120 ft. that are aware of the dragon. Each makes a DC 21 Wisdom save or becomes Frightened for 1 minute. An affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that saves or whose fear ends gains immunity to this dragon's Frightful Presence for 24 hours.
Breath Weapons (recharge 5–6). Use one of the following breaths.
Cold Breath. Each creature in a 90-ft. cone makes a DC 24 Constitution save. Failure deals 67 (15d8) cold damage. Success halves it.
Paralyzing Breath. Each creature in a 90-ft. cone makes a DC 24 Constitution save or becomes Paralyzed for 1 minute. An affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Change Shape. The dragon magically changes into a humanoid or beast of its CR or lower or returns to dragon form. It returns to dragon form on death. The dragon chooses whether its equipment merges into the form or stays with it. In the new form, it keeps its alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, speech, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and this action. Use the form's other statistics and capabilities. The dragon gains none of the form's class features, legendary actions, lair actions, or regional effects.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The dragon has 3 legendary actions. Spend them one option at a time at the end of another creature's turn. It regains them at the start of its turn. It can't use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or while surprised until it finishes its first turn.
Detect (1 action). Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Each creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 25 Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
While in its lair, the dragon can choose one option on initiative count 20, after other creatures on that count. It can't take a lair action while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must first finish its first turn.
Fog. Create fog using the Fog Cloud spell's rules. It lasts until the next round's initiative count 20.
Freezing Wind. Each creature within 120 ft. of the dragon makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 5 (1d10) cold damage. The wind disperses gases and vapors and snuffs exposed flames. Each protected flame, such as a lantern, has a 50 percent chance of going out.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more of these effects around the lair.
Weather. Once per day the dragon can use the effects of Control Weather within 6 miles of its lair, even indoors.
Buoyant Winds. Within 1 mile of the lair, non-evil creatures that fall through no act of the dragon or its allies descend 60 ft. per round and take no falling damage.
Solid Fog. After days or longer of work, the dragon can make clouds and fog in the lair as solid as stone to form objects or structures.
When the dragon dies, weather changes revert as described in Control Weather. The other effects fade in 1d10 days.

gm.title: Variant spellcasting
lines: Under the optional dragon spellcasting rule, choose 6 spells of 7th level or lower. The dragon uses Charisma to cast each once per day without material components. Its spell save DC is 21 and its spell attack bonus is +13. The DM chooses the spells.

lines: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 11, 86, 116, and 118. The official errata corrects the XP to 50,000.
