gm.title: Description
lines: A mountain and city dragon that can control the weather from its lair. Winds nearby catch falling creatures.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Legendary Resistance (4/day, or 5/day in its lair). On a failed save, the dragon can spend a use to succeed.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dragon can use Paralyzing Breath or cast Ice Knife at level 2 through Spellcasting in place of one attack.
Rend. Melee attack, +17 to hit, reach 15 ft. Hit 19 (2d8 + 10) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Cold damage.
Cold Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 90-ft. cone makes a DC 24 Constitution save. Failure deals 67 (15d8) Cold damage. Success halves the damage.
Paralyzing Breath. Each creature in a 90-ft. cone makes a DC 24 Constitution save. On failure, it is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn and repeats the save then. On a second failure, it is Paralyzed and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. A success ends the effect, and the save succeeds automatically after 1 minute.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Casting one of these spells takes an action. The dragon uses Charisma (save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks), and the spells require no Material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Hold Monster, Ice Knife at level 2, Shapechange.
1/day each. Control Weather, Ice Storm at level 7, Teleport, Zone of Truth.
Shapechange only allows Beast or Humanoid forms. It grants no Temporary Hit Points and requires neither Concentration nor Temporary Hit Points to maintain.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The dragon has 3 uses, or 4 in its lair. It can spend one use on one option immediately after another creature’s turn. Spent uses return at the start of the dragon’s turn. It cannot use these actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Chill. Cast Hold Monster through Spellcasting. The dragon can use this option again starting on its next turn.
Cold Gale. Each creature in a 60-ft. line 10 ft. wide makes a DC 23 Dexterity save. On failure, it takes 14 (4d6) Cold damage and is pushed up to 30 ft. straight away from the dragon. Success halves the damage and prevents the push. The dragon can use this option again starting on its next turn.
Pounce. Move up to half its Speed and make one Rend attack.

gm.title: Lair resources
lines: The encounter is worth 62,000 XP in the lair. The dragon has 5 daily Legendary Resistance uses and 4 legendary action uses there.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Gentle Gusts. A creature falling within 1 mile of the lair descends at 60 ft. per round and takes no falling damage.
Sun and Storms. In its lair, the dragon can cast Control Weather without Material components, using its Spellcasting ability.
Both effects end immediately if the dragon dies or moves its lair.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Monster Manual (2024), p. 280. Includes the regional effects.

gm.title: Description
lines: A sun-born dragon with a long scaled body, luminous wings, and a pair of fins may claim an entire Wildspace system as its hunting ground. It guards the approach to its stellar nest, especially when it has eggs.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Flyby. Leaving an enemy’s reach by flying does not provoke an opportunity attack.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The dragon can turn a failed save into a success.
Nebulous Thoughts. Magic that attempts to read the dragon’s mind or thoughts fails.
Siege Monster. Double damage against objects and structures.
Unusual Nature. The dragon needs no air.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (1d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage.
Photonic Breath (Recharge 5–6). Center a 40-ft.-radius sphere on a point the dragon sees up to 240 ft. away. Each creature in the sphere makes a DC 23 Constitution save, taking 66 (12d10) radiant damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The dragon has 3 legendary actions and refreshes them at the start of its turn. Use at most one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Burst of Light (2 actions). The dragon emits magical light. Each creature in a 30-ft.-radius sphere centered on the dragon makes a DC 23 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is blinded through the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Lair
lines: A solar dragon nests in the core of a star or within an immense hollow rock in its glare. An obsidian-shelled egg turns translucent just before it hatches.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Blinding Radiance. A creature inside the star or within 10 miles of it is blinded unless it wears eye protection such as Goggles of Night.
Stellar Incineration. A creature takes 132 (24d10) radiant damage when it enters the star or starts its turn inside it.

lines: A Gargantuan dragon with challenge rating 26. Named abilities include Cycle of Rebirth, Legendary Resistance (5/Day), Rend.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A vast silver time dragon whose great horns carry branching iridescent veins.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saves Dex +10, Con +16, Wis +12, Cha +14. Skills Arcana +16, History +24, Perception +20, Stealth +18. Senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft.. Languages: all. Passive Perception 30.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Cycle of Rebirth. On death, the dragon's soul forms a steely egg that teleports to a random plane. The egg takes no damage and hatches in 1d100 years as a wyrmling retaining the dragon's former memories and knowledge.
Legendary Resistance (5/day). Turn a failed save into a success.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee weapon attack +17, reach 15 ft. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) slashing plus 10 (3d6) force.
Time Breath (Recharge 5–6). A 90-ft. cone turns nonmagical unattended objects and vegetation to dust. Each creature in range makes a DC 24 Constitution save. On failure it takes 52 (8d12) force damage and is weakened. Attacks against a weakened creature have Advantage, and it is Poisoned. Other creatures also resist all damage it deals. A creature that passes the initial save only takes half damage. A weakened target may repeat the save at each turn end. Its third successful repeat ends the effect.
Time Gate (1/day). Open a 20-ft.-diameter portal between the dragon's horns or at a visible unoccupied point within 30 ft. Choose an exact place on any plane, up to 8,000 years before or after the present. Each opening has a front and back. Enter either opening from the front to arrive at the nearest clear space on the other end. The gate lasts up to 24 hours with Concentration. A deity or planar ruler can block it in that being's presence or domain.

gm.title: Reactions
lines:
Up to three reactions each round, at most one each turn.
Reactive Rend. After using Legendary Resistance or being hit by an attack roll, make one Rend attack.
Slow Time. Just after a visible creature's turn ends, choose a visible creature within 90 ft. weakened by Time Breath. Its speed is fixed at 0 while it remains weakened.
Time Slip. Halve damage from an attack by a visible attacker, then optionally teleport with all gear to a visible unoccupied space within 60 ft.

gm.title: Lair Actions
lines:
Act on initiative 20, losing ties. Choose one lair action, with no repeat on consecutive rounds.
Temporal Fling. One visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. On failure it takes 26 (4d12) psychic damage and disappears for one round, then returns to its space or the nearest available space.
Temporal Lag. Until initiative 20 next round, each creature within 60 ft. can move or take an action on its turn, but not both. It cannot take reactions or bonus actions during that time.
Timeline Divergence. Choose a space in the lair the dragon can fit inside. It exists in both locations until initiative 20 next round. It chooses which self moves or acts each time. An attack or effect covering both spaces affects the dragon once.

gm.title: Regional Effects
lines:
Within 3 miles, one or both effects can apply.
Time Dilations. The DM chooses whether a short rest takes 10 minutes or 2 hours.
Timelessness. Beasts, Humanoids, and Plants age one year per decade.
After the dragon dies, the effects fade over 1d10 days.

lines:
Amphibious. The dragon breathes air and water.
Fabricate (1/day). Cast Fabricate with Intelligence and without components.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The dragon can turn a failed saving throw into a success.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.
Desiccating Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 90-ft. cone makes a DC 20 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 49 (14d6) necrotic damage and is weakened until the end of its next turn. It has disadvantage on Strength checks and saves, and its Strength-based weapon attacks deal half damage. A success halves the breath damage and avoids the weakening.

gm.title: Spellcasting (Psionics)
lines:
As an action, the dragon casts one of the listed spells. The dragon uses Intelligence (spell save DC 19) and needs no components.
1/day each. Antilife Shell, Bane, Control Water, Create or Destroy Water.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines:
Change Shape. Magically take the form of any Small or Medium creature, keeping all game statistics except size. The change ends at 0 hit points or when the dragon ends it as a bonus action.
Psychic Step. Magically teleport to a visible unoccupied space within 60 ft.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The dragon has three legendary actions, regained at the start of its turn. It can spend them on one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn.
Claw (1 action). Make one Claw attack.
Psionics (2 actions). Use Psychic Step or Spellcasting.
Essential Reduction (3 actions). Choose a visible creature or an object that no creature wears or carries within 60 ft. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution save or take 40 (9d8) necrotic damage. A target reduced to 0 HP by this damage crumbles to dust.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, the dragon can use one lair action. It cannot choose the same option in consecutive rounds.
Beguiling Whisper. Choose one creature within telepathy range. It must pass a DC 15 Wisdom save or be charmed by the dragon until initiative count 20 next round. While charmed this way, the creature follows the dragon’s commands to the best of its ability, except for commands that directly harm it.
Cancellation. End one active spell of 5th level or lower that the dragon knows is in its lair.
Negative Energy Infusion. Up to two visible creatures in the lair each make a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 14 (4d6) necrotic damage on a failure. Until initiative count 20 next round, only the dragon can regain HP within the lair.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
The dragon’s magic causes one or more of these effects around its lair.
Crystal Profusion. Natural stone within 6 miles sprouts crystals and topaz veins, particularly underground.
Negative Energy. A creature finishing a long rest within 6 miles must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save to reduce its exhaustion or recover any spent Hit Dice. Creatures with resistance or immunity to necrotic damage are exempt.
Thriving Wildlife. Giant squid gather and hunt in nearby seas within 6 miles.
Watery Sight. As an action, the dragon can cast Clairvoyance without components, targeting any body of water within 6 miles.
When the dragon dies, the giant squid population returns to normal over 1d10 days. Existing crystals and topazes remain, and new ones form at their usual rate.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Ice Walk. The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn’t cost it extra moment. Legendary Resistance (3/Day). If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage. Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage. Tail. Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage. Frightful Presence. Each creature of the dragon’s choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon’s Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours. Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6). The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 72 (16d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines: The dragon can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn. The dragon regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn. Detect. The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check. Tail Attack. The dragon makes a tail attack. Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions). The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 15 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · 40 ft., burrow 40 ft., fly 80 ft., swim 40 ft.

gm.title: Description
lines: A solitary arctic hunter that freezes prey and caches its kills beneath the ice.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Ice Walk. The dragon can cross and climb ice without ability checks. Ice and snow that count as difficult terrain cost it no extra movement.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). After failing a save, the dragon can choose to succeed.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. The dragon may use Frightful Presence, then makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack against one target within 15 ft., +14 to hit. Hit for 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack against one target within 10 ft., +14 to hit. Hit for 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack against one target within 20 ft., +14 to hit. Hit for 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.
Frightful Presence. Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 ft. that is aware of it makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened for 1 minute and can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. A successful save or the end of the effect gives that creature 24 hours of immunity to this dragon's Frightful Presence.
Cold Breath (recharge 5–6). All creatures in a 90-ft. cone make a DC 22 Constitution save. Failure deals 72 (16d8) cold damage. Success halves the damage.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The dragon has three legendary actions. Spend them on one option at a time at the end of another creature's turn. Spent actions return at the start of the dragon's turn. The dragon can choose to pass. It cannot use these actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must wait until it finishes its first turn. A creature that assumes the dragon's form gains none of its legendary actions, lair actions, or regional effects.
Detect (1 action). Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make one tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Each creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 22 Dexterity save. Failure deals 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and knocks the creature Prone. The dragon may then fly up to half its flying speed (40 ft.).

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, after other creatures on that count, choose one effect. An effect cannot be chosen in consecutive rounds. Skip this action while the dragon is Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, wait until the dragon finishes its first turn.
Freezing fog. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Fog spreads around corners in a 20-ft.-radius sphere and makes the area heavily obscured. Each creature in the fog when it appears makes a DC 10 Constitution save for 10 (3d6) cold damage, halved on success. A creature that ends its turn there takes 10 (3d6) cold damage. A wind of at least 20 mph disperses the fog. It otherwise lasts until the dragon uses this effect again or dies.
Falling ice. Pick up to three creatures the dragon can see beneath the ceiling within 120 ft. Roll a separate ranged attack at +7 against each. A hit deals 10 (3d6) piercing damage.
Ice wall. Choose a visible solid surface within 120 ft. An opaque ice wall appears, up to 30 ft. long, 30 ft. high, and 1 ft. thick. When it appears, each creature in its space is pushed 5 ft. out of it on the side the dragon chooses. Each 10-ft. section has AC 5, 30 HP, fire vulnerability, and immunity to acid, cold, necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The wall disappears if the dragon uses the effect again or dies.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more of these effects around the lair.
Cold fog makes the land within 6 miles lightly obscured. Freezing precipitation falls within the same radius and can turn into a blizzard while the dragon rests.
Ice walls partition the lair. They are 6 inches thick, and each 10-ft. section has AC 5, 15 HP, fire vulnerability, and immunity to acid, cold, necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The dragon can pass through a wall at full speed, destroying the part it crosses.
After the dragon dies, the fog and precipitation fade within 1 day, and the walls melt over 1d10 days.

gm.title: Variant: innate spellcasting
lines: If using the optional dragon spellcasting rules, choose 2 spells of level 6 or lower. The dragon can cast each once per day without material components using Charisma. Spell save DC 16. Spell attack bonus +8.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Monster Manual (2014), p. 100 for the stat block and p. 86 for optional spellcasting. Lair and regional rules appear on pp. 102–103. The official errata clarifies the legendary and lair action restrictions. The official errata corrects XP to 25,000.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The printed Ice Wall rule is ambiguous about who chooses the side. This profile gives the choice to the dragon.

lines:

Cold Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 90-ft. cone makes a DC 22 Constitution save. Failure deals 63 (14d8) Cold damage. Success halves the damage.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
It has 3 uses, or 4 in its lair. It can spend one use on one option immediately after another creature’s turn. It regains spent uses at the start of its turn. It cannot take legendary actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.

On failure, it takes 14 (4d6) Cold damage and its Speed is 0 until the end of the affected creature's next turn. gm.title: Lair resources
lines: The encounter is worth 33,000 XP in the lair. The dragon has 5 daily Legendary Resistance uses and 4 legendary action uses there.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:

Glacial Gloom. Chilly fog leaves the area within 1 mile of the lair Lightly Obscured. A creature other than the dragon or one of its allies that finishes a Long Rest there must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or have its Speed reduced by 10 ft. for 1 hour.
Both effects end immediately when the dragon dies or moves its lair.

gm.title: Reading Black Flag stat blocks
lines:
Rules source. Black Flag Reference Document, Monsters.
The printed modifiers and fixed HP are ready to use. For a Dexterity (Stealth) check to avoid the creature, use its Perception value as the DC. For a Wisdom (Perception) check to detect it, use its Stealth value as the DC.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Inscrutable. The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the sphinx’s intentions or sincerity have disadvantage. Magic Weapons. The sphinx’s weapon attacks are magical. Spellcasting. The sphinx is a 12th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). It requires no material components to cast its spells. The sphinx has the following cleric spells prepared: Cantrips (at will): sacred flame, spare the dying, thaumaturgy 1st level (4 slots): command, detect evil and good, detect magic 2nd level (3 slots): lesser restoration, zone of truth 3rd level (3 slots): dispel magic, tongues 4th level (3 slots): banishment, freedom of movement 5th level (2 slots): flame strike, greater restoration 6th level (1 slot): heroes’ feast

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. The sphinx makes two claw attacks. Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage. Roar (3/Day). The sphinx emits a magical roar. Each time it roars before finishing a long rest, the roar is louder and the effect is different, as detailed below. Each creature within 500 feet of the sphinx and able to hear the roar must make a saving throw. First Roar. Each creature that fails a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw is frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Roar. Each creature that fails a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw is deafened and frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature is paralyzed and can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Third Roar. Each creature makes a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 44 (8d10) thunder damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn’t knocked prone.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines: The sphinx can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn. The sphinx regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn. Claw Attack. The sphinx makes one claw attack. Teleport (Costs 2 Actions). The sphinx magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions). The sphinx casts a spell from its list of prepared spells, using a spell slot as normal.

gm.title: Description
lines: A winged guardian watches over divine secrets and challenges those who seek them.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Inscrutable. Effects cannot read the sphinx's thoughts or sense its emotions. It can refuse any divination spell and is immune to that spell if it does. Wisdom (Insight) checks to judge its intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
Divine Vigil. The sphinx needs neither sleep nor food while it keeps watch.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The sphinx has 3 legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It can use one option at the end of another creature's turn. It can pass, and it cannot act while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to take actions. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using these options.
Claw Attack. Make one Claw attack.
Teleport (2 actions). Magically teleport up to 120 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space. Worn and carried equipment goes along.
Cast a Spell (3 actions). Cast one of its prepared spells and spend a spell slot as usual.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one magical effect. Each option is available once per short or long rest. The sphinx cannot use its lair actions while outside its lair, Incapacitated, or otherwise unable to take actions. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using an option.
Reroll initiative. Every creature in the lair rolls initiative again. The sphinx may keep its current roll.
Change age. Each creature in the lair makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, it ages or grows younger by 1d20 years, as the sphinx chooses. No creature becomes younger than 1 year old. Greater Restoration can return a creature to its normal age.
Shift time. Move everything in the lair up to 10 years ahead or back, as the sphinx chooses. The sphinx alone notices the change immediately. Wish can restore its caster and up to seven creatures the caster designates to their normal time.
Shift planes. Move the sphinx and up to seven other creatures it can see in the lair to another plane. On its turn, the sphinx can return to its lair as a bonus action and take up to seven creatures with it.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Psychic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
12th-level cleric. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability, with save DC 18 and +10 to hit. It requires no material components.
Cantrips, at will. Sacred Flame, Spare the Dying, Thaumaturgy.
1st level, 4 slots. Command, Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic.
2nd level, 3 slots. Lesser Restoration, Zone of Truth.
3rd level, 3 slots. Dispel Magic, Tongues.
4th level, 3 slots. Banishment, Freedom of Movement.
5th level, 2 slots. Flame Strike, Greater Restoration.
6th level, 1 slot. Heroes' Feast.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.
Roar (3/day). Each creature within 500 ft. that can hear this magical roar makes the save for its place in the sequence. Count roars since the sphinx's last long rest.
First roar. Make a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a failure, the creature is Frightened for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and end the effect on a success.
Second roar. Make a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a failure, the creature is Deafened and Frightened for 1 minute. It is Paralyzed while Frightened this way and can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
Third roar. Make a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature takes 44 (8d10) thunder damage and falls Prone. On a success, it takes half damage and stays upright.

gm.title: Description
lines: Kel Belleth turned her exile into a base for the Void. She recruits disaffected celestials and aids cults from her demiplane, Sun Hollow.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Perception 20, Stealth 14. Immune to necrotic damage. Truesight 120 ft. Speaks all languages and has telepathy 120 ft. CR 16 in Sun Hollow.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: STR +7 · DEX +4 · CON +11 · INT +4 · WIS +10 · CHA +10

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Angelic Resilience. Resist radiant damage and damage from nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing attacks. Immune to Exhaustion, Charmed, and Frightened.
Angelic Senses. Pinpoint Aberrations, Celestials, Fiends, and Undead within 30 ft. Recognize consecration or desecration on any place or object the angel can sense.
Divine Awareness. Kel Belleth recognizes any lie she hears.
Divine Protection. Aberrations, Celestials, Fiends, and Undead roll attacks against her with disadvantage.
Immortal Nature. The angel needs no food, drink, or sleep.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). She can choose to succeed when she fails a save.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Void Weapons. Her weapon attacks are magical and add 4d8 necrotic damage on a hit, as included below.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Greatsword attacks or four Void Bolt attacks. One attack in either set can be replaced with Chain.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 28 (6d6 + 7) slashing plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.
Chain. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. Grapple the target (escape DC 18) and Restrain it until the grapple ends. Each of her three chains can hold one target.
Void Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +10 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 23 (4d8 + 5) necrotic damage.
Soul Siphon (Recharge 6). Choose up to three creatures she can see within 10 ft. Each makes a DC 18 Constitution save, with disadvantage if Restrained by her Chain. A failure deals 49 (11d8) necrotic damage and gives one level of void taint, or one level of Exhaustion if substituting. A success halves the damage and avoids the added level. Kel Belleth regains HP equal to half the total necrotic damage dealt.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Blasphemous Word. When an attacker she can see hits her, Kel Belleth can speak a word of Void Speech. An attacker that hears her takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. She must be able to speak.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines:
Kel Belleth has three legendary actions and recovers them at the start of her turn. Use at most one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Teleport. Move magically up to 90 ft. to an unoccupied space she can see, bringing anything she is wearing or carrying.
Dark Litany (2 actions). Choose up to two creatures she can see within 60 ft. Each that hears her makes a DC 18 Wisdom save, with disadvantage if it has void taint or the substituted Exhaustion. Every saving target falls Prone. A failed save also Incapacitates it until the end of its next turn.
Ravenous Heart (2 actions). Use Soul Siphon if ready.

gm.title: Lair Actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, after tied turns, choose one effect. The same effect cannot be used in consecutive rounds.
Clawing Shadows. Until the next count 20, each hostile creature that starts its turn in dim light or darkness within 120 ft. of Kel Belleth makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and halves its speed until the start of its next turn.
Vile Chorus. Pick a point she can see within 120 ft. Each hostile creature within 30 ft. of that point makes a DC 18 Constitution save. Failure deals 7 (2d6) psychic damage and makes it vulnerable to necrotic damage until the next count 20.
Weeping Stone. All solid surfaces within 300 ft. of Kel Belleth become difficult terrain until the next count 20.

gm.title: Regional Effects
lines:
Gnawing Emptiness. Food and drink consumed in Sun Hollow turn to ash and do not count against starvation or dehydration.
Heavenly Hostility. Celestials other than Kel Belleth and void angels make a DC 18 Charisma save each hour spent in Sun Hollow. Failure adds one level of Exhaustion, bypassing the immunity granted by Angelic Resilience.
Oppressive Gray. Effects that create sunlight give bright light instead. Effects that ordinarily create bright light give dim light.
These effects fade 1d10 days after Kel Belleth dies.

gm.title: Encounter reference
lines: See Chapter 7, pp. 227–229 for the optional void taint rules. Soul Siphon specifies Exhaustion as the fallback.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · 20 ft., climb 20 ft., swim 30 ft.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A purple frogfolk mystic with orange-red eyes, a dark mantle and small pendants.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Dexterity save +6, Wisdom save +7. Skills Acrobatics +6, Perception +10, Stealth +6, Survival +7. Damage immunity poison. Darkvision 120 ft., truesight 60 ft. Passive Perception 20. Language Angulotl.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
Third Eye. Creatures within 30 ft. cannot hide from the seer. Creatures immune to being targeted by divination magic are unaffected.
Toxiferous. A creature that touches the angulotl, or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft., takes 2 (1d4) poison damage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Acid Grasp. Melee spell attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (4d6) acid damage. A creature hit by this attack takes another 14 (4d6) acid damage if it attacks the seer before the start of the seer’s next turn.
Refulgent Beam. Fire two beams, each at a visible creature within 120 ft. Each target makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or takes 13 (3d8) radiant damage and sheds dim light out to 10 ft. for 1 minute. While lit, attacks against it have advantage, it gets no benefit from being Invisible, and it cannot Hide. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect early.
Noxious Bubble (1/day). Create a sphere of toxic gas with a 5-ft. radius in an empty visible space within 60 ft. It dissipates after 1 minute if undisturbed. Attacking, touching, entering or otherwise disturbing it bursts the sphere. Every creature within 15 ft. of it makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 27 (6d8) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.
Psychedelic Drone (1/day). Each enemy within 60 ft. that can hear the seer makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage and is Dazed for 1 minute. The enemy repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect early.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Hop. The seer jumps up to its walking speed.

gm.title: Dazed (MCDM)
lines: On its turn a Dazed creature chooses one of moving, taking an action, or taking a bonus action. If it becomes Dazed during its turn, that turn ends. It still gets any extra action granted by an effect such as Haste or Action Surge. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration and Greater Restoration can end the condition.

lines: An amphibious frogfolk larva with a finned tail, dark round eyes and small webbed feet.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Damage immunity poison. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 9. No languages.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Acid Burst. When the tadpole drops to 0 HP, it bursts and deals 1 acid damage to every creature within 5 ft.
Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
Minion. An attack or a failed save that deals damage immediately drops the tadpole to 0 HP. Any other single instance of damage kills it if it deals at least 6 damage. The tadpole ignores lower damage from such an effect.
Noxious Skin. A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of at least three tadpoles makes a Constitution save with DC 10 plus the number of tadpoles within 5 ft. of it. Failure leaves it Poisoned until the start of its next turn.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Bite (Group Attack). Melee weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1 piercing damage.

gm.title: Minion rules
lines:
Group attack. Two to five tadpoles that share a turn and can all reach a target spend their actions on one Bite roll. Add their number to +3. A hit deals 1 piercing damage per participant. A solo tadpole rolls at +3. Apply advantage or disadvantage only when it applies to all participants. Roll separately for groups with different cover or concealment. If the attack triggers an effect that can affect only one attacker, the target chooses which tadpole it affects.
Group opportunity attack. Multiple tadpoles can each spend their reaction to join the same Bite if the target provokes from them at the same time. Tadpoles have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. A weapon hit dealing more than 6 damage leaves a surplus equal to damage minus 6. Reduce one additional eligible tadpole to 0 HP per 6 surplus damage or fraction of 6. Additional melee targets must be within reach. Additional ranged targets must be on the line from attacker through the first target and within the weapon’s short range. Opportunity attacks cannot deal overkill damage.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Bite uses the default 5-ft. reach for a melee attack.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · 25 ft., climb 20 ft., swim 30 ft.

gm.title: Hit point rule
lines: 7 × the yegg’s level in hit points. It has one d8 Hit Die per level.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A small frogfolk retainer wearing light leather armor and carrying a poison knife and an acid flask.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Light armor. Saving throws +PB across all abilities. Skills Acrobatics +3 + PB, Athletics +PB, Stealth +3 + PB, Survival +2 + PB. Poison resistance. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 12. Languages Angulotl and Common.

gm.title: Mentor scaling
lines: The yegg uses its mentor’s level and proficiency bonus (PB). It acts on its mentor’s initiative, immediately before or after the mentor as the player chooses. At 0 HP it follows the same rules as a player character, including death saves.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Amphibious. The yegg breathes air and water.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Signature Attack (Poison Knife). Melee or ranged weapon attack at +3 + PB, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 1d4 + PB piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison damage. Starting at level 7, the yegg can make two of these attacks when it takes the Attack action. It can use its signature attack for opportunity attacks.

gm.title: Retainer features
lines:
Level 3, Death from Above! (3/day). As a bonus action, jump up to walking speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If the yegg jumps over an enemy, it can make a signature attack against that enemy with advantage. A hit deals extra piercing damage equal to PB.
Level 5, Lay Low (3/day). After hitting a creature with a signature attack while hidden, the yegg can use its reaction to stay hidden.
Level 7, Excoriating Acid (3/day). As an action, throw a flask at a visible point within 20 ft. Every creature within 10 ft. of the point makes a Dexterity save against DC 10 + PB, taking PBd10 acid damage on a failure or half on a success.

lines: Speed · 60 ft., fly 60 ft. (hover), swim 60 ft.

gm.title: Description
lines: An immortal protector of animals from the Beastlands. It shifts between a humanoid guise and a great version of its animal, and calls the spirits of its kind to fight.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Animal Lordship. The DM chooses Forager, Hunter, or Sage. Use that role for both Lordly Presence and Animal Spirit.
Legendary Resistance (4/day). When the animal lord fails a saving throw, it can spend one use to succeed instead.
Lordly Presence. An enemy starting its turn in a 30-foot Emanation from the animal lord makes a DC 20 Wisdom save. On a failure, apply the effect for the chosen role. Forager. The enemy is Charmed until the end of its next turn. While Charmed this way, it is also Incapacitated. Hunter. The enemy is Frightened until the end of its next turn. Sage. The enemy takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage and is magically bewildered until the end of its next turn. While bewildered, it subtracts 1d4 from its saving throws.
Magic Resistance. The animal lord has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Rend and Radiant Ray, and use Animal Spirit.
Rend. Melee attack, +13 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (2d6 + 7) Slashing damage and 7 (2d6) Force damage.
Radiant Ray. Ranged attack, +12 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 20 (4d6 + 6) Radiant damage.
Animal Spirit. Summon a spirit to strike one creature the animal lord can see within 120 ft. The target makes a DC 20 Dexterity save, taking 28 (4d10 + 6) Radiant damage on a failure or half on a success. Either way, apply the effect for the chosen role. Forager. The animal lord gains 20 Temporary Hit Points. Hunter. The animal lord has Advantage on attack rolls against the target until the start of the animal lord's next turn. Sage. The target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn. The spirit then disappears.
Spellcasting. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability (save DC 20). Cast the following spells without Material components. At will, Animal Friendship, Animal Messenger, and Speak with Animals. Twice per day each, Awaken and Greater Restoration. Once per day each, Animal Shapes and Sunburst.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Shape-Shift. Take the form of a Huge or smaller version of the animal the lord represents or a Small or Medium Humanoid, or return to its true form. Only size can change among its game statistics. Equipment it wears or carries stays as it was.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
3 uses, regained at the start of the animal lord's turn. Spend one use at the end of another creature's turn to take one option. The creature cannot take legendary actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Feral Strike. Move up to the animal lord's Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and make one Rend attack.
Radiant Strike. Make one Radiant Ray attack.

lines: A chromatic dragon can shape the energy of its breath into a walking guard or treasure gatherer.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, restrained, unconscious.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: The damage type matching its form (acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison).

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Chromatic Form. When created, the elemental takes the form of its creator’s breath: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. The form sets its resistance and the bonus damage on Slam. The cold form has AC 17. Each other form has AC 15.
Fire Aura (fire only). At the start of the elemental’s turn, each creature within 5 ft. takes 3 (1d6) fire damage. Flammable objects in the aura ignite if nobody wears or carries them. A creature that touches the elemental or hits it with a melee attack takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.
Putrid Aura (acid or poison only). A creature starting its turn within 5 ft. must pass a DC 15 Constitution save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. A creature that touches the elemental or hits it with a melee attack takes 3 (1d6) acid damage in either form.

gm.title: Actions
lines:

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Lightning Burst (lightning only). Magically teleport to a visible unoccupied space within 30 ft. Each creature within 5 ft. of the destination takes 3 (1d6) lightning damage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Contaminated Touch. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target makes a DC 15 Constitution save or gains 1 contamination level.
Engulf. Each creature in the sludge’s space makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, a Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14) and Restrained until the grapple ends. On a success, push the target out of the sludge’s space. The sludge can hold either one Large target or up to two targets of Medium size or smaller. At the start of each of the sludge’s turns, each grappled target takes 28 (8d6) necrotic damage and makes a DC 15 Constitution save or gains 1 contamination level. A creature within 5 ft. can use an action to pull out a creature or object with a successful DC 14 Strength check.

gm.title: Delerium contamination
lines:
Printed source. Appendix C, pp. 222–223.
Add contamination levels from each exposure. A contaminated character rolls 1d20 at the end of each long rest and gains one level on a 1.
Symptoms are cumulative. Level 1 has no symptom. Level 2 halves healing from Hit Dice. Level 3 prevents HP recovery from a long rest. Level 4 halves damage the creature deals with weapon attacks and spells. Level 5 makes it Incapacitated. Level 6 triggers Monstrous Transformation.
After a character gains a level, roll 1d6. On a result at or below the current level, the GM chooses a new mutation or rolls on the printed mutations table. Replace or reroll duplicate mutations.
Contamination does not wear off. Purge Contamination can remove levels and causes Exhaustion. Heal removes all contamination and mutations. Each level removed also removes one random mutation. At level 0, all symptoms and mutations end.
A contaminated humanoid rises as a Haze Husk 24 hours after death. It rises as a Haze Wight if it had at least six class levels or Hit Dice. Raising a creature from the dead reduces its contamination by one level.
Monstrous Transformation. At level 6 or higher, the creature transforms after one round. Replace its statistics, hit points, and Hit Dice with those of a monster the GM chooses. Contamination resets to 0, and the GM controls the transformed creature.
Wish or similar magic can restore one transformed creature, clearing its madness and contamination. Using Wish this way gives the caster a 33 percent chance of losing the ability to cast it again.

Blindsight (Ex). In samples with this ability, detect foes within 120 ft. Beyond that range, treat the animator as blinded.

gm.title: Template
lines: Animate a nonmagical base object using the animated object rules and change its type to Undead. Change its Hit Dice to d12s. Keep its speed, attacks, damage, saves, special attacks, qualities, and hardness. Add +2 deflection AC. Increase Strength by 2, with size adjustments as appropriate. Typical mental scores are Int 15, Wis 12, Cha 12. Base skills are Bluff +10, Hide +5, Intimidate +10, Listen +5, Search +7, Sense Motive +10, Spot +5. Apply size and Dexterity to Hide, and adjust skills for size and level as needed. Add Improved Initiative and Iron Will, plus Power Attack for more powerful animators.

gm.title: Ward and weaknesses
lines:
Ward (Su). An animator feeds on negative emotions produced by its ward and need not follow the ward’s orders. At more than 60 ft. from the ward, or when the ward goes more than a day without these emotions, it loses 1 Cha per day. Normal recovery resumes after rejoining its ward or finding another.
Outside an object it is naturally invisible and incorporeal. Invisibility purge does not cancel the natural invisibility. It cannot possess a magical object or an object under a spell. A successful melee touch with dispel evil expels it. Neither expulsion nor ordinary destruction of the host harms it. Soul bind or trap the soul can imprison it indefinitely. Turn or rebuke it as an 8 HD undead. To destroy it, trap it magically in the object, such as in an antimagic field, then destroy the object while it remains trapped.

lines:

lines:

It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Any creature can use an action to wipe acid off itself or another creature it can reach.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Earth Eruption. When it is burrowing within 10 ft. of the surface, the ankheg can rise without spending movement into a 10-ft. square directly above it. The square becomes difficult terrain. A creature can use an action to free itself or another creature within reach. On a success, the creature moves 5 ft. into an unoccupied space of its own choice.

gm.title: Reactions

gm.title: Villain Actions

lines: The hag pulls out one of her iron teeth or nails and takes 1 minute to shape it into a coin, ring, or tiny mirror. She and its holder can whisper to each other while on the same plane and within 10 miles. They hear only each other’s voice through the token. She can have up to three active tokens. As an action she can sense the direction and approximate distance of each one. She can deactivate one at any distance without an action, leaving an ordinary object.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
Optional for a powerful hag. Grandmothers usually have three to five lair actions, and powerful aunties usually have at most one. Use one on initiative count 20, losing ties, and avoid repeating the same effect two rounds in a row. A required save uses the hag’s highest save DC unless the option specifies a different one.
Pass Through Surfaces. The hag can move through solid doors, walls, floors, and ceilings until initiative count 20 of the next round.
Doors and Windows. The hag opens or closes as many doors and windows as she can see. She can magically lock a closed opening until she unlocks it or opens it with this action. A creature can force it open with a DC 20 Strength check.
Caustic Smoke. Fill a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered on a visible point within 120 ft. with black smoke until initiative count 20 of the next round. The smoke heavily obscures creatures and objects in or behind it. A creature takes 10 (3d6) acid damage if it enters the smoke for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose effects to suit the hag’s power. A lair usually has three to five. A grandmother’s, auntie’s, or coven’s lair has more dangerous effects than a lone hag’s. Use the hag’s highest save DC for an effect that calls for a save. When the hag dies or abandons her lair, an effect ends immediately or fades over up to 2d10 days.
Generic grandmother effects within 1 mile. Small animals grow unusually abundant. Beasts with Intelligence 2 or lower are charmed and sicced on intruders. Figurines, dolls, and twig charms appear in trees.
Additional Annis Hag effects within 1 mile. Gravel can turn into caltrops along 100-ft. stretches. Rockslides can block trails or bury intruders, who are restrained and must hold their breath until freed. Laughter sometimes carries from nowhere. Cairns may hold old bones, lie empty, or draw skeletons, specters, or hostile Fey.

lines: The hag pulls out one of her iron teeth or nails and takes 1 minute to shape it into a coin, ring, or tiny mirror. She and its holder can whisper to each other while on the same plane and within 10 miles. They hear only each other’s voice through the token. She can have up to three active tokens. As an action she can sense the direction and approximate distance of each one. She can deactivate one at any distance without an action, leaving an ordinary object.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
Optional for a powerful hag. Grandmothers usually have three to five lair actions, and powerful aunties usually have at most one. Use one on initiative count 20, losing ties, and avoid repeating the same effect two rounds in a row. A required save uses the hag’s highest save DC unless the option specifies a different one.
Pass Through Surfaces. The hag can move through solid doors, walls, floors, and ceilings until initiative count 20 of the next round.
Doors and Windows. The hag opens or closes as many doors and windows as she can see. She can magically lock a closed opening until she unlocks it or opens it with this action. A creature can force it open with a DC 20 Strength check.
Caustic Smoke. Fill a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered on a visible point within 120 ft. with black smoke until initiative count 20 of the next round. The smoke heavily obscures creatures and objects in or behind it. A creature takes 10 (3d6) acid damage if it enters the smoke for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose effects to suit the hag’s power. A lair usually has three to five. A grandmother’s, auntie’s, or coven’s lair has more dangerous effects than a lone hag’s. Use the hag’s highest save DC for an effect that calls for a save. When the hag dies or abandons her lair, an effect ends immediately or fades over up to 2d10 days.
Generic grandmother effects within 1 mile. Small animals grow unusually abundant. Beasts with Intelligence 2 or lower are charmed and sicced on intruders. Figurines, dolls, and twig charms appear in trees.
Additional Annis Hag effects within 1 mile. Gravel can turn into caltrops along 100-ft. stretches. Rockslides can block trails or bury intruders, who are restrained and must hold their breath until freed. Laughter sometimes carries from nowhere. Cairns may hold old bones, lie empty, or draw skeletons, specters, or hostile Fey.

gm.title: Shared Spellcasting
lines:
All three hags must be within 30 ft. of one another. Each casts as a 12th-level Intelligence-based spellcaster (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). The three hags spend slots from one shared pool. Innate Spellcasting uses its own daily limits.
Level 1 (4 slots). False Life, Inflict Wounds.
Level 2 (3 slots). Gentle Repose, Ray of Enfeeblement.
Level 3 (3 slots). Animate Dead, Revivify, Speak with Dead.
Level 4 (3 slots). Blight, Death Ward.
Level 5 (2 slots). Contagion, Raise Dead.
Level 6 (1 slot). Circle of Death.

gm.title: Hag Eye mechanics
lines: A coven can keep one Hag Eye at a time. A hag can spend an action to see through it while on the same plane. The eye has AC 10, 1 HP, and darkvision 60 ft. If it is destroyed, each coven member takes 3d10 psychic damage and is blinded for 24 hours. All three hags must perform the 1-hour crafting ritual together and none of them can be blinded. Taking an unrelated action during it forces them to restart.

gm.title: Description
lines: The Wilderkith's dryad leader keeps her tree hidden inside Gemhollow and fights by shifting the ground beneath her enemies.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saving throws Dex +5, Wis +8, Cha +9. Nature +8, Perception +8, Stealth +8. Immune to poison damage and to Charmed, Frightened, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 18. Common, Elvish, Sylvan.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Wilderkith, pp. 367–369. Stat block and party action, p. 369.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Supernatural Resistance. Anthracia has advantage on saves against spells, powers, and other supernatural effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Stone Touch and Missile Thorn. Anthracia can also use Tree Teleport if available.
Stone Touch. Melee spell attack +9, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (3d8) necrotic damage. On a failed DC 17 Constitution save the target is Restrained and can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns. If reduced to 0 HP by this attack, it stabilizes and is Petrified into a stone tree. A Cure Ailment power of 4th order or higher, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect ends the petrification.
Missile Thorn. Ranged spell attack +9, range 90 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d6) piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Tree Teleport (3/day, 5th-level spell). Touch a living tree and teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of a second living tree no more than 500 ft. away. Both trees must be Medium or larger.
Wall of Poison (1/day). Center an opaque wall of poison gas on a visible point within 150 ft. It can be up to 50 ft. long, 15 ft. high, and 5 ft. thick. Its area is heavily obscured for 1 minute. Each creature in it when it appears or entering it for the first time on a turn makes a DC 17 Constitution save. It takes 26 (4d12) poison damage on a failure or half on a success. Creatures that need no air automatically succeed. Wind of at least 10 mph disperses it after 4 rounds and wind of at least 20 mph disperses it after 1 round.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Sudden Quake. When an enemy moves within 15 ft. of Anthracia, every creature within 15 ft. of her makes a DC 17 Dexterity save or falls Prone.

gm.title: Villain Party Action
lines:
The Wilderkith can take one party action per round after an enemy's turn. Each action is available once per encounter, in any order, and its actor must be present and able to act.
Action 1, Liquid Earth. Each creature within 60 ft. of Anthracia makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. A target can choose to fail. She can move each creature that fails up to 15 ft. horizontally.

gm.title: Actions
lines:

Discordant Song. Aphemia sings magically. Each humanoid within 120 ft. makes a DC 14 Wisdom save or becomes frightened of Aphemia until her song ends. While she sings, frightened creatures take 7 (2d6) psychic damage at the start of their turns. Each frightened creature can repeat the save at the end of its turns to end the effect. A successful save or the end of the effect grants immunity to Aphemia's Discordant Song for 24 hours.
Grave Calling Song. Aphemia sings magically. Each undead within 300 ft. must pass a DC 14 Wisdom save or fall under Aphemia's control until the song ends.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Continue singing. Aphemia must spend a bonus action on subsequent turns to keep either song going. As part of the same bonus action for Grave Calling Song, she can give mental orders to the undead it controls. She may stop singing at any time. A song also ends if she is incapacitated or dies.

gm.title: Description
lines: Once one of Nylea's dryads, Arasta now nests in the hollow of Enorasi, a vast olive tree in the Nessian Wood.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Armor of Spiders (Mythic Trait, recharges after a short or long rest). When Arasta drops to 0 HP, she stays conscious and alive. She regains 200 HP, and her spiders cover her body and grant 100 temporary HP. While she retains temporary HP from this trait, her mythic actions are available.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Arasta can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. The creature has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Spider Climb. Arasta can climb difficult surfaces and ceilings upside down without making an ability check.
Web Walker. Webbing does not hinder Arasta's movement.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claws attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage. The target also makes a DC 21 Constitution save, taking 32 (5d12) poison damage on a failure or half on a success. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 HP, it stabilizes and is poisoned for 1 hour, even if it recovers HP. It is paralyzed while poisoned this way.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage.
Web of Hair (Recharge 4–6). Fill a 30-ft. cube adjacent to Arasta with webbing for 1 minute. The cube is lightly obscured and difficult terrain. A creature that moves into the web or starts its turn there makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. On a failure, it is restrained while in the web. A creature can use its action to attempt a DC 21 Strength check to free itself or a creature within 5 ft. restrained by this web. Only magical fire can damage the web. A 5-ft. cube burns away if it takes at least 20 magical fire damage on one turn.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Arasta has 3 legendary actions. Use one option at the end of another creature's turn. She recovers spent actions at the start of her turn.
Claws (1 action). Make one Claws attack.
Swarm (2 actions). Summon two swarms of spiders in unoccupied spaces within 5 ft. of Arasta.
Toxic Web (3 actions). Each creature restrained by her Web of Hair takes 18 (4d8) poison damage.

gm.title: Mythic actions
lines:
These options spend legendary actions and are available only while Arasta retains temporary HP from Armor of Spiders.
Swipe (1 action). Make two Claws attacks.
Web of Hair (2 actions). Recharge and use Web of Hair.
Nyx Weave (2 actions). Each creature restrained by Web of Hair must pass a DC 21 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 26 (4d12) force damage and any spells of 6th level or lower affecting it end.

gm.title: Mythic encounter
lines: If Arasta uses Armor of Spiders, award 66,000 XP total for defeating her. This is equivalent to defeating two CR 21 creatures.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
At initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one of the following options. The same option cannot be used in successive rounds.
Read the Web. Each creature restrained by a web or by Web of Hair makes a DC 21 Intelligence save. For each failure, Arasta learns the creature's name, race, what it considers home, and why it came to her web.
Giant Insect. Arasta casts Giant Insect on spiders only. It lasts until she uses this lair option again or dies.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
One or both of these effects can shape the area within 1 mile of Arasta's lair.
Spiders and insects spy for Arasta. Birds and other flying creatures vanish from the skies, although some turn up trapped in webs.
Webs fill 10-ft. cubes of open space wherever two solid surfaces can anchor them. They burn away in 1 round when exposed to fire. Destroyed webs magically repair themselves at the next dawn.
On Arasta's death, the spiders and insects lose their link to her. The webs dissolve within 1d10 days.

lines: A fox-headed yugoloth mage uses a magic tome to imprison creatures.

lines:
Fiendish Restoration. If this yugoloth dies outside Gehenna, its body dissolves into ichor. It returns immediately in a new body at full HP in Gehenna.
Magic Resistance. The fiend has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Soul Tome. Holding or carrying this book allows the arcanaloth to use Banishing Claw. The tome has AC 17 and 35 HP, and is immune to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage. On a failure, the tome traps the target in a demiplane and it is Incapacitated there. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. A success frees it into its former space or the nearest unoccupied space if that spot is occupied. If it fails three saves while inside the demiplane, escape requires reducing the tome to 0 HP.

lines: Natural armor. Saving throw Con +7. Resists acid, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. gm.title: Traits
lines:
Antimagic Lethargy. In an Antimagic Field its speed is halved and it cannot take reactions. When targeted by Dispel Magic, it must pass a Wisdom save against the caster’s spell save DC or lose its reactions for 1 minute.
Arcane Tracker. Coming within 30 ft. of a creature or object affected by magic lets it track that target unerringly for 24 hours.
Explosive Enhancement. Hitting the swarm with a mundane melee weapon charges the weapon for 1 minute, giving it a cumulative +1 bonus to damage rolls. At +3 the weapon explodes and is destroyed, dealing 10 (3d6) force damage to its wielder.
False Appearance. While motionless it passes for a puddle of muck.
Swarm. It can share space with a creature and fit through a 1-inch opening without squeezing. It cannot regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

gm.title: Description
lines: An ancient hag whose curses spread beyond her lair. Choose what she hates most before an encounter. That anathema determines where the characters can kill her.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (4/day, or 5/day in its lair). On a failed saving throw, the hag can spend one use to succeed.
Magic Resistance. The hag has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Spiteful Escape. At 0 HP, the hag dies if she is within 30 ft. of her anathema, the thing she hates most as chosen by the DM. Outside that range she drops to 1 HP, teleports to a harmless demiplane, and cannot return to the plane she left for 2d6 days. Every creature within 60 ft. of the space she left becomes cursed. Each cursed creature has Disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws. The hag knows each cursed creature's location anywhere in the multiverse until its curse ends.

gm.title: Coven Magic
lines: While within 30 ft. of at least two allied hags, she can cast Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, or Unseen Servant. Use each spell's normal casting time, omit Material components, and use Intelligence with spell save DC 19. Each spell recovers its use after a Long Rest.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Spectral Claw attacks and use Crackling Wave.
Spectral Claw. Melee or ranged attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft. A hit deals 17 (3d6 + 7) Force damage. A Large or smaller creature hit also falls Prone.
Crackling Wave. Every creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 22 Dexterity save. Failure deals 32 (5d12) Lightning damage. Success halves the damage. Either outcome curses the creature until the end of the hag's next turn. The creature cannot take Reactions while this curse lasts.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Cast one listed spell as an action, using Charisma (spell save DC 22) and omitting Material components.
At will. Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Dispel Magic, Hypnotic Pattern.
2/day each. Mass Suggestion, Modify Memory, Plane Shift.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Witch Strike. Every creature within 60 ft. that the hag has cursed takes 14 (4d6) Lightning damage.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Tongue Twister. Cast Counterspell on its normal trigger using Charisma (save DC 22). If the target fails its save, it becomes cursed until the end of its next turn. While this curse lasts it cannot cast spells with Verbal components, and its speech expresses the opposite of what it means.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
3 uses, or 4 in the hag's lair. Spend one immediately after another creature's turn to select one option. The hag recovers spent uses at the start of her turn and cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Hag's Swipe. Make one Spectral Claw attack.
Malicious Magic. Use Spellcasting to cast Dimension Door or Hypnotic Pattern. This option is unavailable again until the start of the hag's next turn.

gm.title: In its lair
lines: 41,000 XP. Legendary Resistance increases to 5/day and Legendary Actions increase to 4 uses.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Lapsus Linguae. Within 1 mile of the lair, creatures other than the hag and her allies subtract 1d10 from ability checks made as part of the Influence action.
Meddlesome Magic. When a creature other than the hag or an ally finishes a Long Rest within 1 mile of the lair, its next spell cast with a spell slot also casts Confusion centered on that creature. Confusion uses the creature's spellcasting ability and requires no Concentration.
Both effects end immediately when the arch-hag is destroyed or relocates her lair.

gm.title: Description
lines: A guardian of wild places who can fight with wildfire or assume the form of a beast or elemental.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Staff or Wildfire attacks. The archdruid can replace one attack with Spellcasting.
Staff. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) poison damage.
Wildfire. Ranged spell attack, +9 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 26 (6d6 + 5) fire damage and blinds the target until the start of the archdruid's next turn.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one spell using Wisdom (spell save DC 17).
At will. Beast Sense, Entangle, Speak with Animals.
3/day each. Animal Messenger, Dominate Beast, Faerie Fire, Tree Stride.
1/day each. Commune with Nature (cast as an action), Mass Cure Wounds.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Change Shape (2/day). Magically assume the form of a Beast or Elemental of CR 6 or lower for up to 9 hours. Choose whether equipment falls, merges into the form, or remains worn. Use the new form's statistics except that the archdruid retains its current and maximum hit points, this bonus action, the languages it knows and the ability to speak, and Spellcasting. Attacks in the new form count as magical against resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks. The archdruid reverts when it dies or falls unconscious, or can revert as a bonus action.

gm.title: Favored shapes
lines: Choose an eligible form or roll 1d8. 1 Air Elemental, 2 Earth Elemental, 3 Fire Elemental, 4 Giant Crocodile, 5 Mammoth, 6 Flail Snail, 7 Triceratops, 8 Water Elemental.

gm.title: Description
lines: A guardian of the natural wonders in its domain, often supported by druidic students and loyal beasts or fey.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A practiced nature spellcaster, often shown with simple traveling gear and a scimitar.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Change Shape (2/day). The archdruid magically takes the form of a Beast or Elemental of CR 6 or lower for up to 9 hours. Choose whether its gear drops, merges with the form, or remains worn. It reverts if it dies or falls unconscious, and it can revert as a bonus action on its turn.
In the new form, replace its AC, movement modes, Strength, and Dexterity with the form's values. It retains its other statistics and can still speak. Add the form's special senses, proficiencies, traits, actions, and reactions that the archdruid lacks. Exclude class features, legendary actions, and lair actions. It can cast spells with verbal or somatic components in the form, and the form's attacks count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
The archdruid is an 18th-level druid spellcaster using Wisdom (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Druidcraft, Mending, Poison Spray, Produce Flame.
1st level (4 slots). Cure Wounds, Entangle, Faerie Fire, Speak with Animals.
2nd level (3 slots). Animal Messenger, Beast Sense, Hold Person.
3rd level (3 slots). Conjure Animals, Meld into Stone, Water Breathing.
4th level (3 slots). Dominate Beast, Locate Creature, Stoneskin, Wall of Fire.
5th level (3 slots). Commune with Nature, Mass Cure Wounds, Tree Stride.
6th level (1 slot). Heal, Heroes' Feast, Sunbeam.
7th level (1 slot). Fire Storm.
8th level (1 slot). Animal Shapes.
9th level (1 slot). Foresight.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dagger. Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. Archmages are powerful (and usually quite old) spellcasters dedicated to the study of the arcane arts. Benevolent ones counsel kings and queens, while evil ones rule as tyrants and pursue lichdom. Those who are neither good nor evil sequester themselves in remote towers to practice their magic without interruption. An archmage typically has one or more apprentice mages, and an archmage’s abode has numerous magical wards and guardians to discourage interlopers.

gm.title: Variant: Familiar
lines: The sidebar says a spellcaster who can cast Find Familiar is likely to have a familiar. Choose a form listed in the spell or another Tiny monster, such as a Crawling Claw, Imp, Pseudodragon, or Quasit. For this encounter, the DM chooses the form and can place the familiar with the caster at the start. Use the chosen creature's profile for its statistics. The sidebar leaves the bond mechanics open. The DM can use Find Familiar or the creature's own independent familiar trait, if it has one. The sidebar leaves the caster's prepared spells and challenge rating as printed. Decide separately whether it can cast Find Familiar during play.

gm.title: Description
lines: An armored embodiment of strict law, often riding a winged felidar over the Azorius guildhall.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Immortal Nature. The archon needs no food, drink, or sleep.
Mount. While the archon is mounted and not incapacitated, it cannot be surprised. It and its mount have advantage on Dexterity saving throws. If the mounted archon reaches 0 HP, its mount also drops to 0 HP.

gm.title: Innate Spellcasting
lines:
Wisdom is the spellcasting ability (save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). No material components are required.
At will. Calm Emotions, Command, Compelled Duel.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Hammer of Justice attacks.
Hammer of Justice. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning and 18 (4d8) force damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 18 Strength save or fall prone.
Pacifying Presence. Choose any number of creatures the archon can see within 120 ft. On a failed DC 18 Wisdom save, a target drops held weapons, loses concentration, and becomes charmed by the archon for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. A creature that succeeds on the save or recovers from the effect is immune to this archon’s Pacifying Presence for 24 hours.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines:
Eye of the Law. Choose a visible creature within 120 ft. to learn which laws it broke in the past 24 hours.
Mount. While unmounted, the archon can magically teleport with all worn and carried equipment into the saddle of its mount if both are on the same plane.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The archon has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn.
Rejoin Mount (1 action). If unmounted, magically teleport onto its mount and mount it, provided both are on the same plane.
Smite (2 actions). Make a Hammer of Justice attack. Its mount can then spend its reaction to make a melee weapon attack.
Detention (3 actions). Choose a visible creature within 60 ft. On a failed DC 18 Charisma save, the target is magically sent to a harmless demiplane. At the end of the archon’s next turn, it reappears where it left or in the nearest unoccupied space.

gm.title: Description
lines: A bird of living lightning. Its death leaves a warm mizzium egg that can hatch when fed magic.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, restrained, unconscious.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Elemental Nature. The phoenix needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach does not provoke an opportunity attack.
Grounded Lightning. The first time it touches the ground on any turn, the phoenix takes 11 (2d10) force damage.
Illumination. It sheds bright light for 15 ft. and dim light for another 15 ft.
Lightning Form. The phoenix fits through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. A creature that touches it or hits it in melee from within 5 ft. takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage. The phoenix can enter a hostile creature’s space and stop there. The first time the phoenix enters any given creature’s space on a turn, that creature takes the same lightning damage.
Crackling Death. When the phoenix dies, each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 18 Dexterity save, taking 36 (8d8) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. Only a warm Tiny egg with a mizzium shell remains. A spell that deals lightning damage hatches it if the egg is in the spell’s area. A creature touching the egg can also hatch it by spending spell slots totaling at least 13 levels. The new phoenix appears in the egg’s space.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Arclight Touch. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 27 (6d8) lightning damage. Lightning then jumps to a second creature of the phoenix’s choice that it can see within 30 ft. of the first target. The second creature takes 27 (6d8) lightning damage on a failed DC 18 Dexterity save.

gm.title: Recoverable Magic Item
lines:
Bracers of the Spellbreaker. Very rare. Spellcaster attunement required. The wearer has advantage on saves against spells and magical effects, and their spell attacks bypass damage resistance.
Cursed Sentience. The item uses its Soulbinder's alignment, mental ability scores, and languages. It hears and sees in darkness within 60 ft. and can speak to its wearer telepathically. Break attunement with Remove Curse or equivalent magic. After seven days attuned and every 24 hours after that, make a DC 18 Wisdom save. Each failure reduces Wisdom by 1 while attuned. On the third failure, the Soulbinder takes control and changes the wearer's body, statistics, and equipment to match its own. The wearer remains aware. Breaking attunement restores the body and control. The Soulbinder returns to the item when attunement ends or the body dies. After 1d6 + 12 months of possession, the victim's soul and body are destroyed. The full group ritual for permanently lifting the curse is on p. 382.

gm.title: Description
lines: A former Harper who travels Chult with Dragonbait. He seeks the vanished city of Mezro and his wife Alisanda, keeping the Ring of Winter out of hostile hands.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Cold, while attuned to and wearing the Ring of Winter.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Special Equipment. Divination cannot target Artus or the Ring of Winter, and magical scrying sensors cannot perceive either. While attuned to and wearing the ring, Artus does not age or suffer extreme cold. Bookmark is his +3 Dagger.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Bookmark or Longbow.
Bookmark (+3 Dagger). Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Ring of Winter. With the ring worn and attuned, spend charges to use its powers. It holds 12 charges and restores all at dawn.
Lower Temperature (1 charge). Center a 120-ft.-radius sphere on a visible point within 300 ft. The area cools by 20°F per minute to −30°F. Frost and ice form below 32°F. The change lasts until Artus uses an action with the ring to end it. The area then warms back to its normal temperature at 10°F per minute.
Ring spells (spell save DC 17). Bigby’s Hand (2), Cone of Cold (2), Flesh to Stone (3), Ice Storm (2), Otiluke’s Freezing Sphere (3), Sleet Storm (1), Spike Growth (1), or Wall of Ice (2). Bigby’s Hand is ice, immune to cold, and its Clenched Fist deals bludgeoning damage. Flesh to Stone instead turns the target into solid ice with the properties of stone. The spikes in Spike Growth are ice.
Create Ice (2 or 4 charges). For 2 charges, make a nonmoving ice object that fits within a 10-ft. cube and is as durable and dense as metal or stone, as Artus chooses. For 4, make an animated ice creature modeled on a Beast of CR 2 or lower. It uses that creature’s statistics but is a Construct, is vulnerable to fire, is immune to cold and poison damage, and cannot be charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, or suffer exhaustion. It follows only Artus’s commands.
The ice object or creature appears in an empty space within 60 ft. It becomes water after 24 hours or at 0 HP. In extreme heat it loses 5 (1d10) HP per minute. Use the Dungeon Master’s Guide object rules for the object’s HP.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines:
Bookmark. While attuned and holding the drawn dagger, activate one feature as a bonus action.
Light. Turn the pommel gem on or off. It sheds bright light to 20 ft. and dim light for another 20 ft.
Compass. Lay Bookmark on Artus’s palm to make it point north.
Dimension Door. Cast it from Bookmark. This property recharges at dawn.
Compulsion. Cast it from Bookmark (save DC 15, range 90 ft.). It targets only spiders of the Beast type. This property recharges at dawn.

gm.title: Encounter
lines: Artus is looking for the Guardian Naga Saja N’baza at Orolunga. He does not know where Omu is, but will set aside the search for Mezro to help characters who explain why they seek the Soulmonger.

lines:
