Summon Air Elemental. Five aarakocra must stay within 30 ft. of one another and each spend their action and movement on an aerial dance for three consecutive turns. Each must maintain Concentration as if on a spell. Once all five complete the dance, an Air Elemental appears in an empty space within 60 ft. of the group, is friendly toward them, and follows spoken orders. It stays for 1 hour, until it dies, all its summoners die, or any summoner dismisses it as a bonus action. Each participant must finish a short rest before performing the dance again. When the elemental returns to the Elemental Plane of Air, any aarakocra within 5 ft. of it may go along.

gm.title: Dance of the Seven Winds
lines: This 10-minute ritual requires an aarakocra elder, seven other aarakocra to chant without interruption, and a black orchid. Asharra grinds and inhales the orchid, then dances around up to ten creatures that cannot fly. Her wings disappear when the rite ends and each recipient gains a magical fly speed of 30 ft., enough to travel 4 miles per hour. After three days the recipients lose the flight and Asharra regains her wings and flying speed.

gm.title: Encounter context
lines: Asharra offers the rite to travelers heading to Omu to destroy the Soulmonger. She directs them to find the orchid in Nangalore, whose Eblis have kept her people away. Kir Sabal also shelters Mwaxanaré and Na.

gm.title: Description
lines: Necromancers use this spiked construct to retrieve corpses for their work.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Immune to necrotic and poison damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Understands the languages of its creator but cannot speak.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Corpse Carrier. Start with 6 corpses or roll 1d6 + 3. Corpse Bomb and Create Zombies spend these corpses.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Arm attacks. If both hit the same creature, the hoarder can use Impale on that creature.
Arm. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, chosen by the hoarder.
Impale. One Large or smaller creature the hoarder sees within 10 ft. makes a DC 17 Strength save. On a failure, the creature takes 16 (3d10) piercing damage and becomes Restrained. At the start of each of its turns, it takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage. If this damage reduces it to 0 HP, it dies and joins the corpse supply. A creature can use an action and pass a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check to free itself or someone it can reach. Destroying the hoarder releases everyone it has impaled.
Corpse Bomb. Hurl and destroy one corpse up to 60 ft. away. Creatures in a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered on it make a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure, they take 33 (6d10) necrotic damage and cannot regain HP until the start of the hoarder's next turn. On a success, they take half damage.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Create Zombies. Drop any number of carried corpses. Each becomes a zombie in an unoccupied space within 10 ft. and acts immediately after the hoarder.

gm.title: Dazed (MCDM)
lines: On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses one of these options: move, take an action, or take a bonus action. If it becomes Dazed during its turn, its turn ends. Extra actions from effects such as Haste and Action Surge still apply. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect can end this condition.

gm.title: Description
lines: These fallen archons fled to the Underworld when their empires collapsed. They return on winged mounts and show little mercy to the heroes who stand in their way.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Aura of Silence. When a creature the rider can see starts its turn within 30 ft., the rider can require a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a failure, the creature is deafened and can't speak until the start of its next turn. A creature that succeeds is immune to this aura for 24 hours.
Mount. While mounted and not incapacitated, the rider can't be surprised, and the rider and mount have advantage on Dexterity saves. If the rider drops to 0 HP while mounted, its mount drops to 0 HP too.

gm.title: Innate Spellcasting
lines:
Wisdom is the spellcasting ability (save DC 18). No material components are required.
At will. Command, Compelled Duel.
1/day each. Banishment, Blade Barrier.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Ashen Blade attacks or two Bolt of Ash attacks.
Ashen Blade. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 13 (2d12) radiant damage.
Bolt of Ash. Ranged spell attack, +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. A hit deals 22 (4d10) necrotic damage and prevents the target from regaining HP until the start of the rider's next turn.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Mount. While unmounted and on the same plane as its mount, the rider can magically teleport onto the mount with everything it wears or carries.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The rider has 3 legendary actions and regains them at the start of its turn. It can use just one option at the end of another creature's turn.
Attack (1 action). Make one Ashen Blade or Bolt of Ash attack.
Coordinated Assault (2 actions). Make one Ashen Blade or Bolt of Ash attack. Then the mount can use its reaction to make one melee weapon attack.
Reduce to Ash (3 actions). A creature the rider can see within 60 ft. makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 27 (5d10) necrotic damage, and its HP maximum drops by the necrotic damage taken until it finishes a long rest. At a maximum of 0 HP, the creature and all its worn or carried gear except magic items turn to ash. Only Wish can revive it.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Atonement (3/day). Ashyra can turn a failed saving throw into a success. She then ends Ancient Curse on one enemy within 120 ft. or becomes Dazed until the end of her next turn.
Mummy Dust. When Ashyra takes piercing or slashing damage, every creature within 5 ft. takes 9 (2d8) poison damage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Desiccating Slam and Soul Fire, then use Ancient Curse.
Desiccating Slam. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. Until the start of Ashyra's next turn, the target's speed is 0 and it cannot regain HP.
Soul Fire (3rd-level spell). Ranged spell attack, +9 to hit, 60-ft. range, one target. Hit 20 (3d10 + 4) radiant damage. A creature's HP maximum also drops by the damage taken until it finishes a long rest or receives Cure Ailment of 4th order or higher, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect. The creature dies if its HP maximum reaches 0.
Ancient Curse. One creature Ashyra sees within 120 ft. must pass a DC 17 Wisdom save or its attacks deal half damage. The curse lasts until she ends it or it is lifted by Cure Ailment, Remove Curse, or similar supernatural magic.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Misty Step (2nd-level spell). Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Weight of Ages. When a creature Ashyra sees within 60 ft. damages her, it must pass a DC 17 Strength save or become Restrained until the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Villain Actions
lines:

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Platinum Brilliance (recharges after a short or long rest). When the creature would drop to 0 HP, set its current HP to 500, recharge Breath Weapon, and restore all spent uses of Legendary Resistance. gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite, one Claw, and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +19 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (2d12 + 10) piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) force damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (2d10 + 10) slashing damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 20) and restrained until the grapple ends. The aspect can hold only one creature with this attack at a time.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (2d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 27 Strength save or fall prone.
Breath Weapon (recharge 5–6). Choose Exalting Breath or Platinum Breath.
Exalting Breath. The aspect chooses creatures in a 300-ft. cone. Chosen living creatures regain 71 (13d10) HP. Chosen creatures dead for no more than 1 hour return to life with all their HP.
Platinum Breath. Each creature in a 300-ft. cone makes a DC 26 Dexterity save, taking 66 (12d10) radiant damage on a failure or half on a success.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Change Shape. Magically take the form of any Humanoid or Beast, keeping the aspect’s statistics except size. The form ends if the aspect drops to 0 HP or spends a bonus action to end it.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The creature has 3 legendary actions. It can take one option at the end of another creature’s turn and regains spent actions at the start of its turn.
Attack (1 action). Make one Claw or Tail attack.
Furious Bite (2 actions). Make one Bite attack. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 27 Wisdom save or be frightened of the aspect until the end of its own next turn.

gm.title: Mythic actions
lines:
For 1 hour after Platinum Brilliance activates, the aspect can spend legendary actions on these options.
Celestial Shield (2 actions). Seven spectral ancient gold dragons protect the aspect, giving him 77 temporary HP until the start of his next turn.
Celestial Lances (3 actions). Pick four different points on the ground the aspect can see within 150 ft. Each creature in a 20-ft.-radius, 100-ft.-high cylinder centered on a point must succeed on a DC 27 Dexterity save or take 24 (7d6) force damage. Resolve the save once per creature, even where cylinders overlap.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A mountain-sized elemental body of molten rock and open flame.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Wisdom saves +6. Resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons. gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). On a failed save, the aspect can choose to succeed.
Molten Skin. A creature takes 11 (2d10) fire damage if it touches the aspect, attacks the aspect in melee from within 5 ft., or ends its turn within 5 ft. Flammable objects within 5 ft. ignite.
Natural Light. Bright light extends 60 ft. from the aspect and dim light extends another 60 ft.
Cooling. Taking at least 50 cold damage in one round reduces the aspect’s speed to 0 until the end of its next turn.
Fuel for the Fire. Plant life does not slow its movement as difficult terrain. If it starts a turn occupying plants that provide cover, it burns away the plants in its occupied spaces and regains 1d4 HP per 5-ft. square consumed. Regaining at least 17 HP this way recharges Magma Throw.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Molten Fist attacks.
Molten Fist. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit for 16 (2d10 + 5) fire damage.

Magma Throw (Recharge 5–6). Choose a point within 60 ft. Each creature within 15 ft. of that point makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 22 (4d10) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines:
The aspect has three legendary actions and recovers spent actions at the start of its turn. It can use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn.
Detect. Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Molten Fist. Make one Molten Fist attack.
Magma Barrage (costs 2 actions). Use Magma Throw. Table ruling. If Magma Throw has yet to recharge, the aspect can take 17 cold damage to use it anyway.

lines: Scorched Grove finale. Only the southern tree cover can fuel the aspect in this scene. It gains Rekindle and regains 10 HP if it starts its turn at 0 HP. Cold damage that drops it to 0 HP or hits it while at 0 prevents Rekindle on that turn and petrifies it when the turn starts. Petrification lasts an hour. It then returns to full HP. A shattered petrified aspect reassembles in 1d4 rounds, and any pieces still separated when petrification ends have Molten Skin.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The v1.04 Magma Barrage text is ambiguous about its 17 cold damage clause. Fuel for the Fire separately recharges Magma Throw after the aspect heals at least 17 HP from plants.

gm.title: Description
lines: An Astral titan whose eye suppresses magic and whose jaws send swallowed prey to a private demiplane.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, stunned.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Antimagic Cone. Its open eye projects a 150-ft. cone with the effects of Antimagic Field. The dreadnought chooses the direction at the start of each of its turns. The cone stops working if its eye closes or it is blinded.
Astral Entity. The dreadnought cannot leave the Astral Plane. Banishment and other forms of transport cannot move it off the plane.
Demiplanar Donjon. Swallowed things enter an otherwise indestructible demiplane. Only Wish, Bite, or Donjon Visit can get a creature inside. Escape requires magic that enables planar travel, such as Plane Shift. The space resembles a stone cavern about 1,000 ft. across and 100 ft. high, littered with the remains of old meals. Nothing inside can injure the dreadnought. When the dreadnought dies, the demiplane disappears and its contents appear around the corpse.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the dreadnought fails a save, it can spend one use to succeed instead.
Sever Silver Cord. On a critical hit against a creature using Astral Projection, the dreadnought can sever the creature's silver cord in place of dealing damage.
Unusual Nature. The dreadnought needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 36 (5d10 + 9) force damage. The dreadnought swallows a Huge or smaller creature hit if it is incapacitated or if this damage reduces it to 0 hit points. It and its worn and carried gear appear in a free space on the Donjon floor.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d6 + 9) force damage.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
3 actions. Spend the indicated cost on one option at the end of another creature's turn. The creature regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must wait until after its first turn.
Claw (1 action). Make one Claw attack.
Donjon Visit (2 actions). One visible creature of Huge size or smaller within 60 ft. makes a DC 19 Charisma save. On a failure it teleports to an unoccupied space on the Donjon floor. At the end of its next turn, it reappears in the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.
Psychic Projection (3 actions). Every creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 19 Wisdom save, taking 26 (4d10 + 4) psychic damage on a failure or half on a success.

gm.title: Astral Elf society
lines:
Astral elves settled in the Astral Plane to live closer to their gods. They do not age or need sustenance there, and some count their lives in millennia. They often wear ornate visors when meeting outsiders.
Their crews shape Wildspace crystal and hardened plant material into ships such as star moths. Some cities and citadels occupy the petrified bodies of dead gods. Elves travel out of the Deep Astral to raise children and orbit stars to gather starlight for crystal growth and repairs or make pacts with solar dragons.

lines: The atropal attacks creatures that threaten it or the Soulmonger. Killing the atropal brings Acererak to the south balcony. Destroying the Soulmonger ends the death curse and releases its trapped souls. A creature entering the lava by falling into it or starting its turn there takes 55 (10d10) fire damage.

gm.title: Soulmonger
lines: The crystal cylinder is a Huge object (AC 15, 200 HP) vulnerable to radiant damage and immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Any one of its three adamantine struts breaking brings the whole device down. Each strut is a Large object (AC 20, 100 HP) immune to fire, poison, psychic, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. A creature taking damage while standing on a strut must make a DC 10 Dexterity save or fall into the lava unless secured. When a strut breaks, unsecured creatures on it fall. One within reach of a balcony can leap to safety on a successful DC 10 Dexterity save.

gm.title: Soulmonger tentacles
lines: Once per turn, the Soulmonger responds to a melee weapon hit on the cylinder or a strut with one tentacle attack against the attacker. Reach 30 ft., +7 to hit, 24 (4d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. It can grapple in place of damage (escape DC 16). If the grappled creature weighs up to 330 lb., the tentacle can also move it to an empty space within reach or drop it into the lava. Each tentacle is a Huge animated object (Strength 22, AC 15, 30 HP) immune to poison and psychic damage.

gm.title: Heraldic servant rules
lines:
Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.
A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.
Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.
An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.
The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

gm.title: MCDM demon soul rules
lines:
Soul count. Use the printed starting total or roll the listed dice. Souls spent on a feature are deducted from the total. A demon can accumulate souls without a maximum.
Soul Devourer. When the demon drops a creature other than a Construct or Undead to 0 HP, or deals damage to a dying creature, that creature makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On a failure, the demon consumes its soul, adds 1 to its soul count, and the creature dies. Only Wish can restore it to life.
Lethe. At 0 souls, the demon has advantage on attacks and disadvantage on saving throws, and its Intelligence is 3. On each turn it must use its movement to get as close as possible to the nearest creature it senses with Soulsight. If able, it must then use its action to attack that creature and attempt to kill it. It can pursue no other goal until its soul count rises.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A towering reptilian fiend in an open gold robe with a stack of crowns and several clawed hands.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saves Dex +7, Wis +10, Cha +10. Arcana +11, Athletics +12, Deception +10, History +11, Insight +10, Perception +10, Persuasion +10. Resists necrotic, psychic, and bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from mundane attacks. Immune to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed and Stunned. Darkvision 120 ft., Soulsight 30 ft., passive Perception 20. All languages. Telepathy 120 ft.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Abyssal Resistance (2 souls). When Aurumvas fails a save, he can succeed instead.
Soul Weapons. While he has at least 2 souls, his weapon attacks are magical, and allies within 60 ft. deal an extra 5 (1d10) psychic damage with weapon attacks.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Greedy Hands and Covetous Bolt.
Greedy Hands. Melee weapon attack +12, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit 14 (2d6 + 7) bludgeoning plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage. Aurumvas can spend 1 soul to gain temporary HP equal to the psychic damage dealt.
Covetous Bolt. Ranged spell attack +11, range 120 ft., one target. Hit 22 (5d8) force damage. If the target has spell slots, Aurumvas can spend 2 souls to make it expend its highest remaining spell slot without any effect.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Greed Is Good. Choose a visible object within 30 ft. worth at least 100 gp. Aurumvas teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of it.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Absorb Soul. When a demon with at least 1 soul dies within 60 ft. and Aurumvas can see it, he gains 1 soul.

gm.title: Villain Actions
lines:
Each option can be used once per encounter after an enemy’s turn, in any order, at most one per round.
Time Is Money. Each ally Aurumvas can see within 120 ft. moves up to their speed. At the end of this round, Aurumvas rearranges initiative in any order he chooses.
That’s Ours. Choose up to three visible magic items within 30 ft. that need no attunement and are neither legendary nor artifacts. Aurumvas can teleport each into the hands or to the feet of an ally he can see within 30 ft. An enemy wearing or carrying an item can prevent its teleportation by succeeding on a DC 19 Charisma save.
At Any Cost. Choose four different visible points within 120 ft. Aurumvas teleports an explosive Tiny treasure to each point. Every creature within 10 ft. of one or more points makes one DC 19 Dexterity save, taking 33 (6d10) force damage on a failure or half on a success.

gm.title: MCDM demon soul rules
lines:
Soul count. Use the printed starting total or roll the listed dice. Souls spent on a feature are deducted from the total. A demon can accumulate souls without a maximum.
Soul Devourer. When the demon drops a creature other than a Construct or Undead to 0 HP, or deals damage to a dying creature, that creature makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On a failure, the demon consumes its soul, adds 1 to its soul count, and the creature dies. Only Wish can restore it to life.
Lethe. At 0 souls, the demon has advantage on attacks and disadvantage on saving throws, and its Intelligence is 3. On each turn it must use its movement to get as close as possible to the nearest creature it senses with Soulsight. If able, it must then use its action to attack that creature and attempt to kill it. It can pursue no other goal until its soul count rises.
Soulsight. Within the creature’s listed radius, it perceives creatures other than Constructs and Undead. This counts as seeing them for its features. Physical objects, total cover, and supernatural effects do not block this sense unless a rule says they do.

gm.title: Description
lines: A rock gnome builds an autognome in its own likeness, with painted features on a metal shell. Magic gives the machine a mind of its own, and a design flaw can leave it wandering Wildspace without orders.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Malfunction. If the autognome survives taking at least 15 damage from one source, roll a d20.
1–10. It keeps working.
11–12. It is incapacitated for 1 minute.
13–14. An arm drops off. It can make one fewer Shock attack until a creature uses an action to put that arm back on.
15–16. Its head falls off and switches off. It is blinded and deafened until a creature spends an action reattaching and reactivating its head.
17–20. The autognome explodes and is destroyed. Each creature within 20 ft. makes a DC 11 Dexterity save, taking 22 (4d10) slashing damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

gm.title: Actions
lines:

gm.title: Orders
lines: A working autognome follows its maker's orders. Most protect themselves if attacked, defend gnomes against non-gnome attackers, and protect children regardless of species. An autognome might step between a Lunar Dragon Wyrmling and the adults fighting it.

lines: STR +13 · DEX +2 · CON +11 · INT +5 · WIS +13 · CHA +10

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Aura of Hopelessness. A hostile creature that begins its turn within 15 ft. makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure, until its next turn starts, it rolls attacks with disadvantage and gains half as many HP from healing effects. The avatar can exempt any creature without spending an action.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The avatar can turn its failed save into a success.

gm.title: Actions
lines:

Decaying Breath (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 19 Constitution save, taking 54 (12d8) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Plant creatures and magical plants make this save with disadvantage. Use the maximum damage roll against them. Ordinary nonmagical plants in the cone die.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines:
The avatar has three legendary actions per round. It chooses one option at the end of another creature’s turn and refreshes its pool at the start of its own.
Detect. Pinpoint every creature and trap within 30 ft. automatically.
Move. Move up to half speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Void Wave (2 actions). Each creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 19 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and falls Prone. Void taint imposes disadvantage on the save. If a tainted creature fails, it takes another 4 (1d8) necrotic damage per level of void taint. The avatar heals HP equal to that extra damage, then the creature loses all levels of void taint.

gm.title: Encounter reference
lines: Void taint measures exposure to the Void. Use the target’s current levels for Void Wave. See Chapter 7 for the optional taint rules.

lines: Speed · walk 30 ft. (40 ft. in tiger form)

gm.title: Description
lines: A Chultan guide in Port Nyanzaru conceals her ability to take tiger form. She wants the pterafolk at Firefinger to return her family’s wooden tiger mask.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Common. She cannot speak in tiger form.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered. Her immunity does not prevent falling damage.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Shapechanger. As an action, take tiger form, tiger-humanoid hybrid form, or true human form. Statistics otherwise stay the same apart from size and the listed tiger speed. Gear does not change with her. She returns to human form when she dies.
Keen Hearing and Smell. She has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks using hearing or smell.
Pounce (tiger or hybrid). Move at least 15 ft. directly toward a creature, then hit it with Claw during that turn. The target makes a DC 14 Strength save or falls prone. If prone, it can be the target of one bonus-action Bite.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack (human or hybrid). In human form, make two Scimitar or two Longbow attacks. The hybrid can do the same or make two Claw attacks.
Bite (tiger or hybrid). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage. A humanoid target must pass a DC 13 Constitution save or contract weretiger lycanthropy.
Claw (tiger or hybrid). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Scimitar (human or hybrid). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Longbow (human or hybrid). Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

gm.title: Adventure encounter
lines: Azaka guides the party for free if they agree to recover her Mask of the Beast from the pterafolk. She avoids spreading her curse and refuses situations where a fall of more than 60 ft. is likely. At Firefinger she urges an attack under cover of dark or rain. She leaves if the party refuses to attack the pterafolk. See the Firefinger encounter and handout 2.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A crested bat with a bearded chin, white pupil-less eyes, and leathery gray, mauve, or emerald green skin. Its tail ends in a needle-sharp point.

gm.title: Physical attacks mechanics
lines: Bite and tail stab · The bite deals 1 damage and the tail stab deals 1d2.

gm.title: Magic mechanics
lines: Know alignment · Three times per day.
Invisibility · Self only, once per day for up to six rounds. It ends when the Azmyth makes a successful attack.
Silence · Once per day, centered on the Azmyth in a 15-foot radius.
Shocking grasp · Twice per day, direct contact deals 1d8+6 electrical damage. It can be added to a physical attack.

gm.title: Behavior mechanics
lines: Voluntary companionship · Azmyths sometimes form lifelong partnerships with humanoids. The entry distinguishes them from familiars under a wizard’s direct control.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Rare, solitary, and active at any time. Omnivore. High intelligence (13–14). Chaotic neutral. Elite (14) morale. Treasure Nil. 1 appearing.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, January 1994 third printing, pp. 15–16.

gm.title: Description
lines: A spear-wielding demon whose gaze weakens foes who rely on strength.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks. The babau can also use Weakening Gaze before or after those attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

gm.title: Description
lines: An archdevil who frightens nearby foes, bolsters his allies, and regenerates unless exposed to cold or radiant damage.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Dread. A creature other than a devil that starts its turn within 10 ft. of Bael makes a DC 22 Wisdom save. On a failure it is frightened of him until the start of its next turn. It succeeds automatically if Bael chooses to let it or if he is incapacitated.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Bael fails a save, he can spend one use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Bael has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. Bael recovers 20 hit points at the start of his turn. Cold or radiant damage prevents recovery at the start of his next turn. He dies only if he starts his turn at 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Hellish Morningstar attacks.
Hellish Morningstar. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d8 + 7) force damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.
Infernal Command. Each of Bael's allies within 60 ft. cannot be charmed or frightened until the end of Bael's next turn.
Teleport. Bael teleports up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space he can see, taking worn and carried equipment along.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Charisma (spell save DC 21). No material components are required.
At will. Alter Self (can become Medium), Charm Person, Detect Magic, Invisibility, Major Image.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Fly, Suggestion, Wall of Fire.
1/day. Dominate Monster.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
3 actions. Spend the indicated cost on one option at the end of another creature's turn. The creature regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must wait until after its first turn.
Fiendish Magic (1 action). Use Spellcasting or Teleport.
Infernal Command (1 action). Use Infernal Command.
Attack (2 actions). Make one Hellish Morningstar attack.

gm.title: Description
lines: A gaunt yugoloth with a horned, horse-like skull and ember eyes. Baernaloths seek secrets in the Gray Wastes of Hades and prolong the suffering of creatures they capture.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A gaunt gray yugoloth with a horned, horse-skull head and eyes like embers.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold; fire; lightning; necrotic; psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (4/day). Turn a failed save into a success.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Anguishing Bite and one Claw attack. The baernaloth can also use Teleport.
Anguishing Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage. A creature hit cannot regain HP until the start of the baernaloth’s next turn.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing plus 17 (5d6) necrotic damage.
Miasma of Discord (Recharge 5–6). Choose a visible point within 120 ft. for a momentary 20-ft.-radius sphere of vapor. Each non-yugoloth inside makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. Failure deals 35 (10d6) psychic damage and leaves the creature charmed until the end of its next turn. During the charm, it treats allies as foes, and its body and gear turn gray. Success halves the damage and prevents the charm.
Summon Yugoloth (1/day). Roll a 50% chance to summon the baernaloth’s choice of 1d4 Mezzoloths, one Arcanaloth, or one Baernaloth. Each ally appears in an unoccupied spot within 60 ft. and cannot summon other yugoloths. It stays for up to 1 minute, until it or the summoning baernaloth dies, or until the summoner dismisses it as an action.
Teleport. The baernaloth and its gear teleport up to 120 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one spell from the following list using Intelligence (save DC 20), with no material components.
At will. Detect Thoughts, Phantasmal Force, Suggestion.
1/day each. Cloudkill, Plane Shift (self only), Scrying (cast as an action).

gm.title: Reactions
lines:
The baernaloth can take three reactions per round, with a maximum of one per turn.
Afflict Despair. When a visible creature within 60 ft. hits with an attack roll or succeeds on a save, force it to reroll the d20 and keep the new roll.
Inescapable Pain. When another creature damages the baernaloth, that creature makes a DC 19 Constitution save. Failure deals 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. Success halves it.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, after other combatants tied at 20, choose one action. The same action cannot be used in consecutive rounds. In its lair the baernaloth is CR 18 (20,000 XP).
Consume Suffering. Until initiative count 20 next round, whenever another creature in the lair takes necrotic or psychic damage or drops to 0 HP, the baernaloth regains 10 (3d6) HP.
Discover Secrets. Use Spellcasting to cast Detect Thoughts. A target of the spell cast this way also takes 13 (3d8) psychic damage.
Recurring Wound. Choose a visible creature in the lair that is below its HP maximum. It makes a DC 19 Constitution save, taking 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
The lair can produce either or both effects within 10 miles. Both end immediately if the baernaloth dies.
Persistent Anguish. A spell that restores HP or removes the charmed or frightened condition fails and is wasted unless its caster passes a DC 19 save using its spellcasting ability. A caster that succeeds ignores this effect for 24 hours.
Slow Healing. Other creatures regain HP equal to only half their maximum after a long rest. They regain half the usual HP when spending Hit Dice on a short rest.

gm.title: Description
lines: An elderly tabaxi hunter who picks off travelers from the roofs of Omu. He came to find the Navel of the Moon in hopes of locating his missing son.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Feline Agility. When Bag of Nails moves on his turn in combat, he can double his speed until that turn ends. He regains use after a turn when he moves 0 ft.
Assassinate. On his first turn he has advantage against creatures that have yet to act. His hits against surprised creatures are critical hits.
Evasion. When a Dexterity save would halve damage, he takes none on a success and half on a failure.
Sneak Attack (1/turn). Add 14 (4d6) damage to a successful weapon attack if he has advantage. He can also add it if a non-incapacitated ally is within 5 ft. of the target and he lacks disadvantage on the attack.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Shortsword attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 2 (1d4) slashing damage.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. Apply the same poison save and damage as the Shortsword attack.

gm.title: Fallen Tree ambush
lines: Bag of Nails begins hidden on the east bank, 150 ft. from the fallen tree bridge (DC 22 Wisdom (Perception) to spot him). He shoots when someone crosses and tries to hide at a new firing position after each shot. Below 39 HP, he surrenders and invites his enemies into his lair for stew. A successful DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check exposes his intent. The stew contains Midnight Tears. If it has not been neutralized by midnight, the eater makes a DC 17 Constitution save, taking 31 (9d6) poison damage on a failure or half on a success. Five more doses can be found in the lair.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Tomb of Annihilation, p. 102. The Fallen Tree encounter prints changes to the 2014 Assassin, including the claw attack and longbow.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Tentacle attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d10 + 3) piercing damage.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, grapples the target (escape DC 15), and moves it up to 5 ft. toward the balhannoth. The target is restrained until the grapple ends. That tentacle cannot attack another target while the grapple lasts. The balhannoth has four tentacles.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
3 actions. Spend the indicated cost on one option at the end of another creature's turn. The creature regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must wait until after its first turn.
Bite (1 action). Make one Bite attack against a creature it has grappled.
Teleport (1 action). Teleport up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. Its worn and carried equipment and any creatures it has grappled go with it.
Vanish (1 action). Become magically invisible for up to 10 minutes. The effect ends immediately after the balhannoth makes an attack roll.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, after anyone tied at that count, the balhannoth can use one option while in its lair. It cannot choose the same option in consecutive rounds. Using an option requires being in the lair and able to act. If surprised, the creature must finish its first turn before using one.
Teleport. One creature within 500 ft. makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, the balhannoth teleports it and its worn or carried belongings to a free space of the balhannoth's choice within 60 ft. of the balhannoth.
Vanish. One creature within 500 ft. makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, the balhannoth becomes invisible to that creature for 1 minute, or until it attacks that creature.
Warp Terrain. After 10 minutes, an area up to 500 ft. square resembles a location desired by one Humanoid the balhannoth sensed with Sense Desires. Only nonliving material changes. The effect cannot create moving parts or magical properties. Close inspection exposes imitations, such as blank books or fake valuables. The terrain stays changed until the balhannoth dies or uses Warp Terrain again.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
The lair can cause one or more of these effects. All end immediately when the balhannoth dies.
Sense Desires. Within 1 mile of itself, the balhannoth detects the strongest desires of Humanoids and learns whether those desires involve a place, such as a safe place to rest, a temple, or a home.
Supernatural Lure. Creatures within 1 mile of the lair feel close to what they want most. The feeling strengthens as they approach the lair.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Resonant Connection. While carrying a piece of a creature or object, such as a hair or splinter, the banderhobb knows the most direct route to its source if it is within 1 mile.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tongue attack. Shadow Step can replace one of those attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage and grapples a Large or smaller creature (escape DC 16). That creature is restrained until the grapple ends. While it remains grappled, the banderhobb cannot Bite or use Tongue against another target.
Tongue. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. A hit deals 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. On a failed DC 16 Strength save, the target is pulled into a space within 5 ft. of the banderhobb.
Shadow Step. Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space in dim light or darkness.
Swallow. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature the banderhobb has grappled. A hit deals 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage, swallows the creature, and ends the grapple. The creature is blinded and restrained while swallowed, with total cover against attacks and effects from outside the banderhobb. It takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of the banderhobb's turns. If this damage drops it to 0 hit points, the damage stops and the creature becomes stable.
Only one creature can be swallowed at a time. The banderhobb can regurgitate it at any time while not incapacitated, without spending an action. It also regurgitates the creature when it dies. The creature lands prone in a space within 5 ft. of the banderhobb.

gm.title: Actions
lines:

The banderhobb can hold only one swallowed creature. It can expel that creature at any time without an action while free of the incapacitated condition. It also expels the creature if it dies. The creature lands prone in a space within 5 ft. of the banderhobb.

gm.title: Description
lines: The ghost of an elf haunts the place she died. She covets beautiful objects and flies into a rage at the sight of her reflection.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Acid, fire, lightning, and thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Detect Life. The banshee can magically sense creatures within 5 miles, except constructs and undead. She knows their general direction only.
Incorporeal Movement. Creatures and objects count as difficult terrain for her movement. She takes 5 (1d10) force damage if she ends her turn inside an object.
Sorrow Bound. She cannot travel more than 5 miles from where she died.
Undead Nature. She needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Corrupting Touch. Melee spell attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (3d6 + 2) necrotic damage.
Horrifying Visage. Each non-undead creature within 60 ft. that can see her makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. Failure leaves it Frightened for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each turn, with disadvantage if she is in its line of sight. Success ends the effect. Once the creature saves or the effect ends, it is immune to this banshee's Horrifying Visage for 24 hours.
Wail (1/day). She can wail only outside sunlight. Each creature within 30 ft. that can hear her makes a DC 13 Constitution save. Failure drops it to 0 HP. Success deals 10 (3d6) psychic damage. Constructs and undead are unaffected.

gm.title: Actions

gm.title: Description
lines: A demon lord who hunts through a labyrinth with a massive blade called Heartcleaver.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing that is nonmagical.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Labyrinthine Recall. Baphomet remembers every path he has taken and is immune to the Maze spell.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Baphomet fails a saving throw, he can spend one use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Baphomet has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite, one Gore, and one Heartcleaver attack. Use Frightful Presence as part of the same action.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (2d8 + 10) piercing damage.
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d6 + 10) piercing damage. Add 16 (3d10) piercing damage if Baphomet moved at least 10 ft. directly toward the target immediately before the hit. A creature hit by Gore makes a DC 25 Strength save, falling prone and being pushed up to 10 ft. away on a failure.
Heartcleaver. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (2d10 + 10) force damage.
Frightful Presence. Choose any number of creatures within 120 ft. that are aware of Baphomet. Each makes a DC 18 Wisdom save or becomes frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if it has line of sight to Baphomet. A success ends the effect. A creature that succeeds on any save or whose fear ends becomes immune to this Frightful Presence for 24 hours.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 18). Material components are waived.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Dominate Beast, Maze, Wall of Stone.
1/day. Teleport.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Baphomet has 3 legendary actions. Immediately after another creature's turn, spend the stated cost to use one option. He regains spent uses at the start of his turn and cannot spend them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, he cannot spend any until his first turn ends.
Heartcleaver Attack (1 action). Make one Heartcleaver attack.
Charge (2 actions). Move up to Baphomet's speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then make one Gore attack.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
At initiative count 20, losing ties, Baphomet can take one of these actions. He cannot choose the same option in consecutive rounds. Using an option requires being in the lair and able to act. If surprised, the creature must finish its first turn before using one.
Illusory Room. Cast Mirage Arcane in one room of the lair that measures no more than 100 ft. along any dimension. Use Charisma. The illusion ends at the next initiative count 20.
Reverse Gravity. Reverse gravity in one room of the lair that measures no more than 100 ft. along any dimension, until the next initiative count 20. Creatures and objects in the room fall in the new direction unless they can stay aloft. Baphomet can ignore the reversal.
Seal the Way. Fill an unoccupied doorway or other opening in the lair with solid stone. The stone lasts 1 minute or until Baphomet uses this option again.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more effects for the area around the lair.
Beguiling Realm. Within 6 miles, Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Performance) checks have disadvantage. Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Intimidation) checks have advantage.
Hedge Mazes. Vegetation within 1 mile forms dense barriers around small mazes.
Panicked Beasts. Beasts within 1 mile are frightened and disoriented. They may panic or lash out even without a visible threat.
The effects fade over 1d10 days after Baphomet dies.

Labyrinthine Recall. Baphomet remembers every path he has traveled perfectly and is immune to Maze.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Baphomet can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. Baphomet has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Baphomet’s weapon attacks are magical.

gm.title: Actions
lines:

Bite. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (2d8 + 10) piercing damage.
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d6 + 10) piercing damage.
Frightful Presence. Each chosen creature within 120 ft. that is aware of Baphomet must make a DC 18 Wisdom save or become frightened for 1 minute. Each affected creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if Baphomet is in its line of sight. A successful save ends the effect. When the creature saves successfully or the effect otherwise ends, it is immune to this Frightful Presence for 24 hours.

gm.title: Innate spellcasting
lines:
Use Charisma (spell save DC 18). These spells require no material components.
At will. Detect Magic.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Dominate Beast, Hunter’s Mark, Maze, Wall of Stone.
1/day. Teleport.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Baphomet has 3 legendary actions. Use one option at a time, at the end of another creature’s turn. He regains spent actions at the start of his turn and must be able to act. If surprised, he first has to complete his first turn.
Heartcleaver Attack (1 action). Make one Heartcleaver attack.
Charge (2 actions). Move up to Baphomet’s speed, then make one Gore attack.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one magical effect. Baphomet cannot choose the same effect two rounds in a row. He must be able to act. If surprised, he first has to complete his first turn.
Seal an entrance. Fill one unoccupied doorway or other entrance within the lair with solid stone. The stone lasts for 1 minute or until Baphomet uses this option again.
Reverse gravity. Choose a room within the lair no larger than 100 ft. in any dimension. Gravity reverses there until the next initiative count 20. Creatures and objects in the room fall in the new direction unless they can stay aloft. Baphomet can ignore the reversal if he is in the room.
Mirage Arcane. Cast Mirage Arcane on one room within the lair no larger than 100 ft. in any dimension. The spell ends on the next initiative count 20.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Plants within 1 mile of the lair grow into dense walls that form small mazes.
Beasts within 1 mile of the lair become frightened and disoriented. They may panic or lash out without an obvious threat.
A humanoid that spends at least 1 hour within 1 mile of the lair must pass a DC 18 Wisdom save or gain a flaw from Madness of Baphomet. A successful save grants immunity to this regional effect for 24 hours.
If Baphomet dies, these regional effects fade over 1d10 days.

gm.title: Madness of Baphomet
lines:
If a creature goes mad in the lair or within Baphomet’s line of sight, roll d100 for a flaw that persists until cured.
01–20. Once provoked, the creature is too angry to listen to reason.
21–40. The creature slips into animal behavior.
41–60. The creature treats the world as its hunting ground and other people as prey.
61–80. The creature slips easily from hatred into rage.
81–00. The creature regards anyone who opposes it as fair game.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · 60 ft. (30 ft. in goblin form)

gm.title: Description
lines: A soul-eating fiend that can pass as a goblin.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Abyssal, Common, Goblin, Infernal, telepathy 60 ft.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Fire Banishment. If the barghest starts its turn engulfed in flames at least 10 ft. high or wide, it makes a DC 15 Charisma save. Failure instantly returns it to Gehenna.
Soul Feeding. The barghest can spend at least 1 minute eating the corpse of a Fey or Humanoid it killed within the past 10 minutes. This destroys the corpse and traps the soul inside the barghest for 24 hours. Magic that tries to restore the victim to life while the soul is trapped has a 50 percent chance to fail and is wasted on a failure. If the barghest dies before the 24 hours end, the soul escapes. Otherwise, the barghest digests the soul and the victim cannot be revived.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claw attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 12). Material components are waived.
At will. Levitate, Minor Illusion, Pass without Trace.
1/day each. Charm Person, Dimension Door, Suggestion.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Change Shape. Become a Small goblin or return to true form. Only size and speed change. Worn and carried equipment keeps its form. The barghest returns to its true form if it dies.

lines: Speed · 60 ft. (30 ft. in goblin form)

gm.title: Description
lines: A goblin-born fiend sent by the General of Gehenna to consume seventeen goblinoid souls. It can hide among goblins while seeking powerful victims.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Abyssal, Common, Goblin, Infernal, telepathy 60 ft.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Shapechanger. As an action, the barghest can take the form of a Small goblin or return to its true form. Only its size and speed change. Its gear stays in its original form. The barghest reverts when it dies.
Fire Banishment. If the barghest starts its turn engulfed by flames at least 10 ft. high or wide, it must pass a DC 15 Charisma save or immediately return to Gehenna. Instantaneous flames, such as Fireball or a red dragon's breath, cannot banish it.
Keen Smell. The barghest has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on smell.
Soul Feeding. The barghest can take at least 1 minute to devour the body and soul of a Humanoid it killed less than 10 minutes ago. This destroys the body. Its soul remains trapped for 24 hours and is released if the barghest dies in that time. A revival that would otherwise work has a 50 percent chance while the soul is trapped and frees the soul on success. Once the soul is digested, mortal magic cannot revive the victim.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A bearded mercenary captain in half plate and a fur-lined cloak. His magic longsword, Nine Lives, has bloodstones set in its pommel.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Half plate. Saves Str +7, Con +7. Athletics +10, Deception +6, Insight +5, Intimidation +9, Perception +5. Passive Perception 15. Common.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Bloodstones (3 uses). When Uthrak fails a save while holding Nine Lives, he can succeed instead. If he does, he takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.
Exploit Opening (3/day). When Uthrak makes an attack, he can roll it with advantage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Nine Lives and Whip.
Nine Lives. Melee weapon attack +8, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
Whip. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage. On a failed DC 15 Strength save, the target is pulled up to 15 ft. toward Uthrak.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Kneel, Peasant! A Large or smaller creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure it takes 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage and falls Prone.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Riposte. When a creature Uthrak can see misses him with a melee attack, he makes a melee attack against that creature.

gm.title: Villain Actions
lines:
Use each once per encounter, in any order after an enemy’s turn. Use at most one per round.
Shoot! Each ally within 60 ft. who can hear Uthrak can make a ranged weapon attack without spending an action.
Form Up! Uthrak and each ally within 60 ft. who can hear him can move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each enters a defensive stance that ends when that creature moves again or becomes Restrained or Incapacitated. When at least two allies in the stance are within 5 ft. of one another, attack rolls against them have disadvantage.
Lead from the Front. Uthrak moves up to twice his speed without provoking opportunity attacks. During or after this move he can make up to four attacks with advantage, choosing Nine Lives or Whip for each and using a different target each time. After each attack, each ally within 5 ft. of that target can make a melee attack with advantage against the same target without spending an action.

gm.title: Encounter uses
lines: Uthrak lost his title after backing a failed rebellion. He now leads a mercenary band. Place melee guards close enough to form a line and ranged allies within earshot so his commands have targets.

lines: A low-slung cave predator that turns prey to stone before feeding.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Petrifying Gaze. Unless incapacitated, the basilisk can force a DC 12 Constitution save at the start of another creature’s turn when that creature is within 30 ft. and the two can see each other. On a failure the creature starts turning to stone and becomes restrained. It saves again at the end of its next turn. Success ends the effect. Failure petrifies it until Greater Restoration or other magic frees it.
A creature that begins its turn without being surprised can avert its eyes to avoid the initial save. It cannot see the basilisk until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. Looking at the basilisk before then forces an immediate save.
If the basilisk sees its own reflection in bright light within 30 ft., it takes the reflection for a rival and directs the gaze at itself.

gm.title: Encounter notes
lines: A basilisk raised in captivity can be trained to avoid meeting the eyes of creatures its keeper wants to protect. The book also describes oil derived from a basilisk’s gullet that reverses petrification. Lost parts stay missing, and the oil fails if the creature is missing a vital part.

gm.title: Ferocity actions
lines:
Level 1, Poison Spittle (2 Ferocity). Make a signature attack. On a hit, add damage equal to PB. A different creature of the basilisk’s choice within 5 ft. of the basilisk takes poison damage equal to PB.
Level 3, Poison Gaze (5 Ferocity). Choose up to three creatures the basilisk sees within 15 ft. Each makes a Constitution save against DC 10 + PB or becomes Poisoned until the start of the basilisk’s next turn.
Level 5, Lesser Petrifying Eye Beams (8 Ferocity). Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. It makes a Constitution save against DC 10 + PB or becomes Restrained as it starts turning to stone. If it is still Restrained this way at the end of its turn, it repeats the save. A success ends the effect. A failure Petrifies it for 1 hour, or until Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect ends the condition.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Heavy Glare. When the caregiver’s attack hits a creature that can see the basilisk, the target makes a Constitution save against DC 10 + PB. On a failure, until the start of the target’s next turn, its speed drops by 10 ft. and it cannot make opportunity attacks.

gm.title: MCDM companion rules
lines:
Shared turn. The caregiver and companion act on the same turn. The companion moves and uses its reaction and bonus action independently. To do anything with its action besides Dash, Disengage or Dodge, it normally needs a command that costs the caregiver a bonus action. It must see or hear the caregiver. If the caregiver is Incapacitated, it can act without a command. The GM chooses who controls it when the caregiver is Incapacitated or absent.
Ferocity. At the start of their turn, unless Incapacitated, the companion gains 1d4 Ferocity plus one for each enemy it sees or hears within 5 ft. A swarm sharing one stat block counts as one enemy. Spend the listed cost before taking a Ferocity action. It uses the companion’s action, requires the listed caregiver level and is unavailable during a rampage.
Rampage. After rolling Ferocity, a companion with at least 10 Ferocity risks a rampage if it is not Incapacitated. A caregiver who is not Incapacitated and can be seen or heard can prevent it with a Wisdom (Animal Handling) check against DC 5 + Ferocity, without spending an action. If the companion rampages, it immediately moves toward the nearest creature it senses and makes its signature attack, with extra damage equal to half its Ferocity on a hit. If an ally and enemy tie for nearest, roll any die. On an odd roll the caregiver’s player chooses a tied ally. On an even roll they choose a tied enemy. If it cannot reach a target, it Dashes toward it. If it senses none, it moves as far as it can in a random safe direction. Ferocity falls to 0 after this action or at the end of the turn.
Recovery. At 0 HP, a companion makes death saves. After combat, Ferocity resets to 0. A companion that is not dying first regains HP equal to its remaining Ferocity.

gm.title: Description
lines: A dream stalker hides among cast shadows until someone sleeps. It takes on a broad human shape and spreads dark tendrils over the sleeper's face as it feeds.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Any land or underground. Solitary or pack of 2–5. Always chaotic evil. No treasure. Advancement 6–10 HD (Medium). No level adjustment. Understands its languages from life but cannot speak. It can communicate with any creature that has a language through a dream.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +3. AC +3 Dex and +3 deflection. Touch 16 and flat-footed 13, calculated from those bonuses. Base attack +2, grapple +2 as listed. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +1, Ref +4, Will +6.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Bluff +9, Hide +10 or +20 with multiple light sources, Intimidate +11, Listen +9, Sense Motive +8, Spot +12. Alertness (bonus), Blind-Fight, Skill Focus (Hide).

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Undead traits, incorporeal subtype, and +4 turn resistance.
Hide in Plain Sight (Ex). It takes on the shape of a shadow cast by a creature or object. An observer can use Spot to notice an extra shadow. The bastellus gains a +10 circumstance bonus to Hide in a room with more than one light source. A dream invasion reveals its actual form, ending this benefit.
Light Blindness. Sunlight or comparably intense light such as daylight blinds it. It tries to smother the light with darkness.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Incorporeal touch +5 melee. In the waking world the touch deals no damage. A creature hit must make a DC 17 Will save against insanity or suffer confusion for 1d4 rounds.
Darkness (Sp). Twice per day as a 5th-level sorcerer.
Sleep (Sp). Every living creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 14 Will save or fall asleep, regardless of Hit Dice.
Dream Invasion (Su). Take on its actual form and touch a sleeping victim's forehead. Witnesses make a DC 15 Horror save. The sleeper makes a DC 18 Will save. Failure gives the bastellus control of the dream and the sleeper wakes with one negative level. On a success, the sleeper can fight back inside the dream. Both sides retain their normal abilities, and the sleeper also has their current gear, spells, and feats. Supplies and spells used in the dream remain available after waking. The bastellus's dream touch deals 1d6 Wisdom damage instead of causing insanity. At Wisdom 0, the sleeper loses and wakes with one negative level. If the sleeper wins, they wake at once and recover lost Wisdom. The bastellus is stunned for 10 minutes per level of the sleeper.
Create Spawn (Su). Someone who dies from a dream invasion returns as an independent bastellus after 1d4 days, without their former abilities.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: It attacks the weakest or least guarded target, puts guards to sleep when needed, and flees when it can if cornered.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The attack header lists Constitution drain, but the detailed rules supply no amount or trigger. Use the detailed insanity and dream invasion rules. The printed grapple bonus is retained, though standard incorporeal creatures cannot physically grapple corporeal opponents.
The book gives no duration or daily limit for Sleep. For a runnable table default, use five minutes, as for the 3.5 spell at 5th caster level, with the printed save, radius, and unlimited HD.

gm.title: Description
lines: Slack-jawed Lorna bargains for immediate relief from other people’s troubles. The hag of the present distrusts visitors and relies on diminutive copies of herself in her Downfall cottage.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. Bavlorna breathes air and water.
Boon of Immortality. Aging has no effect on her, and old age cannot kill her.
Widdershins Allergy. If a creature within 10 ft. spends at least 10 ft. of movement running in place counterclockwise, Bavlorna starts sneezing and cannot cast spells through the end of her next turn. Any creature she has swallowed is expelled at once into an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of her and falls prone.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Use Bite once and Withering Ray once.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage on a hit. A Medium or smaller target is also grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained until the grapple ends. Bavlorna cannot Bite another target while holding this one.
Withering Ray. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Deal 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage on a hit.

gm.title: Heraldic servant rules
lines:
Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.
A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.
Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.
An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.
The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

1. Charm Ray. Wisdom DC 16 or Charmed by the eye tyrant for 1 hour. If it harms the target, the charm ends.
2. Paralyzing Ray. Constitution DC 16 or Paralyzed for 1 minute. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the condition on a success.
3. Fear Ray. Wisdom DC 16 or Frightened for 1 minute. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the condition on a success.
4. Slowing Ray. Dexterity DC 16 or speed is halved for 1 minute. While slowed, the target cannot take reactions and can take only one of an action and a bonus action on its turn. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the effect on a success.
5. Enervation Ray. Constitution DC 16. Failure deals 36 (8d8) necrotic damage. Success halves it.
6. Telekinetic Ray. A creature makes a DC 16 Strength save. On failure, move it up to 30 ft. in any direction. It is Restrained until the start of the eye tyrant’s next turn or until the eye tyrant becomes Incapacitated. An object weighing 300 lb. or less, neither worn nor carried, can move up to 30 ft. in any direction without a save. The ray can also work a simple tool or open a door or container.
7. Sleep Ray. Wisdom DC 16 or Unconscious for 1 minute. Damage or another creature spending an action to wake the target ends the sleep. Constructs and Undead are unaffected.
8. Petrification Ray. Dexterity DC 16 or Restrained and beginning to turn to stone. Repeat the save at the end of the target’s next turn. Success ends the effect. Failure leaves the target Petrified until Greater Restoration or other magic frees it.
9. Disintegration Ray. A creature makes a DC 16 Dexterity save or takes 45 (10d8) force damage. If that damage leaves it at 0 HP, its body turns to fine gray dust. A Large or smaller nonmagical object or creation of magical force is destroyed without a save. For a Huge or larger object or creation of magical force, destroy one 10-ft. cube of it.
10. Death Ray. Dexterity DC 16 or take 55 (10d10) necrotic damage. If this leaves the target at 0 HP, it dies.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Three legendary actions. Spend one option at the end of another creature’s turn. Regain spent actions at the start of this creature’s turn. It cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before its first turn if surprised.
Eye Ray (1 action). Use one randomly rolled eye ray.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
In its lair, the beholder is CR 14 (11,500 XP). Act on initiative count 20, losing ties. No lair action while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before the first turn if surprised.
Slime. A 50-ft. square of ground within 120 ft. becomes Difficult Terrain until initiative count 20 next round.
Grasping Walls. Walls within 120 ft. sprout grasping limbs until initiative count 20 on the round after next. Choose which creatures that start their turn within 10 ft. of these walls must make a DC 15 Dexterity save or become Grappled. Escape with a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.
Wall Eye. An eye opens on a solid surface within 60 ft. It fires one random eye ray at a target of the beholder’s choice that the beholder can see, then disappears.
Use all three effects before repeating one, and never repeat on consecutive rounds.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Within 1 mile of the lair, creatures sometimes feel watched. While the beholder sleeps, minor changes to natural surfaces or unattended nonmagical objects can appear within 1 mile and vanish after 24 hours.
After the beholder dies, these regional effects fade over 1d10 days.

gm.title: Description
lines: A floating eye tyrant carves tunnels with its rays and collects the adventurers it petrifies.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Legendary Resistance (3/day, 4/day in its lair). It can turn a failed save into a success.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Use Eye Rays three times.
Bite. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit deals 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Eye Rays. Choose a visible target within 120 ft. and roll 1d10 for its magical ray. Reroll a ray the beholder has already used during this turn. All saves below are DC 16.
1. Charm Ray. Wisdom save. Failure deals 13 (3d8) psychic damage and leaves the target Charmed for 1 hour or until it takes damage. Success halves the damage and avoids the condition.
2. Paralyzing Ray. Constitution save. Failure leaves the target Paralyzed. Repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect on success. It automatically succeeds after 1 minute.
3. Fear Ray. Wisdom save. Failure deals 14 (4d6) psychic damage and leaves the target Frightened until the end of its next turn. Success halves the damage and avoids the condition.
4. Slowing Ray. Constitution save. Failure deals 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. Until the end of its next turn, the target has half Speed, cannot take Reactions, and has to choose between taking an action and taking a Bonus Action on its turn. Success halves the damage and avoids the other effects.
5. Enervation Ray. Constitution save. Failure deals 13 (3d8) poison damage and leaves the target Poisoned until the end of its next turn. While Poisoned this way, it cannot regain HP. Success halves the damage and avoids the condition.
6. Telekinetic Ray. Strength save. A Gargantuan target succeeds automatically. On failure the beholder moves the target up to 30 ft. in any direction and Restrains it until the start of the beholder’s next turn or until the beholder is Incapacitated. This ray can also manipulate objects precisely, for example to open a door or operate a tool.
7. Sleep Ray. Wisdom save. Constructs and Undead succeed automatically. On failure the target is Unconscious for 1 minute. Damage ends the effect. A creature within 5 ft. can also use an action to wake the target.
8. Petrification Ray. Constitution save. Failure leaves the target Restrained. If it is still Restrained at the end of its next turn, it repeats the save. Success ends the effect. Failure changes Restrained to Petrified.
9. Disintegration Ray. Dexterity save. Failure deals 36 (8d8) force damage and disintegrates a 10-ft. cube of a targeted nonmagical object or magical force creation. Success halves the damage. Either way, a creature reduced to 0 HP by the ray turns to dust.
10. Death Ray. Dexterity save. Failure deals 55 (10d10) necrotic damage and success halves it. A creature reduced to 0 HP by the ray dies.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Antimagic Cone. Project a 150-ft. Cone from the central eye. Until the start of the beholder’s next turn, the area acts as Antimagic Field and suppresses even its own Eye Rays.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
3 uses (4 in its lair). Spend one use immediately after another creature’s turn. Recover all uses at the start of this creature’s turn. It cannot use these actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Chomp. Make two Bite attacks.
Glare. Use Eye Rays.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Scopophobia. Creatures within 1 mile feel watched. A creature other than the beholder or its allies that finishes a Short Rest within that area makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On failure the rest grants no benefit.
Warping Terrain. Any creature other than the beholder that rolls a natural 1 on a D20 Test within 1 mile of the lair falls Prone.
Both effects end immediately if the beholder dies or its lair moves.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · 30 ft., fly 50 ft. (hover, Graystaff Magic)

gm.title: Description
lines: A winter hag who rides a flying staff and can turn a grisly feast into a weapon.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Control Weather (1/day). Cast Control Weather using Charisma and without material components.
Graystaff Magic. The hag can use her flying speed only while riding her magical graystaff. Only a bheur hag can use the staff. If it is lost or destroyed, she must make another, which takes a year and a day.
Ice Walk. The hag can move and climb across ice without an ability check. Difficult terrain caused by ice or snow costs her no extra movement.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Slam or Frost Shard.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage and 18 (4d8) cold damage.
Frost Shard. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 30 (6d8 + 3) cold damage and reduces the target's speed by 10 ft. until the start of the hag's next turn.
Horrific Feast. Feed on the corpse of an enemy within reach that died within the last minute. Choose any creatures within 60 ft. that can see the hag feeding. Each makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or becomes frightened of the hag for 1 minute. While frightened this way, the creature is incapacitated, cannot read or understand others' speech, and can speak only gibberish. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If it succeeds on a save or the effect ends, it is immune to this hag's Horrific Feast for 24 hours.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
While holding or riding the graystaff, cast one listed spell as an action using Charisma (spell save DC 14). Material components are waived.
At will. Hold Person.
1/day each. Cone of Cold, Ice Storm, Wall of Ice.

gm.title: Coven challenge
lines: CR 9 (5,000 XP) when part of a coven.
