gm.title: Description
lines: An undead warlock stripped of much of its magic as punishment by a patron or necromancer.

gm.title: Languages
lines: The languages it knew in life.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the wight has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

gm.title: Undead nature
lines: The Deathlock does not need to breathe, eat, drink or sleep.

gm.title: Innate Spellcasting
lines:
The wight uses Charisma (save DC 13) for its innate spells. It needs neither verbal nor material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Disguise Self, Mage Armor.
1/day each. Fear, Hold Person, Misty Step.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Grave Bolt attacks.
Grave Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) necrotic damage.
Life Drain. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage. On a failed DC 13 Constitution save, reduce the target’s hit point maximum by the damage taken until it finishes a long rest. The target dies if this drops its maximum to 0. A Humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a Zombie under the wight’s control unless the Humanoid is revived or its body is destroyed. The wight can control up to twelve Zombies this way.

gm.title: Description
lines: An Orzhov angel grants favors to petitioners and collects the debt through service. Some debtors continue serving as indentured spirits after death.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Necrotic and radiant. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Flyby. Leaving a foe's reach in flight does not provoke an opportunity attack.
Magic Resistance. The angel makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Immortal Nature. The angel needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Innate Spellcasting
lines:
Charisma sets the angel's spell save DC to 19 and spell attack bonus to +11. It needs no material components.
At will. Command (as a 2nd-level spell), Detect Evil and Good.
1/day. Raise Dead.
3/day each. Charm Person (as a 5th-level spell), Darkness, Suggestion.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Scythe attacks. Chains of Obligation can replace one Scythe attack.
Scythe. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 27 (6d8) necrotic damage.
Chains of Obligation. Choose a creature the angel has charmed that it can see within 90 ft. It must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma save or become paralyzed for 1 minute. Taking any damage ends this paralysis.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Exploitation of the Debtors. Choose a creature charmed by the angel that it can see within 30 ft. Deal 11 (2d10) necrotic damage to it and gain temporary HP equal to the damage it takes.

gm.title: Debts Paid
lines: A deathpact angel may offer an indentured spirit release from its debt. If the spirit sees the angel fall to 0 HP, the spirit can destroy itself to bring the angel back to life with 1 HP.

gm.title: Description
lines: Head-shaped fruit moan from the branches of a willow, drawing rescuers into range. When the heads ripen, they break away and drift in search of hosts.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Temperate plains, forests, hills, or marshes. Solitary or grove of 2–12. Always neutral evil. No treasure. Advancement 11–16 HD (Huge, 4d6 heads), 17–22 HD (Gargantuan, 6d8 heads).

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative −1. Trunk AC 21 (−2 size, +13 natural), touch 8, printed flat-footed 19. Attached heads AC 12 (+2 size), touch and flat-footed 12. Base attack +7, grapple +16. Space 10 ft., reach 15 ft. Fort +12, Will +4. Reflex is unlisted. Plant traits, DR 10/bludgeoning or slashing, fire resistance 20, SR 11.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Bite +13 melee (1d2 plus implant) or spit seed +4 ranged (1 damage plus implant).
Full attack. 4d4 bites at +16 melee, or 4d4 spit seeds at +4 ranged. Use the actual head count once established. Each head has 1d6 seeds. Spit seeds have a maximum range of 30 ft. and no range increment.
Implant Seeds (Ex). A bite or spit hit plants a seed. DC 15 Spot notices the numbed wound. DC 10 Heal removes the seed during the first 24 hours. After that it takes root in a humanoid and deals cumulative damage of 1d4 on day one, 2d4 on day two, and so on to 10d4 per day. A rooted seed requires DC 15 + days since rooting to remove with Heal. Every attempt deals half that day’s damage, even on a failure. If the victim dies with an implanted seed, a new tree grows from the body.

gm.title: Detached Death’s Head
lines: Tiny Undead, CR 1/6, 6 HP (1d12), initiative +0. Fly 10 ft. (perfect) as a free action, with personal feather fall continuously. AC 11 (+2 size, −1 Dex), touch 11, flat-footed 12. Base attack +0, grapple −8. Attack or full attack: spit seed +0 ranged (1 damage plus implant). Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +0, Ref +0, Will +2. Str 2, Dex 9, Wis 10, Cha 1. Listen +3, Spot +3, Weapon Focus (spit). SR 11 and undead traits. Always neutral, no treasure. A head may roam up to 20 miles and dies after using its last seed. Encounters are solitary or a harvest of 2–6.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The printing gives a higher bonus to the tree’s full-attack bites than to its single bite and a different flat-footed AC from its listed trunk modifiers. The printed values are retained.

gm.title: Description
lines: A spherical ten-eyed machine with ten grasping tentacles, tasked with keeping lower-ranking modrons in working order.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A hovering hierarch modron with mechanical tentacles and lightning rays.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Axiomatic Mind. No effect can compel the decaton to disobey its instructions or act against its nature.
Combat Ready. Roll initiative with advantage.
Disintegration. When the decaton dies, it crumbles to dust and leaves behind anything it was carrying.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Tentacle attacks.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 14). The decaton has ten tentacles. Each can hold one creature and cannot attack another target until that grapple ends.
Lightning Rays (Recharge 6). All creatures within 30 ft. of the decaton make DC 13 Dexterity saves against its electrical barrage. It deals 38 (7d10) lightning damage on a failed save or half on a success.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell.
Intelligence (spell save DC 13), no material components. At will: Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, and Mending (as an action). 1/day each: Plane Shift (self only) and Protection from Evil and Good.

gm.title: Encounter context
lines: The lawful planar encounter table suggests one decaton and 2d6 Quadrones returning to Mechanus. Modron orders pass from one rank to the next, and decatons form the lowest rank of hierarchs.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A hovering hierarch modron with mechanical tentacles and lightning rays.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Bone Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical. Its bow fires bones taken from its own body. Those bones grow back each dusk.

gm.title: Actions

Bone Knife (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 1 slashing damage.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

lines:

Antimagic. Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. Antimagic Field fills its space and moves with it until initiative count 20 next round.
Seal Healing. Choose any number of visible creatures within 30 ft. They cannot regain HP until initiative count 20 next round.

lines:

On a success it takes 24 (7d6) necrotic damage, and if that leaves it at 0 HP, trap its soul as on failure. After 24 hours in a gem, the soul is devoured and ceases to exist. lines:

gm.title: Actions

Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (3d12 + 9) force damage. A creature hit must make a DC 23 Constitution save. On a failure, reduce its hit point maximum by the damage it took until it finishes a long rest. The creature dies if its maximum reaches 0.
Gaze. Choose one creature Demogorgon can see within 120 ft. Demogorgon's magical gaze forces a DC 23 Wisdom save. On a failure, choose one result or roll 1d6.
1–2, Beguiling Gaze. The target is stunned until the start of Demogorgon's next turn or until he leaves its line of sight.
3–4, Confusing Gaze. The target is affected by Confusion until the start of Demogorgon's next turn. It makes no saving throw against the spell, and Demogorgon doesn't concentrate on it.
5–6, Hypnotic Gaze. The target is charmed by Demogorgon until the start of his next turn. He chooses how it uses its action, reaction, and movement.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 23). No material components are required.
At will. Detect Magic, Major Image.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Fear, Telekinesis.
1/day each. Feeblemind, Project Image.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Demogorgon has 2 legendary actions. Immediately after another creature's turn, spend the stated cost to use one option. He regains spent uses at the start of his turn. He cannot spend any while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, he must finish his first turn before using one.
Gaze (1 action). Use Gaze and choose Beguiling Gaze or Confusing Gaze.
Tail (1 action). Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.
Cast a Spell (2 actions). Use Spellcasting.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
In his lair, Demogorgon can use one option on initiative count 20, losing ties. He cannot select the same option on consecutive rounds. He must be able to act. If surprised, he must finish his first turn before using one.
Darkness. Cast Darkness four times in different areas, with no concentration needed. Each ends on initiative count 20 of the next round.
Illusory Duplicate. A double appears in Demogorgon's space and lasts until initiative count 20 of the next round. On his turn, Demogorgon can move it a distance equal to his walking speed without spending an action. On the first physical interaction with Demogorgon by a creature or object, roll a 50 percent chance that the double takes the effect instead. If it does, it disappears.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more effects for the area around Abysm.
Beguiling Realm. Within 6 miles, Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Performance) checks have disadvantage. Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Intimidation) checks have advantage.
Frenzied Animals. Beasts within 1 mile become violent, including usually docile animals. Checks involving Animal Handling in that area have disadvantage.
Venomous Beasts. Poisonous snakes and other venomous Beasts proliferate within 6 miles.
These effects fade over 1d10 days after Demogorgon dies.

lines:

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/Day). When Demogorgon fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed.
Magic Resistance. Demogorgon has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Demogorgon’s weapon attacks count as magical.
Two Heads. Demogorgon has advantage on saving throws to avoid being blinded, deafened, stunned or knocked unconscious.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Tentacle attacks.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (3d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it makes a DC 23 Constitution save. On a failure, reduce its hit point maximum by the damage taken until it finishes a long rest. It dies if this drops its maximum to 0.
Gaze. Choose one creature Demogorgon can see within 120 ft. It makes a DC 23 Wisdom save against his magical gaze. A target that is not incapacitated can avert its eyes and pass the save automatically. It then cannot see Demogorgon until the start of his next turn. If it looks at him before then, it must immediately make the save. On a failed save, Demogorgon chooses one of the three effects or determines it at random.
Beguiling Gaze. The target is stunned until the start of Demogorgon’s next turn or until he is out of its line of sight.
Hypnotic Gaze. The target is charmed until the start of Demogorgon’s next turn. He chooses how it spends its actions, reactions and movement. Both heads are occupied, so Demogorgon cannot use Maddening Gaze until the start of his next turn.
Insanity Gaze. Apply Confusion without an extra save or concentration until the start of Demogorgon’s next turn.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Demogorgon has two legendary actions and regains spent uses at the start of his turn. He can use one option at the end of another creature’s turn. Each option costs one use.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.
Maddening Gaze. Use Gaze with either the Beguiling or Insanity effect.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
At initiative count 20, losing ties, Demogorgon may use either option. He cannot repeat the same option in consecutive rounds.
Illusory duplicate. An illusion of Demogorgon appears in his space and lasts until initiative count 20 of the next round. On his turn, he can move the duplicate up to his walking speed without using an action. The first time a creature or object physically interacts with him, there is a 50% chance it affects the duplicate. The duplicate vanishes if affected.
Darkness. Cast Darkness at its lowest level in four different areas without concentration. All four effects end on initiative count 20 of the next round.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
The following effects can occur around Abysm, his palace in the Gaping Maw.
Venomous beasts. Lizards, venomous snakes and other venomous beasts overpopulate the area within 6 miles.
Violent beasts. Within 1 mile, beasts grow violent even if normally docile.
Madness. After at least an hour within 1 mile, a Humanoid makes a DC 23 Wisdom save. On a failure, roll on Madness of Demogorgon. A success makes the creature immune to this regional effect for 24 hours.
The effects fade over 1d10 days if Demogorgon dies.

gm.title: Madness of Demogorgon
lines:
When a creature goes mad in Demogorgon’s lair or within sight of him, roll d100. The flaw lasts until cured.
01–20. The creature believes someone plans to kill it and must be attacked first.
21–40. The creature believes killing everyone involved will solve its problems.
41–60. The creature believes it shares its head with another mind.
61–80. The creature tries to force anyone who disagrees to submit through violence.
81–00. The creature fears theft and refuses to let others touch its belongings.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Slam +2 melee for 1d8 + 1 damage. The prose gives the same damage for weapons or other attacks.

The deva magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. lines:

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A wiry horned devil clerk in a blue-gray coat carrying an open ledger and quill.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Chain shirt. Fire damage immunity. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 12. Common and Infernal.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Importunity. At the start of its turn, the notary can bless a visible non-minion ally within 60 ft. without spending an action. The ally can add +1 to its next attack roll or saving throw before the start of the notary’s next turn. Blessings from multiple notaries stack to a maximum bonus of +5.
Minion. Damage from an attack or failed save drops the notary to 0 HP. Other damage kills it if it deals at least 13 damage. It ignores smaller amounts from those other effects.
True Name. If the notary hears someone within 60 ft. speak its true name, it loses its damage immunity and Importunity for 24 hours.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Brimstone (Group Attack). Melee or ranged spell attack +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. Hit 4 fire damage.

gm.title: Minion rules
lines:
Group attack. Two to five notaries on the same turn can each spend an action to attack a target in reach or range of every participant. Make one roll at +6 plus the number joining. A hit deals 4 fire damage per participant. A solo notary attacks at +6. Advantage or disadvantage applies if all participants have it. When cover or concealment differs, roll separately for each group. The target chooses which participant is affected by a response that can affect only one attacker.
Group opportunity attack. If a target provokes from multiple notaries at once, each can spend its reaction to join the melee Brimstone attack. Notaries have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. A weapon hit dealing more than 13 damage leaves surplus that can drop an eligible additional notary to 0 HP for each 13 points of surplus damage or part thereof. For melee, each must be within reach of the weapon. At range, each must lie on the line from attacker through the first target and within the weapon’s short range. This rule excludes opportunity attacks.

gm.title: Description
lines: Orcus sends devourers to trap souls and raise undead servants. Their hollow ribcages hold the dying.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unusual Nature. The devourer needs no air, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks. The devourer can also use one available option, Imprison Soul or Soul Rend.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage.
Imprison Soul. Choose a living Humanoid the devourer can see within 30 ft. that has 0 hit points. The target teleports into the devourer's ribcage and stays imprisoned there. It is restrained and has disadvantage on death saving throws while imprisoned. If it dies there, the devourer regains 25 hit points and immediately recharges Soul Rend. At the start of its next turn, the devourer uses a bonus action to spit out the dead victim as an Undead. A victim with up to 2 Hit Dice becomes a Zombie. A victim with 3–5 Hit Dice becomes a Ghoul. A victim with 6 or more Hit Dice becomes a Wight. Only one creature can be imprisoned at a time.
Soul Rend (recharge 6). Each creature in a 20-ft. radius centered on the devourer makes a DC 18 Constitution save, taking 44 (8d10) necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Medium augmented monstrous humanoid, 8th-level human fighter example

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Slam +13 melee for 1d6 + 5 or +1 rapier +14 melee for 1d6 + 8. Full attack uses slam +13 or rapier +14/+3, as printed. Slam counts as magic for overcoming damage reduction.
Domination (Su). Standard action. Meet a creature's gaze within 30 ft. and force a DC 17 Will save against dominate person at caster level 12. Mere eye contact does not trigger it.
Blood Drain (Ex). While pinning a living target, drain 1d4 Constitution damage each round the grapple is maintained.
Children of the Night (Su, 1/day). Standard action to summon 4d8 dire rats, 10d10 bats or 3d6 wolves. They arrive in 2d6 rounds and serve up to one hour.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
DR 10/magic, cold and electricity resistance 10, and spider climb as the spell at CL 12. Fast healing 1 until reduced to −10 HP. Supernatural special attacks and qualities stop in natural daylight or after a week without humanoid blood.
Restless (Su). The printed fighter rises as a vampire 1d4 days after burial. Destroy the body as for a vampire to prevent it. A dhampir with fewer than 5 original Hit Dice instead rises as vampire spawn.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +8. AC from +4 Dex, +4 natural and +5 +1 chain shirt. Touch 14, flat-footed 19. BAB/grapple +8/+13, space/reach 5 ft./5 ft., Fort +8, Ref +8, Will +4.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Bluff +9, Climb +15, Hide +10, Jump +13, Listen +10, Move Silently +12, Ride +12, Swim +15, Search +8, Sense Motive +8, Spot +10. Alertness, Athletic, Combat Reflexes, Combat Expertise, Dodge, Improved Critical (rapier), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Mobility, Quick Draw, Spring Attack, Weapon Focus and Weapon Specialization (rapier), Whirlwind Attack.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Solitary, any land. Dust of appearance, double standard treasure.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The printed example uses d12s and gives the second rapier attack as +3. The general template describes increasing Hit Dice by one die size. Retained the sample’s listed dice and attacks.

gm.title: Description
lines: A dire troll lashes out with several arms. Even at 0 hit points it can regenerate unless an attack delivers enough acid or fire to kill it.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Regeneration. At the start of its turn, the troll regains 10 hit points. After taking acid or fire damage, the troll regains 5 hit points at the start of its next turn. The troll dies only when an attack hits it while it has 0 hit points and deals at least 10 acid or fire damage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and four Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (3d6 + 6) slashing damage.
Whirlwind of Claws (recharge 5–6). Each creature within 10 ft. of the troll makes a DC 19 Dexterity save, taking 44 (8d10) slashing damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

lines: A dire troll grows by feeding on other trolls and grafting stolen flesh onto its wounds. Its regeneration can incorporate extra eyes and arms, leaving it with more claws than its prey can fend off.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

lines:

Regeneration. The troll regains 10 HP at the start of its turn. If it takes acid or fire damage, it regains 5 HP at the start of its next turn instead. It dies only if an attack deals at least 10 acid or fire damage to it while it has 0 HP.

gm.title: Description
lines: This outsized worg unnerves prey with a supernatural howl. Dire worgs often hunt with ettins, ogres, and trolls, and can teleport with a willing ally.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Magic Resistance. The worg has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage and leaves the target Poisoned until the start of the worg's next turn. The target can't regain HP while Poisoned by this bite.
Dreadful Howl (Recharge 5–6). Each creature other than a worg within 30 ft. makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure the creature takes 36 (8d8) Psychic damage and is Frightened until the start of the dire worg's next turn. On a success it takes half damage only.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Warp Step. The worg and one willing creature of its choice within 5 ft. of it teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space the worg can see.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · 40 ft., burrow 40 ft., climb 40 ft.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +12, Con +11, Cha +6. Athletics +12, Perception +7. Immune to cold, fire, and poison damage and to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 17. Understands its creator's languages and cannot speak.

gm.title: Traits
lines:

lines:

lines: A dreg that is hard to strike and can attack as it teleports.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common.

gm.title: Base stat block
lines: Delerium Dreg, Appendix A, p. 199. This profile includes the printed Displaced mutation.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Misty Camouflage. The dreg has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in mist or fog that obscures the area.
Displacement. Attacks against the dreg have disadvantage. A hit suppresses this trait until the end of its next turn. The trait also stops while the dreg is Incapacitated or its speed is 0.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 20/60-ft. range, one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Wielding the spear in two hands for a melee attack deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Teleport (Recharge 4–6). The dreg and its worn or carried equipment teleport up to 60 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space. It can make one melee attack before or after teleporting. A hit deals an extra 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

gm.title: Haze-native creatures
lines:
Printed source. Appendix A, pp. 196–197. These traits leave the creature’s CR as printed. They apply to Haze natives and exclude creatures recruited or summoned by the party.
Fully Contaminated. Immune to contamination and has advantage on saves against contaminated spells.
Haze Adaptation. Can benefit from a long rest in the Haze. It can see twice as far through the Haze and Deep Haze.
Haze Dependence. Gains one Exhaustion level for each 24 hours outside the Haze. It can remove those levels only in the Haze.
Delerium Healing. As an action, touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) HP. That shard cannot heal this way again for 24 hours.

gm.title: Description
lines: A young displacer beast whose illusion makes it seem to be a short distance from its true position. Star, the kitten in Thither, recognizes its mirrored toy ball.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Displacement. A magical illusion offsets the kitten’s apparent position, imposing disadvantage on attack rolls against it. A hit disrupts the illusion until the end of its next turn. The illusion also fails while the kitten is incapacitated or its speed is 0.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 2 bludgeoning damage plus 2 piercing damage.

gm.title: Star and the Getaway Gang
lines: Will of the Feywild, an Oni in disguise, keeps Star as a pet. He abandons Star if his curse ends. Showing the kitten Dirlagraun’s mirrored ball excites it. If told about Star’s parent, Will agrees to return the kitten if the party helps free the children in Loomlurch.

gm.title: Traits
lines:

Relentless (1/turn). If Raskovar would fall to 0 HP without dying outright and is not Incapacitated, he can attack an enemy before the loss of HP resolves, without an action. If the attack hits and drops the enemy to 0 HP, Raskovar drops to 1 HP instead.

gm.title: Actions
lines:

War Mace. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage and Daze the target until the end of its next turn.
Repeating Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack +4, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d12 + 1) piercing damage and reduce the target's speed by 10 ft. until the end of its next turn.
Reinforcements (1/day). Take the Dodge action. Ten Orc Blitzers appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 ft. of Raskovar.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Dohma Rally (3/day). Regain 20 HP and gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of Raskovar's next turn.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: On the House. After a visible creature within 30 ft. fails a check or misses with an attack roll, that creature can reroll and choose either result.

gm.title: Villain Actions
lines:
Each villain action is available once per encounter. Use one at most per round, in any order, immediately after an enemy's turn.
1. Close In. Each ally within 60 ft. who can hear Raskovar can move up to its speed. Afterward, each enemy within 5 ft. of at least one ally who moved makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, the enemy is Frightened of Raskovar for 1 minute, with an end-of-turn save.
2. Lockdown. Each ally within 60 ft. who can hear Raskovar can attempt a Strength (Athletics) check with advantage to grapple an enemy it can reach, without an action. Raskovar can then move up to his speed.
3. Do It Myself. Move up to Raskovar's speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then make up to five War Mace attacks with advantage.

gm.title: Heraldic servant rules
lines:
Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.
A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.
Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.
An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.
The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

lines: Shapechanger. The doppelganger can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. lines:

gm.title: Description
lines: A tangle of vines grows pods large enough to hold a person. Victims can return to their companions with familiar memories and an allegiance to the plant.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Warm or temperate land. Solitary. Always chaotic evil. No treasure of its own. Podlings have standard treasure. Advancement 11–14 HD (Gargantuan), 15–20 HD (Colossal).

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +0. Vines AC 8 (−2 size), touch 10, flat-footed 8. Pods AC 16 (+6 natural), touch 10, flat-footed 16. Base attack and grapple are both +7. Space one 10-ft. square per HD, reach 0 ft. Fort +4, Will +4. Reflex is unlisted. Bluff +20, Diplomacy +18, Gather Information +18, Sense Motive +18. No feats.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Plant traits, DR 10/bludgeoning or slashing, electricity resistance 20 and fire resistance 20. Has no physical attacks. Each HD supplies one pod. The plant perceives and communicates through its continuous telepathic link to its podlings. The plant and all podlings share their languages and can use the highest available Int-, Wis-, and Cha-based skill bonus among them.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Mind Bondage (Su). Once per round, as a standard action, randomly select a sleeping or unconscious humanoid within 1 mile per plant HD. Will DC 14 + half the plant’s HD (DC 19 for the sample). Failure traps the soul in a vacant pod and gives the victim the podling quality. The attack is mind-affecting. Stop attempts for one day after a success. Each pod holds one soul, and no attempt is possible if all pods are occupied.
Dominate and duplicate. The combat text gives a separate on-site procedure. A humanoid entering the plant’s area must make a DC 25 Will save against its domination. On a failure the plant lures the victim into a pod that traps the soul, consumes the body at 1 HP per round, then releases a duplicate with the victim’s memories. The plant can use this domination through its clones to lure more victims.

gm.title: Podlings
lines: The plant controls a podling completely. The podling is otherwise immune to mind-affecting effects, retains its statistics and abilities except divinely granted powers, and acts as chaotic evil. Animal companions and similar bonds may detect the change. Starting 24 hours after capture, the podling loses 1d4 HP daily and cannot heal naturally. After piercing or slashing damage, it must make a Reflex save at DC 10 + damage or reveal its hollow interior. Witnesses may make a DC 15 Horror save. A podling that dies while enslaved has its life energy consumed, and only true resurrection can restore it.

gm.title: Dispersed Vines (Ex)
lines: Track HP per Hit Die. Put two HP from each HD into a shared vine and root pool and assign the rest of each die to its own pod. Area attacks deal full damage to each section in range. At 0 HP a pod deals nonlethal damage equal to its podling’s total HP + 10. At −10 HP the pod breaks, frees the soul, removes podling status, and costs the plant one HD. At 0 HP the vine pool stops pod communication and knocks out all podlings in the same way. At −10 HP the vines free every soul. The plant can also free all souls to feign destruction. Kill it by destroying the vine pool and every pod.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The combat paragraph gives DC 25 for dominating people in the patch. Mind Bondage has a separate range, target requirement, and DC formula. Both procedures are retained as printed.
For the listed 50 HP, use a 20-HP vine pool and ten 3-HP pods as a quick distribution. Per-HD rolls can vary individual pod HP.

lines:
Multiple Heads. The dracohydra starts with five heads. While it has more than one, it has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned or knocked unconscious. Whenever it takes 30 or more damage in one turn, one head dies. It dies if it loses all its heads. Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage cannot harm it. At the end of every turn it returns to full HP, but it crumbles to dust at 0 HP. Spellcasting. Cast one spell using Charisma (save DC 19, +11 to hit). These spells require no Material components. At will, Detect Magic and Ray of Sickness (level 2). Once per day each, Create Undead (level 8) and Finger of Death.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
3 uses, or 4 in its lair. Spend one use just after another creature's turn ends. All uses return at the start of the creature's turn. It cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.

Soul Drain. Creatures within 1 mile of the lair make Death Saving Throws with Disadvantage.
Both effects end immediately if the dracolich is destroyed or moves its lair. They resume if it gains a new body.

lines:

Rend. Melee attack +13, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 18 (2d10 + 7) slashing plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.
Necrotic Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 20 Constitution save, taking 52 (8d12) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma, save DC 19 and +11 to hit with spell attacks. The spells require no material components.
At will · Detect Magic, Ray of Sickness (2nd level).
1/day each · Create Undead (8th level), Finger of Death.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines:
The dracolich has 3 uses, or 4 in its lair. It can spend one immediately after another creature's turn and regains all uses at the start of its own turn.
Pounce. Move up to half its Speed and make a Rend attack.
Sickening Ray. Cast the 2nd-level version of Ray of Sickness. The dracolich can use this option only once before the start of its next turn.
Terrifying Presence. Each creature in a 30-ft. emanation from the dracolich makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure the creature takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage and becomes Frightened until the end of that creature's next turn. The dracolich can use this option only once before the start of its next turn.

gm.title: Regional Effects
lines:
Sapping Mist. Pale fog Lightly Obscures the region within 1 mile of the lair. Creatures other than the dracolich and its allies who finish a Long Rest there must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or gain 1 Exhaustion level.
Soul Drain. Within 1 mile of the lair, creatures have Disadvantage on Death Saving Throws.
The effects end immediately if the dracolich is destroyed or moves its lair. They resume if it gains a new body through the soul gem.

gm.title: Encounter
lines: A dracolich often occupies a corrupted version of the lair it held in life. Its soul gem allows it to return after defeat and can be hidden away from its hoard.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Huge and Gargantuan dracoliches use the same printed hit points and Hit Dice.

gm.title: Description
lines: A powerful draconian born from a magically warped dragon egg. It fights with a serrated blade and can take the shape of a slain humanoid.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Death Throes. At 0 hit points, the dreadnought burns to ash. Each creature within 10 ft. must pass a DC 13 Dexterity save or take 10 (3d6) fire damage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Serrated Sword attacks and one Tail attack.
Serrated Sword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit must pass a DC 14 Strength save or fall prone.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Shape Theft. After killing a Medium or smaller humanoid, the dreadnought can magically take on that creature’s look and feel. It retains its statistics except size. The change lasts until the dreadnought dies or spends an action to end it.

gm.title: Description
lines: A draconian scout and spy that scales walls and glides from heights. Two hits from its envenomed daggers can paralyze the same target.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Death Throes. At 0 HP, the draconian dissolves into acid. Each creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, acid coats it for 1 minute and deals 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can use an action to scrape or wash the acid off itself or another creature.
Glide. While falling and not incapacitated, subtract up to 100 ft. from the distance used to calculate falling damage. For each foot of descent, the draconian can also move up to 2 ft. horizontally.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Dagger attacks. If both hit the same creature, it must pass a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn. While poisoned by this attack it is also paralyzed.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

gm.title: Description
lines: A winged draconian spellcaster that fights with a trident or a ray of necrotic energy. Its bones explode when it dies.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Death Throes. At 0 HP, the draconian’s flesh and scales wither immediately and its bones explode. Each creature within 10 ft. must pass a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) force damage.
Glide. While falling and not incapacitated, subtract up to 100 ft. from the distance used to calculate falling damage. For each foot of descent, the draconian can also move up to 2 ft. horizontally.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Trident or Necrotic Ray for each.
Trident. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage on a melee hit made with two hands.
Necrotic Ray. Ranged spell attack, +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.
Spellcasting. Cast Enlarge/Reduce, Invisibility, or Stinking Cloud, each once per day. Spellcasting uses Charisma (save DC 12) and requires no material components.

gm.title: Description
lines: A cunning draconian that uses illusion and mobility to direct a fight. Its magic arcs between nearby creatures when it falls.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Death Throes. At 0 HP, lightning strikes the nearest creature within 30 ft., then arcs to up to two other creatures within 15 ft. of the first. Each target makes a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half the damage and avoids the stun.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three attacks, choosing Rend or Energy Ray for each.
Rend. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Energy Ray. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) force damage.
Noxious Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 21 (6d6) poison damage and gains one level of exhaustion. On a success, it takes half damage, avoids exhaustion, and is immune to Noxious Breath from all draconians for 24 hours.
Spellcasting. Cast Invisibility or Mage Hand at will, or Dimension Door, Disguise Self, or Sending twice per day each. Spellcasting uses Charisma (save DC 14) and requires no material components.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Magic Shield (3/day). When an attack roll hits the draconian, it can raise its AC by 5 against that attack, potentially turning the hit into a miss.

gm.title: Description
lines: The psychic remnant of a gem dragon. It can appear as a spectral dragon or inhabit a treasure as an intelligent magic item, steering its bearer toward unfinished business.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Acid and fire. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Deflection. The listed AC already includes the shard’s Intelligence modifier.
Incorporeal Movement. The shard treats creatures and objects as difficult terrain when moving through them. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the shard fails a saving throw, it can succeed instead.
Rejuvenation. At 0 HP, the shard disappears and leaves a Tiny cracked gemstone in its space. The gem matches the kind of dragon the shard once was. The gem has AC 20, 15 HP, and immunity to every damage type except force. After 1d20 days, an intact gem dissipates and the shard returns at full HP in that space or the nearest unoccupied space. Destroying the gem prevents its return.
Unusual Nature. The shard requires no air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Telekinetic Rend attacks.
Telekinetic Rend. Melee or ranged spell attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d8 + 6) force damage.
Inhabit Object. The shard disappears into a visible, nonsentient object of Medium size or smaller within 30 ft. Use the shard’s AC for the object and apply damage to the shard’s HP. Possession ends if the shard uses an action to leave, is turned, reaches 0 HP, or an effect such as Dispel Evil and Good ends the possession. The shard reappears in the nearest unoccupied space when it leaves. The inhabited object becomes a magic item if it was not one already, and a Tiny cracked gemstone of the shard’s ancestral kind appears on it. The shard can fly the object at its own flying speed, use its senses, speak aloud or telepathically, cast spells, and use legendary actions. If a creature wears or carries the object, the shard can give that creature resistance to psychic damage and an extra 1d8 force damage each time an attack hits.
Psychic Crush (Recharge 5–6). Each creature the shard chooses in a 60-ft.-radius sphere centered on the shard makes a DC 20 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, it takes 55 (10d10) psychic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and avoids the stun.
Spellcasting (Psionics). Cast Detect Thoughts, Invisibility, or Telekinesis at will. Spellcasting uses Intelligence (save DC 20) and requires no components.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The shard gets three legendary actions and regains them at the start of its turn. It can use one option at a time, at the end of another creature’s turn.
Rend (1 action). Make one Telekinetic Rend attack.
Cast a Spell (2 actions). Use Spellcasting.
Commanding Thought (2 actions). One creature the shard can see within 30 ft. must pass a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the end of its next turn. While charmed, it moves and acts as the shard directs telepathically. On its turn, its only action options are Dash and Attack, and the shard chooses the target of any Attack.

lines: Any terrain and activity cycle. Very rare. Solitary, appearing alone. No diet or treasure. Neutral, or matches the bearer. Intelligence High (13–14). Size Medium, 6 ft. tall. Morale Champion (15–16). Magic resistance 15%.

gm.title: Bearer benefits

gm.title: Heraldic servant rules
lines:
Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.
A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.
Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.
An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.
The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The servant’s fire breath lists damage and uses but gives no area or save details. The sword’s +1/+3 notation is retained as printed.

gm.title: Description
lines: Once a dwarf, Fafnir turned on his family over the cursed ring Andvaranaut. He now guards his hoard in secluded hillside or cliff caves, moving whenever he suspects someone might find it.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Perception 15, Stealth 16. Darkvision 60 ft. and keensense 60 ft. Languages Common, Draconic, Dwarven, and Northern Tongue.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: Str +6, Dex +6, Con +5, Int +0, Wis +1, Cha -1

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Armor of Greed (3/day). Fafnir can turn a hit against him into a miss. A critical hit costs two uses. Each use grants advantage on attacks against Fafnir through the end of his next turn.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Fafnir fails a save, he can succeed instead.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Bite attacks, replacing one with Constrict if desired.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing plus 11 (2d10) poison damage.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A Huge or smaller creature is Grappled (escape DC 18) and Restrained while the grapple lasts. Fafnir cannot use Constrict on another target while holding it.
Misfortune Breath (recharge 4–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. line, 5 ft. wide, makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. Failure deals 31 (7d8) poison damage and makes the creature Poisoned through the end of Fafnir’s next turn. Success halves the damage and avoids the condition.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines:
Fafnir can spend 3 legendary actions per round, one option at the end of another creature’s turn. He regains them at the start of his turn.
Entrap. Move up to half speed and make one Constrict attack.
Toxic Blood Spray (costs 2 actions; 241 HP or fewer). Each creature within 20 ft. of Fafnir makes a DC 17 Constitution save. Failure deals 10 (4d4) poison damage and makes the creature Poisoned through the end of its next turn.
Inflame Greed (costs 2 actions). Cast Compel Avarice (Wisdom, DC 13) with verbal and somatic components, without material components or concentration. Choose a visible object and target one creature within 30 ft. On a failed save it tries to steal the object, fights its holder if theft fails, or flees the others to guard it once acquired. The effect lasts up to 1 minute. A creature immune to Charmed automatically succeeds.

gm.title: Lair Actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, use one option. Fafnir cannot repeat the same option in consecutive rounds.
Distracting Gleam. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Each creature within 20 ft. of the point makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. A failure bars reactions and bonus actions for up to 1 minute, until Fafnir uses this option again, or until he dies. Affected creatures repeat the save at the end of each turn to end it.
Grasping Tentacles. Target up to three creatures Fafnir can see within 120 ft. Each makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or becomes Restrained by tentacles. Any creature, including a target, can spend an action and pass a DC 15 Strength check to free a target.
Treasure Whirlwind. A visible point within 120 ft. becomes the center of a 15-ft.-diameter whirlwind. Each creature entering it for the first time on a turn or starting a turn there makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. It lasts 1 minute, until Fafnir uses this option again, or until he dies.

gm.title: Regional Effects
lines:
The region can have any of these effects. They fade 1d10 days after Fafnir leaves or dies.
Avariciousness. Within 1 mile, creatures guard their things, covet others’ belongings, and have disadvantage on saves against effects that compel theft or taking an object.
Familial Strife. Within 5 miles, creatures become hostile toward relatives. Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion) checks to get someone to harm a relative have advantage.
Increased Mishaps. Within 1 mile, checks and saves to avoid injury while climbing, jumping pits, or otherwise risking an accident have disadvantage.

gm.title: Description
lines: A saurial swordsman who helps Artus Cimber search Chult. He communicates his feelings through scents and willingly puts himself in danger to help a friend.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands Common but cannot speak it. His native clicks and whistles are above the human hearing range.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Divine Health. Dragonbait is immune to disease.
Magic Resistance Aura. While Dragonbait holds his Holy Avenger Longsword, he and friendly creatures within 10 feet of him have advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two melee weapon attacks.
Holy Avenger (+3 Longsword). Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage when wielded in one hand, or 10 (1d10 + 5) in two hands. Against a fiend or undead, the hit also deals 11 (2d10) radiant damage.
Sense Alignment. Choose a visible creature within 60 feet and learn its alignment. This fails if magic shields that creature from divination.

gm.title: Encounter context
lines:
Dragonbait met Artus Cimber in Port Nyanzaru and helps him look for his wife, Alisanda. If Artus agrees to destroy the Soulmonger, Dragonbait joins him. He has never been to Omu and cannot guide the party there.
Scent cues. Brimstone signals confusion, roses sadness, lemon joy, bread anger, violets fear or danger, honeysuckle concern, wood smoke devotion, tar triumph, and ham worry.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Tomb of Annihilation, Appendix D, pp. 217–218. The stat block is on p. 218.

gm.title: Description
lines: An alchemical accident that gave congealed dragon blood a will of its own. It can briefly shape itself like a dragon before collapsing into a heap.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, prone, restrained.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Blindsight 120 ft. The ooze is blind beyond that radius.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands Draconic and its creator’s languages. It cannot speak.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amorphous. The ooze fits through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Spider Climb. The ooze can climb difficult surfaces and cross ceilings upside down without a check.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Pseudopod attacks, or replace one with Slime Breath when available.
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) acid damage. A Large or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 15) and takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns until the grapple ends.
Slime Breath (Recharge 6). The ooze ejects part of its body in a 30-ft. cone. Each creature in the cone makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d10) acid damage and is pulled up to 30 ft. straight toward the ooze. On a success, it takes half damage and stays where it is.

gm.title: Description
lines: A dragon animates the etched bones of defeated rivals and binds them with adamantine wire to make a lair guardian.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands Draconic and its creator’s languages. It cannot speak.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Fear Aura. When a creature of the golem’s choice starts its turn within 20 ft., it makes a DC 15 Wisdom save unless the golem is incapacitated. A failure leaves it frightened until the start of its next turn. A success grants 24 hours of immunity to this golem’s aura.
Magic Resistance. The golem makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Unusual Nature. The golem needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Pinion attack and two Rend attacks.
Pinion. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit is pinned and restrained. Each of the golem’s two pinions can restrain one creature. An occupied pinion cannot attack. At the start of its turn, the restrained creature can free itself with a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check.
Rend. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.
Petrifying Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 15 Constitution save. A failure deals 35 (10d6) poison damage and restrains the creature while it starts to turn to stone. The restrained creature repeats the save at the end of its next turn. The effect ends on a success and petrifies it on a failure.

gm.title: Actions

lines: These platinum-winged knights champion Bahamut. Some serve orders that protect people from evil dragons.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Legendary Resistance (1/day). After failing a saving throw, the dragonborn can succeed instead.

gm.title: Actions
lines:

Once per turn, the dragonborn can make the sword flare on a hit. The target then makes a DC 14 Constitution save or is blinded until the start of the dragonborn’s next turn.
Healing Touch (1/day). Touch another creature within 5 ft. It magically regains 40 hit points, and the touch removes every disease and poison affecting it.
Radiant Breath (Recharge 6). Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 15 Dexterity save. On a failure, a creature takes 44 (8d10) radiant damage. On a success, it takes half. gm.title: Description
lines: These psionic champions believe that Sardior’s essence survives in gem dragons. Many belong to the Inheritors of the First World and can lift themselves through the air by telekinesis.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (1/day). After failing a saving throw, the dragonborn can succeed instead.
Mental Defense. While unarmored, the dragonborn adds its Intelligence modifier to its Armor Class.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Mind Blade attacks.
Mind Blade. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Heat Breath (Recharge 6). Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 14 Constitution save, taking 27 (6d8) fire damage on a failure or half on a success. Metal objects in the cone stay red-hot until the end of the dragonborn’s next turn. A creature that starts its turn in physical contact with one of these objects makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 9 (2d8) fire damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn.

gm.title: Description
lines: Often called Talons of Tiamat, these champions seek to free the Dragon Queen from Avernus. Some work with the Cult of the Dragon.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Legendary Resistance (1/day). After failing a saving throw, the dragonborn can succeed instead.

gm.title: Actions
lines:

Greataxe. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (1d12 + 5) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.
Necrotic Breath (Recharge 6). Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, a creature takes 36 (8d8) necrotic damage and is frightened of the dragonborn for 1 minute. On a success, it takes half damage and avoids the fear. A frightened creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the fear on a success.

gm.title: Description
lines: A sorcerer who turned to blood magic for revenge. In battle he uses it to pin enemies down and keep the Hallowed Dark alive.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Studded leather. Saves Dex +11, Con +7, Int +11. Skills Arcana +11, Investigation +11. Resists acid and necrotic damage. Blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 10. Common and Draconic.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Exploit Opening (3/day). Gain advantage on an attack roll Draven makes.
Profane Sacrifice (1/turn). After hitting a creature with a melee attack, Draven can reduce its speed to 0 until the start of his next turn. He takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage if he does.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Gloom Dagger attacks.
Gloom Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +11, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 10 (1d4 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) necrotic damage. Draven can move the target up to 10 ft. horizontally. If this attack reduces a creature to 0 HP, he regains one use of Blood of the Dragon.
Blood of the Dragon (1/day). Choose up to three creatures Draven can see within 60 ft. Each takes 33 (6d10) necrotic damage. On a failed DC 19 Constitution save, it also falls Prone and is Poisoned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the poisoning.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Creeping Dread. Choose a creature Draven can see within 30 ft. in dim light or darkness. On a failed DC 19 Wisdom save, it moves its speed in a direction Draven chooses. Advantage on saves against becoming Frightened applies here, and a creature immune to Frightened succeeds automatically.

gm.title: Utility Spells
lines: Intelligence, spell save DC 19. At will: Alarm and Mage Hand. Once per day each: Glyph of Warding and Scrying. Mage Hand takes an action. Use each other spell’s normal casting time.

gm.title: Villain Party Action
lines:
Hallowed Dark. Once per encounter for each party action, after an enemy finishes its turn. The party can use the actions in any order, one per round. The creature performing the action must be present and must not be Incapacitated.
Action 4, Blood Drain. Choose an enemy Draven can see within 60 ft. It makes a DC 19 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 27 (5d10) necrotic damage and is Dazed until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and is not Dazed. Draven divides healing equal to twice the necrotic damage dealt between himself and any member of the Hallowed Dark he can see within 60 ft.

gm.title: Dazed (MCDM)
lines: On each turn, a Dazed creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action. It chooses only one. Its turn ends if it becomes Dazed during that turn. It can still take extra actions granted by effects such as Haste or Action Surge. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration remove Dazed.

gm.title: Shared dread cloaker rules
lines:
Printed source. Cloaker, Dread, p. 51.
Damage reduction (Su). A cloaker draped around its host shares its damage reduction against physical attacks other than area attacks.
Engulf (Ex). As a standard action, the cloaker envelops a creature at least one size category smaller. Its host is engulfed automatically. Any other target requires a successful grapple check without provoking an attack of opportunity. The target is pinned. A cloaker without a host gains +4 to bite the engulfed creature.
Split damage from attacks that hit an engulfing cloaker equally between it and its victim. Area spells deal full damage to both. A shadow or undead cloaker can still strike other targets with its tail while engulfing a creature.

gm.title: Description
lines: Clans replace members of wealthy households one at a time. A cornered impostor may fake its death to keep the rest of the clan hidden.

gm.title: Other statistics

Bluff +12, Disguise +12, Listen +11, Sense Motive +6, Spot +8. Alertness, Dodge. Any land or underground, especially Paridon. Solitary, pair, or clan of 4–12. Double standard treasure. Usually neutral evil. Advances by class.

gm.title: Actions

Full attack. Two slams +6 melee (1d6+2 each). It can instead use the weapons of its assumed identity.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Change Shape (Su). Assume the shape of any Small or Medium humanoid and keep it indefinitely.
Detect Thoughts (Su). Works continuously as the spell at caster level 18th, Will DC 14 negates. Suppress or resume it as a free action.
Glamer (Su). As a free action, change the look and texture of an object it carries without changing its underlying material. The object reverts at a separation of 5 ft. or more.
Immune to sleep and charm effects.

gm.title: Disguise checks

gm.title: Table notes

gm.title: Description
lines: Ravenloft produces corrupted elementals of blood, grave earth, mist, and pyre fire. Each has six printed size tiers.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: Choose the kind of elemental and its size tier, then use that profile. All four use elemental traits and the Mists subtype. They understand speech but never speak. Free-willed dread elementals resent their conjurers and look for a chance to turn on them.

Grave Elemental

gm.title: Dread elemental rules
lines:
Printed source. Elemental, Dread, p. 63, and Mists subtype, pp. 7–8.
In Ravenloft, calling a standard elemental has a 20% chance of producing a dread elemental. Summoning magic always produces the dread form. Accidental dread elementals are uncontrolled, and the Dark Powers supply the matching materials. Intentional conjuring requires the matching material and uses the usual chance for the elemental to break control.
Dread elementals understand speech but do not communicate. Their Mists subtype makes them native throughout Ravenloft and allows them to be summoned in any domain. A dismissed dread elemental returns to Ravenloft itself, so the realm's restrictions on calling do not break the calling pact.

gm.title: Description
lines: A succubus has taken control of the printed fighter. It can imitate the host’s ordinary life until its wings and infernal features give it away.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Medium outsider (augmented humanoid), transposed 6th-level human fighter example

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. +1 longsword +13 melee for 1d8 + 8, claw +11 melee for 1d4 + 5, or shortbow +11 ranged for 1d6/×3.
Full attack. +1 longsword +13 with bite +6 for 1d6 + 5, two claws +11 with bite +6, or shortbow +11.
Smite Good (Su, 1/day). Add 6 damage to a normal melee attack against a good foe.
Spell-like abilities. Charm person at will. Darkness 3/day. Desecrate and unholy blight 1/day each. CL 6, Charisma-based saves.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DR 5/magic, darkvision 60 ft., immune to poison, acid/cold/electricity/fire resistance 10, SR 16. Dread fiends summoned into Ravenloft cannot return to their plane when the spell ends.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +7. AC +5 Dex, +1 natural, +4 chain shirt. Touch 15, flat-footed 15. BAB/grapple +6/+11, space/reach 5 ft./5 ft., Fort +10, Ref +7, Will +2.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Climb +7, Craft (woodworking) +2, Handle Animal +2, Intimidate +7, Jump +7, Ride +8, Swim +7. Blind-Fight, Combat Reflexes, Improved Initiative, Mounted Combat, Weapon Focus and Weapon Specialization (longsword). Solitary, always evil, double standard treasure.

gm.title: Applying the encounter template
lines: A complete transposition replaces the host’s agency and changes the host to outsider. The host must be living, corporeal, nongood and Int 4+. Keep size, Hit Dice, BAB and saves. Add +1 natural armor, two claws and a bite, magical natural weapons, and flight at land speed (average) only if wings function. Smite adds HD damage (max +20). DR increases to 10/magic at 12 HD, SR is HD +10 (max 35). Modifiers Str +4, Dex +4, Con +2, Int +4, Cha +2. Increase CR by 1 at up to 4 HD, by 2 at 5–10 HD, or by 3 at 11+ HD.

gm.title: Template powers
lines: If Int or Wis is at least 8, gain cumulative Charisma-based abilities at CL equal to HD. At 1 HD darkness 3/day; 3 desecrate; 5 unholy blight; 7 poison 3/day; 9 contagion; 11 blasphemy; 13 unholy aura 3/day and unhallow; 15 horrid wilting; 17 summon monster IX (fiends only); 19 destruction. Default is 1/day.

gm.title: Possessing fiend options
lines: Balor grants see invisibility at will and fire that deals 2d6 per round to anyone touching it, with −4 Cha. Erinyes grants cause fear at will and +4 Cha. Pit fiend grants +2 Str and injury poison at Fortitude DC 27, initially 1d6 Con and then death. Succubus grants charm person at will and +4 Cha.

gm.title: Natural attack damage by size
lines: Bite/claw: Fine 1/none; Diminutive 1d2/1; Tiny 1d3/1d2; Small 1d4/1d3; Medium 1d6/1d4; Large 1d8/1d6; Huge 2d6/1d8; Gargantuan 3d6/2d6; Colossal 4d6/3d6. The full attack can use two claws and a secondary bite, or a weapon and secondary bite plus a claw if it has a free hand.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The book supplies Hit Dice but does not print a fixed HP total. Roll 6d10 + 24. The printed HP dice and initiative do not follow directly from the listed abilities and feats.

gm.title: Description
lines: The seams in the golem’s skin reveal where its creator stitched the body together.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +2. AC −1 size, +2 Dex, +12 natural. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 21. Base attack +9, grapple +14. Space 10 ft., reach 10 ft. Fort +3, Ref +2, Will +3.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Slam +14 melee for 2d8 + 5. Full attack makes two slams, each for the same damage and bonus.
Berserk (Ex). Each round in combat, the cumulative chance of going berserk increases by 1 percentage point. A berserk golem attacks the nearest creature or object, then moves on to the next. Its creator can make a DC 29 Charisma check within 60 ft. to regain control and reset the chance to 0%.
Constrict (Ex). A successful grapple check deals 2d8 + 5 damage.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Damage reduction 5/adamantine or magic. Darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision and disease immunity. Its own stat block specifically lists vulnerability to poison, level drain and gases.
Magic Immunity (Ex). Immune to spells and spell-like abilities that allow spell resistance. Magical cold or fire slows the golem for 2d6 rounds. Electrical magic clears this slowing effect and restores 1 HP for every 3 damage the spell would have dealt. It can gain temporary HP this way and makes no electricity save. Only acid or fire can destroy it permanently.
Regeneration (Ex). It regains 1 HP per hour even while active. Below 0 HP it goes dormant and stops recovering. A strong electrical shock can wake it after its flesh is repaired.
Fear of fire. It tries to stay 10 ft. away from small fires and 25 ft. from larger ones. It takes a −4 penalty on Fear saves involving fire.
Construct traits. Immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, disease and similar effects. Critical hits, nonlethal damage, ability damage, energy drain and death from massive damage do not affect it, subject to the exceptions below.

gm.title: Dread golem commands
lines: The creator can give commands from within 60 ft. if the golem can see and hear them. It follows the last command and responds to attacks against it. Some dread golems act independently.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Climb +12, Hide +7, Jump +11, Listen +5, Move Silently +7, Spot +6, Survival +6, Swim +10. Alertness, Blind-Fight, Dodge.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any terrain in Lamordia. Solitary or gang of 2–4, usually neutral, no treasure. Advances to 13–18 HD (Large) or 19–27 HD (Huge).

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Use the printed 49 HP and +14 grapple. Treat the flesh golem’s listed vulnerabilities as exceptions to the general construct traits. The printing does not give a separate numerical multiplier for fire or acid.

gm.title: Description
lines: The maker shapes a body, but the dark desires behind the work bring the construct to life. Some dread golems develop wills of their own.

gm.title: Running the encounter

gm.title: Construct defenses
lines: Dread golems are immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, disease, and similar effects. They ignore critical hits, nonlethal damage, ability damage, energy drain, and death from massive damage. Their magic immunity blocks spells except where the chosen golem's profile lists an exception.

Flaming Hooves (Su). A hoof hit ignites combustible material.
Frightful Presence (Ex). Stomp and belch smoke. Affected creatures make a DC 15 Fear save or become frightened for 5d6 rounds.
Smoke (Su). In battle, snort a 15-ft. cone. A creature caught in it makes a DC 16 Fortitude save or takes a −3 morale penalty on attack and damage rolls until 1d6 minutes after leaving. The nightmare has concealment against creatures 5 ft. away and total concealment against creatures 10 ft. away. It sees through its smoke and can suppress it as a free action.

gm.title: Description
lines: A wronged spirit wears straw and a pumpkin head to hunt down the people it blames.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +0. AC +2 natural. Touch AC 10, flat-footed AC 12. Base attack +2, grapple +3. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +1, Ref +1, Will +3.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Slam +3 melee (1d4 + 1). Full attack. Two slams +3 melee (1d4 + 1 each) or one scythe +3 melee (2d4 + 1, ×4 critical).
Stinging Curse (Ex). A creature hit in melee must pass a DC 13 Fortitude save or attract a swarm of insects. Stings automatically deal 1d4 damage in round one, with another 1d4 added to the damage each round. Each round of stings also adds a cumulative −1 circumstance penalty to attack and damage rolls. The stings continue until remove curse or death.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Construct traits, damage reduction 5/magic, cold immunity, electricity resistance 5, and fire vulnerability. It understands languages known in life but cannot speak. Someone who knew the living spirit can recognize its changing face with a DC 20 Spot check.

gm.title: Skills and tactics
lines: Listen +2, Spot +2. It usually pursues its chosen victims and never retreats. Solitary, usually neutral evil, and found on temperate or warm farmland. No treasure.

gm.title: Description
lines: A dread wight can pass for the person it once was until it gets close. Greater dread wights send their lesser kin into the fight first.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Any land or underground. Solitary, gang of 2–5, or pack of 6–11. Always lawful evil. No treasure. Common advancement 6–9 HD (Medium).

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +2. AC +2 Dex and +5 natural. Touch 12, flat-footed 15. Base attack +2, grapple +4. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +1, Ref +3, Will +5.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Climb +8, Hide +10, Listen +8, Move Silently +20, Search +7, Spot +8. Blind-Fight, Toughness. Dread wights have a +8 racial bonus on Move Silently, already reflected in the listed modifier.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Slam +5 melee for 1d6 + 3 plus energy drain.
Energy Drain (Su). A living creature hit by the slam gains one negative level. Use DC 14 for the later Fortitude save to remove it.
Create Spawn (Su). A humanoid slain by the wight rises as a dread wight in 1d4 rounds. It loses its former abilities and serves its creator until that creator dies.

gm.title: Greater dread wight
lines:
Large Undead, CR 6. 10d12 + 3 (68 HP), initiative +2, speed 40 ft. (8 squares), AC 20 (−1 size, +2 Dex, +9 natural), touch 11, flat-footed 18. Base attack +5, grapple +12. Use the printed 5-ft. space and 10-ft. reach. Fort +3, Ref +5, Will +9. Str 25, Dex 14, Int 13, Wis 14, Cha 17. Climb +12, Hide +10, Intimidate +8, Listen +10, Move Silently +22, Search +10, Spot +10. Blind-Fight, Cleave, Power Attack, Toughness. DR 10/magic, +1 turn resistance, and undead traits. Advancement 11–14 HD (Large).
Slam +12 melee for 1d8 + 10 plus energy drain, or make two such slams as a full attack. Each hit on a living creature applies one negative level, Fortitude DC 18 to remove. As for a common dread wight, humanoid victims rise in 1d4 rounds. A giant slain by the greater wight becomes a greater dread wight. It controls its spawn until destroyed.

gm.title: Description
lines: These shapeshifters feed on fear in the Veil of Sleep and use a dreamer's memories to decide what shape to take.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: A gray morph plays a minor part in the nightmare and flees when challenged. A shadow morph directs the dream and uses its howl to paralyze foes. An ennui stalks vivid nightmares and can turn invisible. Use the chosen form's profile. If a dream spawn kills a dreamer in the dreamscape, the dreamer makes a Madness save on waking. The DC is 10 + half the spawn's Hit Dice + its Wisdom modifier.

gm.title: Shared actions
lines: Alternate Form works as polymorph on itself at caster level 8 and takes a standard action. It lasts indefinitely, and the spawn can return to its own form as a free action. In its dreamscape, it reads surface thoughts as if it had studied each creature for three rounds with detect thoughts. Caster level equals its Hit Dice and the save DC is Wisdom-based. Once per day, Memory Drain inflicts 1d4 Intelligence damage with a touch. Until the victim recovers all the lost Intelligence, the spawn can mimic creatures from their memories.

gm.title: Lullaby and Fear Eater
lines: Lullaby is a standard action. Foes within 20 ft. make a DC 14 Will save or become fatigued for 1d4 rounds, or for as long as the spawn stays within 20 ft. and maintains its chant as a free action. This is a sonic, mind-affecting compulsion. Dream spawn are immune to fear, horror, and madness. A spell that would cause one of these effects heals the spawn 1 HP per spell level. If the spawn makes a dreamer fail one of these saves, it heals 2 HP for a minor effect, 4 HP for a moderate effect, or 8 HP for a major effect.
