gm.title: Description
lines: These small spiders spin dreams. The pale ones bring rest, while black ones weave nightmares. Both communicate only through dreams.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +7. AC components +3 Dex, +4 size. Touch AC 17, flat-footed AC 14. Base attack +0, grapple −14. Space 1 ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +2, Ref +5, Will +2.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Bite +3 melee (1d2 − 2 plus poison).
Poison (Ex). DC 11 Fortitude. Initial damage 1d6 Wisdom, secondary damage 2d6 Wisdom. At Wisdom 0, the victim cannot be awakened until their Wisdom goes above 0.
Web (Su). It spins around sleepers within 50 ft. A light dreamweaver relieves Ravenloft’s nightmares horror effect. A sleeper free of that effect gains a full night’s rest in four hours. A dark dreamweaver imposes the nightmares effect while the creature sleeps near its silk.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Natural sunlight causes it to fade away permanently. It fights only when cornered.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Hide +10, Move Silently +6, Spot +2. Feat: Improved Initiative.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any land or underground, usually in dreams. Solitary, colony (2–5), or swarm (6–11). Usually a colony has only light or only dark dreamweavers. Always lawful neutral. No treasure.

gm.title: Nightmares
lines: The victim is shaken for 5d6 rounds. Each attempt to sleep ends after 5d6 minutes, preventing rest, natural healing, and recovery of arcane spells. Each full day without rest adds a cumulative −1 morale penalty to attack rolls, saves, skill checks, and ability checks, up to −4. A sleep spell allows dreamless rest and clears the accumulated penalties, but the nightmares return on nights without it. Elves are normally immune. The optional waking dream during meditation instead works like major image and permits a Will save to disbelieve. See Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, p. 81.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The attack lines assign poison to the bite. The poison paragraph calls it a sting but gives no separate sting attack.
Nightmares refers to the horror effect in the Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, Chapter Three.

lines: Abyssal. Telepathy 60 ft. with creatures that understand Abyssal.

lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claws attack.

Fetid Cloud (1/day). Gas extends 10 ft. from the dretch, spreads around corners, and lightly obscures its area. It lasts 1 minute or until a strong wind disperses it. A creature that starts its turn in the cloud makes a DC 11 Constitution save or becomes Poisoned until the start of its next turn. While Poisoned by the cloud, it may take either an action or a bonus action on its turn and cannot take reactions.

gm.title: Abyssal return
lines: A demon killed outside the Abyss dissolves and reforms there immediately. Killing it in the Abyss destroys it permanently unless it has protected its essence with a demonic amulet.

gm.title: Description
lines: A devotee of Lolth who draws magic from the Demonweb Pits and can take the form of a large spider.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Elvish, Undercommon, can speak with spiders.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Fey Ancestry. The creature has advantage on saves to avoid being charmed. Magic cannot put it to sleep.
Spider Climb. The drow climbs difficult surfaces, including ceilings while upside down, without making an ability check.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on sight.
Web Walker. Webbing does not restrict the drow’s movement.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using any combination of Bite, Poisonous Touch, and Web that the current form allows. Spellcasting can replace one of those attacks.
Bite (spider form only). Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 31 (7d8) poison damage on a failure or half on a success. If this poison damage drops the target to 0 hit points, it is stable and poisoned for 1 hour, even if it regains hit points. While poisoned this way, it is also paralyzed.
Poisonous Touch (humanoid form only). Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 35 (10d6) poison damage.
Web (spider form only, recharge 5–6). Ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. A hit restrains the target in webbing. The target can spend an action to break the webbing with a successful DC 15 Strength check. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10, 5 hit points, vulnerable to fire damage and immune to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one spell without material components using Intelligence (spell save DC 17).
At will. Dancing Lights, Mage Hand.
1/day each. Darkness, Dispel Magic, Etherealness, Faerie Fire, Fly, Insect Plague, Invisibility.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Change Shape (recharges after a short or long rest). Magically become a Large spider for up to 1 hour or return to true form. Only size changes. The drow can speak and cast spells as a spider. Anything worn or carried in humanoid form merges into the spider, and the drow cannot use or benefit from it in that form. Death restores the drow’s humanoid form.

lines: A priest of Lolth appointed to uncover treachery. Within the noble houses, drow matron mothers are the inquisitor’s only equals in authority.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Medium humanoid (cleric, elf), typically neutral evil

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Discern Lie. The drow recognizes a spoken lie from a creature in earshot if the drow knows the language.
Fey Ancestry. The creature has advantage on saves to avoid being charmed. Magic cannot put it to sleep.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on sight.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Death Lance attacks.
Death Lance. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage and 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. Reduce the target’s hit point maximum by the necrotic damage it actually took. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its maximum drops to 0.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one spell without material components using Charisma (spell save DC 18).
At will. Dancing Lights, Detect Magic, Message, Thaumaturgy.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Spectral Dagger (recharges after a short or long rest). Conjure a floating dagger within 60 ft. The drow can make a melee spell attack, +10 to hit, against one creature within 5 ft. of the dagger. A hit deals 9 (1d8 + 5) force damage. The dagger lasts 1 minute. On later turns, the drow can use a bonus action to move it up to 20 ft. and repeat the attack against one creature within 5 ft. of it.

gm.title: Variant action
lines: Summon Demon (1/day). The inquisitor magically attempts to summon a yochlol with a 50 percent chance of success. On a failure, the inquisitor takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage. On a success, the yochlol appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft., acts as the inquisitor’s ally, and cannot summon other demons. It remains for 10 minutes or until either creature dies or the inquisitor dismisses it as an action.

gm.title: Description
lines: A priestess of Lolth who leads a noble drow house. A Drow Favored Consort and Drow House Captain usually accompany her.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Medium humanoid (drow elf, cleric), typically neutral evil

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Fey Ancestry. The drow has advantage on saves against being charmed. Magic can't put the drow to sleep.
Special Equipment. The matron mother wields a Tentacle Rod.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on sight.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Demon Staff attacks, or one Demon Staff attack and three Tentacle Rod attacks.
Demon Staff. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage with one hand or 8 (1d8 + 4) with two. Add 14 (4d6) psychic damage either way. The target must pass a DC 19 Wisdom save or be frightened of the matron mother for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
Tentacle Rod. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. A hit deals 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage. Three rod hits on the same turn force a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, for 1 minute the creature's speed is halved, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saves, and it can't take reactions. On each of its turns it can take an action or a bonus action, but only one. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end all these effects.
Divine Flame (2/day). Place a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high column of fire within 120 ft. Each creature in it makes a DC 20 Dexterity save, taking 14 (4d6) fire plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failure or half of each on a success.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one of these spells using Charisma (spell save DC 20). Material components are waived.
At will. Command, Dancing Lights, Detect Magic, Thaumaturgy.
2/day each. Banishment, Blade Barrier, Cure Wounds, Hold Person, Plane Shift, Silence.
1/day each. Clairvoyance, Darkness, Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Faerie Fire, Gate, Levitate (self only), Suggestion.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines:
Lolth's Fickle Favor. Choose one ally she can see within 30 ft. The ally takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage and gains advantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
Summon Servant (1/day). Magically summon a Glabrezu or Yochlol to an unoccupied space within 60 ft. It fights as an ally and can't summon other demons. It stays for 10 minutes, until it or the matron mother dies, or until she spends an action to dismiss it.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The matron mother has 3 legendary actions. She can use one option at the end of another creature's turn, paying its listed cost. Spent actions return at the start of her turn. She can't use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, she must finish her first turn before using them.
Compel Demon (1 action). An allied demon within 30 ft. uses its reaction to attack once against a target she chooses and can see.
Demon Staff (1 action). Make one Demon Staff attack.
Cast a Spell (2 actions). Use Spellcasting.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
The matron mother's palace is her lair. A temple to Lolth also qualifies while she is inside, provided she still follows Lolth and no other matron mother is present. If two or more matron mothers gather in such a temple, none can use its lair actions.
On initiative count 20, losing ties, she can use one option in her lair. She must be able to act. If surprised, she can act on count 20 only after her first turn. She can't choose the same option in consecutive rounds.
Perceive Interlopers. Until initiative count 20 in the next round, hostile creatures in the lair can't become hidden from her and get no benefit from invisibility against her.
Spectral Web. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Each creature within 60 ft. of it must pass a DC 19 Dexterity save or be restrained for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
Telekinetic Throw. Choose a visible creature within 60 ft. On a failed DC 19 Strength save, it flies 2d6 × 10 ft. through the air. If it strikes a solid object, it takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage per 10 ft. moved. Apply normal falling damage if released in midair.

lines: A matron mother who renounces Lolth can have any alignment and loses Lolth's Fickle Favor, Summon Servant, and Compel Demon.

gm.title: Printed source

gm.title: References
lines: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 104 · https://5e.tools/bestiary.html#drow%20matron%20mother_mpmm

gm.title: Description
lines: The ruling priestess of a drow noble house, backed by high cleric magic, summoned servants, and Lolth’s uncertain favor.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Fey Ancestry. The drow has advantage on saves against being charmed and is immune to magical sleep.
Magic Resistance. The drow makes saving throws against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls and sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Lolth’s Fickle Favor. Choose one ally the matron can see within 30 ft. The ally takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage and gains advantage on the next attack roll it makes by the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make either two Demon Staff attacks or three Tentacle Rod attacks.
Demon Staff. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) with two hands, and 14 (4d6) psychic damage. The target must pass a DC 19 Wisdom save or be frightened of the matron for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Tentacle Rod. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage. If the rod hits a target three times during one turn, that target must pass a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, its speed is halved, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it cannot take reactions for 1 minute. On each of its turns during that time, it can take only one action or one bonus action. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Summon Servant (1/day). Magically summon a Retriever or a Yochlol in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. The servant acts as the matron’s ally and cannot summon other demons. It departs after 10 minutes, if it or the matron dies, or if the matron dismisses it as an action.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The matron has 3 legendary actions and regains all spent actions at the start of her turn. She can choose one option at the end of another creature’s turn. She cannot use these actions if incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, she can use them after completing her first turn.
Demon Staff (1 action). Make one Demon Staff attack.
Compel Demon (2 actions). One allied demon within 30 ft. spends its reaction to make one attack against a target the matron chooses and can see.
Cast a Spell (1–3 actions). Expend a spell slot to cast a prepared 1st-, 2nd-, or 3rd-level spell. The cost is one legendary action per level of the spell.

gm.title: Innate spellcasting
lines:
Charisma sets the innate spell save DC at 20. The spells require no material components.
At will. Dancing Lights, Detect Magic.
1/day each. Clairvoyance, Darkness, Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Faerie Fire, Levitate (self only), Suggestion.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
The drow casts as a 20th-level cleric using Wisdom (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Guidance, Mending, Resistance, Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy.
1st level (4 slots). Bane, Command, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt.
2nd level (3 slots). Hold Person, Silence, Spiritual Weapon.
3rd level (3 slots). Bestow Curse, Clairvoyance, Dispel Magic, Spirit Guardians.
4th level (3 slots). Banishment, Death Ward, Freedom of Movement, Guardian of Faith.
5th level (3 slots). Contagion, Flame Strike, Geas, Mass Cure Wounds.
6th level (2 slots). Blade Barrier, Harm.
7th level (2 slots). Divine Word, Plane Shift.
8th level (1 slot). Holy Aura.
9th level (1 slot). Gate.

lines: Innate Spellcasting. The dryad’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). The dryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. Speak with Beasts and Plants. The dryad can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language. Tree Stride. Once on her turn, the dryad can use 10 feet of her movement to step magically into one living tree within her reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or bigger.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Club. Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit (+6 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh. Fey Charm. The dryad targets one humanoid or beast that she can see within 30 feet of her. If the target can see the dryad, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed. The charmed creature regards the dryad as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn’t under the dryad’s control, it takes the dryad’s requests or actions in the most favorable way it can. Each time the dryad or its allies do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the dryad dies, is on a different plane of existence from the target, or ends the effect as a bonus action. If a target’s saving throw is successful, the target is immune to the dryad’s Fey Charm for the next 24 hours. The dryad can have no more than one humanoid and up to three beasts charmed at a time.

gm.title: Description
lines: A masked duergar spy who uses psionics to see through illusions and shrink small enough to slip into guarded places.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Duergar Resilience. The duergar has advantage on saves against spells and against being charmed, paralyzed, or poisoned.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on sight.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Mind-Poison Dagger attacks. Mind Mastery can replace one attack.
Mind-Poison Dagger. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage. While reduced, deal 1 piercing plus 10 (3d6) psychic instead.
Invisibility (Recharge 4–6). Magically turn invisible with worn and carried equipment for up to 1 hour. The effect ends if the duergar attacks, forces a saving throw, or stops concentrating as if on a spell.
Mind Mastery. Choose a creature the duergar can see within 60 ft. A creature immune to being charmed is unaffected. On a failed DC 12 Intelligence save, the target uses its reaction if available. The duergar chooses either a single weapon attack against another creature the duergar can see or movement up to 10 ft. in a direction the duergar chooses.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Reduce (recharges after a short or long rest). Magically become Tiny for 1 minute, shrinking worn and carried gear as well. Weapon damage drops to 1. Strength-based attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws have disadvantage. Gain +5 AC and +5 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks. On each turn while reduced, the duergar can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · 40 ft., burrow 40 ft., fly 80 ft., swim 40 ft.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: The Ruined Providence is a pale ruin dragon with glacial blue wings and jagged horns like icicles.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saves Con +14, Wis +8, Cha +10. Intimidation +10, Perception +8, Persuasion +10. Immune to cold and force damage. Passive Perception 18. Immune to Charmed, Dazed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified and Stunned. Blindsight 120 ft., truesight 60 ft. Common and Draconic.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Frosted Resistance (3/day). On a failed save, Durixaviinox can succeed instead. His speed is then halved and he cannot Disengage until the end of his next turn.
Hoarfrost. His cold damage ignores resistance.
Ice Walk. No ability check is needed to cross or climb ice. Ice and snow cost him no extra movement as difficult terrain.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +14, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing plus 9 (2d8) cold damage. The target loses reactions until the end of its next turn.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +14, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage. Durixaviinox can move the target up to 15 ft. horizontally.
Numbing Breath (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 90-ft. cone make a DC 22 Constitution save. Failure deals 42 (12d6) cold damage and leaves the creature Restrained until the end of its next turn. Success halves the damage and avoids restraint.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Icy Grip. A creature Durixaviinox can see within 60 ft. makes a DC 18 Strength save. Failure deals 22 (4d10) cold damage and leaves it Restrained in ice. Success halves the damage and avoids restraint. A creature can spend an action to free itself or another creature it can reach, ending the restraint.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Withering Frost. When a creature within 5 ft. hits him with an attack, every creature within 5 ft. of him makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 10 (3d6) cold damage.

gm.title: Villain Actions
lines:
Use each once per encounter, in any order after an enemy’s turn, and at most one per round.
Raging Blizzard. Each creature within 120 ft. makes a DC 18 Strength save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage, pushes the creature 60 ft. straight away from Durixaviinox and knocks it Prone. Success halves the damage and avoids the push and knockdown.
Royal Defense. Summon a spectral guard using the Frost Giant Wind Sprinter stat block with its type changed to Undead. It acts immediately after Durixaviinox and follows his verbal commands. He has resistance to all damage while it is within 60 ft. of him. The guard is destroyed if he dies.
Frost Cataclysm. Each enemy in a 120-ft.-radius sphere centered on Durixaviinox makes a DC 18 Constitution save against 45 (10d8) cold damage, then a separate DC 18 Strength save against 45 (10d8) force damage. Each successful save halves its respective damage.

gm.title: Dazed (MCDM)
lines: On its turn, a Dazed creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action. It chooses just one. If it becomes Dazed on its turn, its turn ends. Extra actions such as those from Haste and Action Surge still apply. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration and Greater Restoration can end the condition.

lines:

Slam. Melee weapon attack +8, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

Collision. A thrown creature that hits an object takes an additional 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage per 10 ft. thrown. If thrown at another creature, that creature makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or takes the same distance-based damage and falls Prone.

gm.title: Description
lines: This armored revenant tracks movement through stone and can retreat inside a wall.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Fledgling sample, 5th-level dwarf fighter. Initiative +6. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 28. BAB +5, grapple +11. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +5, Will +3.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Choose slam +11 melee (1d6 + 6 and 1d4 Strength drain to a living target), +1 dwarven waraxe +14 melee (1d10 + 9, ×3) or throwing axe +7 ranged (1d6 + 6).
Terror Gaze (Su). Standard action to target a creature it can see within 30 ft. The target need not see the vampire. DC 12 Will Fear save. Failure by 1–5 leaves the target shaken, 6–10 frightened, and 11 or more panicked. Fear lasts 5d6 rounds. Failure by 16 or more also prompts a Horror save at DC 7, the Fear DC minus 5. A further failed Fear save worsens shaken to frightened or frightened to panicked.
Blood Drain (Ex). Pin a living target in a grapple. Each round the pin holds, drain 1d4 Constitution and gain 5 temporary HP.
Children of the Night (Su, 1/day). Standard action to call 2d8 badgers, 2d6 wolverines, or 2d4 thoqquas. They arrive in 2d6 rounds and serve up to 1 hour.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
DR 10/cold iron and magic, cold and electricity resistance 20, darkvision 60 ft., turn resistance +4, and undead traits. SR 12 cannot be lowered. A dwarven vampire must overcome its own SR to cast spells. Tremorsense pinpoints creatures touching stone within 60 ft.
Stonewalk (Su). At will as a standard action merge into solid stone and travel through it at 20 ft. Remain merged indefinitely. At 1 HP or more, fast healing is 1 aboveground or 5 underground. At 0 HP or less it retreats through stone to its coffin within 2 hours or is destroyed. After 1 hour in the coffin it reaches 1 HP and resumes healing.

gm.title: Spawn
lines: A dwarf drained to Constitution 0 or less must be laid underground in a stone sarcophagus. The creator sprinkles the body with powdered metals. The victim rises 1d4 days later and remains controlled until its creator dies. At 4 HD or fewer it becomes spawn, otherwise a dwarven vampire. Dwarven spawn have DC 14 Fear Gaze, the same Strength Drain, Blood Drain and Stonewalk, and heal 2 HP per round only underground.

gm.title: Repelling and slaying
lines: Mirrors and presented holy symbols repel it. An unbroken line of metal shavings blocks it even through stone. It can enter only structures built at least partly from stone and earth. In sunlight it can take only standard actions and turns to stone the next round unless it escapes. Stone to flesh reverses this. Mineral-spring water burns like holy water and immersion in a natural spring removes one-third of HP per round, destroying it after 3 rounds. Natural stone through the heart kills it while left in place. To make the death permanent, the book requires the heart to soak in oil for three days, then burn to ash in a dwarven forge.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Appraise +3, Bluff +8, Climb +14, Craft (weaponsmithing) +9, Hide +10, Intimidate +2, Listen +12, Move Silently +10, Ride +7, Search +9, Sense Motive +10, Spot +12. Alertness, Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Exotic Weapon Proficiency (dwarven waraxe), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Weapon Focus and Weapon Specialization (dwarven waraxe).

gm.title: Encounter adaptation
lines: Apply the strain to the 3.5 vampire template. Retain unmodified abilities, size, BAB, saves and skill points. The base vampire uses undead d12 Hit Dice and has no Constitution score. Keep an existing swim speed and ignore vulnerability to immersion in running water if the base creature can swim. Use save DC 10 + half HD rounded down + Charisma modifier unless specified. Age rows replace one another. Apply only to a dwarf. Age DR always requires cold iron and magic. The two listed fast healing numbers are aboveground and underground.

gm.title: Age modifiers
lines:
Apply one row to a base creature. The sample already includes its adjustments. Ability scores are listed in Str, Dex, Int, Wis, Cha order.
Fledgling. Abilities 6/2/2/2/4. Speed +0 ft., natural AC +8, turn resistance +4, CR +3. DR 10, fast healing 1/5, SR 12.
Mature. Abilities 8/2/4/2/4. Speed +0 ft., natural AC +8, turn resistance +4, CR +3. DR 15, fast healing 1/5, SR 14.
Old. Abilities 8/4/4/4/6. Speed +10 ft., natural AC +9, turn resistance +5, CR +4. DR 15, fast healing 2/6, SR 16.
Ancient. Abilities 10/4/6/4/6. Speed +10 ft., natural AC +9, turn resistance +6, CR +4. DR 20, fast healing 2/7, SR 18.
Eminent. Abilities 10/6/6/6/8. Speed +20 ft., natural AC +10, turn resistance +7, CR +5. DR 20, fast healing 3/8, SR 20.
Patriarch. Abilities 12/8/8/8/10. Speed +30 ft., natural AC +10, turn resistance +8, CR +6. DR 25, fast healing 3/10, SR 22.

gm.title: Description
lines: A dybbuk is an airborne demon with a jellyfish-like body. It uses intact corpses to move among the living and frighten witnesses.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Incorporeal Movement. The dybbuk can move through creatures and objects as difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Magic Resistance. The dybbuk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, reduce its hit point maximum by 3 (1d6) until it finishes a short or long rest. If the maximum falls to 0, the creature dies.
Possess Corpse (recharge 6). The dybbuk disappears into an intact corpse within 5 ft. that belonged to a Large or smaller Beast or Humanoid. The dybbuk gains 20 temporary hit points. It takes the corpse's size and cannot use Incorporeal Movement while inside, but its other statistics stay the same. The possession ends when it loses those temporary hit points or ends it as a bonus action. It then appears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the corpse.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
The dybbuk casts one spell as an action using Charisma, with spell save DC 12. It needs no material components.
At will. Dimension Door.
3/day. Phantasmal Force.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Control Corpse. While possessing a corpse, the dybbuk makes it move or behave in an unnatural way. Each Beast or Humanoid that sees this makes a DC 12 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened of the dybbuk for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Any creature that succeeds on the save is immune to Control Corpse for 24 hours.

gm.title: Heraldic servant rules
lines:
Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.
A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.
Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.
An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.
The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

gm.title: Description
lines: An eidolon guards a sacred place and can animate a statue prepared to hold its spirit.

gm.title: Languages
lines: The languages it knew in life.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Acid, fire, lightning, thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Incorporeal Movement. The eidolon can move through creatures and objects as difficult terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object other than a Sacred Statue, it takes 5 (1d10) force damage.
Sacred Animation (recharge 5–6). When the eidolon enters a Sacred Statue's space, it can disappear into the statue. The statue becomes a creature under its control, and the eidolon uses the Sacred Statue stat block while inside.
Turn Resistance. The eidolon has advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.
Unusual Nature. The eidolon needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Divine Dread. Each creature within 60 ft. that can see the eidolon makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is frightened of it for 1 minute. At the start of each turn while frightened this way, the creature must take the Dash action and move away by the safest available route. If it has nowhere to go, it is also stunned until it can move again. The creature repeats the save at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success. When it succeeds or the effect ends, it is immune to every eidolon's Divine Dread for 24 hours.

gm.title: Sacred Statue encounter
lines:
The Sacred Statue is an object until an eidolon enters it. The animated statue is a Large construct with the eidolon's alignment, AC 19 (natural armor), 95 HP (10d10 + 40), and speed 25 ft. It has Str 19, Dex 8, Con 19, Int 14, Wis 19, Cha 16, and a +8 Wisdom save. It has darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14, and the eidolon's languages. It resists acid, fire, and lightning, plus bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks. It is immune to cold, necrotic, and poison damage and to the charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
False Appearance. If motionless at the start of combat, the statue has advantage on initiative. A creature that has never seen the statue move or act needs a successful DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to tell it is a creature.
Ghostly Inhabitant. The eidolon leaves the statue if the statue reaches 0 HP, if the eidolon leaves as a bonus action, or if it is turned or forced out, such as by Dispel Evil and Good. It then appears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the statue and uses its own stat block again.
Multiattack. The statue makes two Slam or Rock attacks in any combination.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 43 (6d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 37 (6d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 15) and restrained until that grapple ends. Eku can constrict only one target at a time.
Change Shape. Magically take the form of a humanoid or beast of CR 4 or lower, or return to true form. Eku resumes true form on death. At her choice, gear is absorbed or carried by the new form. She keeps her game statistics and speech except for AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and other actions, which the new form supplies. She gains capabilities of the new form she lacks, apart from class features, legendary actions, and lair actions. She can use her own Bite if the new form has a bite attack.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Innate Charisma spellcasting, DC 14, verbal components only.
At will: Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts.
3/day each: Bless, Create Food and Water, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration, Protection from Poison, Sanctuary, Shield.
1/day each: Dream, Greater Restoration, Scrying.

gm.title: Adventure encounter
lines: Eku begins in her human guise. The printed adventure does not name a separate stat block for that guise. When a group needs direction, she suggests consulting the guardian naga of Orolunga. Near Mbala, she asks the party to help her confront Nanny Pu’pu, who destroyed the community there.

gm.title: Description
lines: The mind flayer colony tends this immense brain in a pool of psionically charged brine. It coordinates the colony by telepathy and feeds on other creatures’ brains.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Large aberration (mind flayer), typically lawful evil

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands Common, Deep Speech, and Undercommon. It cannot speak. Telepathy 5 miles.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Creature Sense. Within 5 miles, the brain knows the distance, direction, and Intelligence score of every creature with Intelligence 4 or higher. This trait reveals no other information. Mind Blank, Nondetection, or similar magic shields the creature from this sense.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the brain fails a saving throw, it can succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. The brain has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Telepathic Hub. Start and maintain telepathic conversations with up to ten creatures at once. The brain can let those creatures hear each other telepathically.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (4d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage. A Huge or smaller creature is also grappled (escape DC 15) and takes 9 (1d8 + 5) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns while grappled this way. The brain can grapple up to four targets at once.
Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6). Choose any creatures within 60 ft. Each makes a DC 18 Intelligence save. On a failure, it takes 32 (5d10 + 5) psychic damage and is stunned for 1 minute. A stunned target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Spellcasting (Psionics). As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 18). No components are required.
At will. Detect Thoughts, Levitate.
3/day. Modify Memory.
1/day each. Dominate Monster, Plane Shift (self only).

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines:
Psychic Link. Link with one incapacitated creature detected by Creature Sense. While linked, the brain perceives everything the target senses. When the target recovers from incapacitation, it notices the mental link. The target can use its action to make a DC 18 Charisma save, breaking the link and taking 10 (3d6) psychic damage on a success. The brain can end the link without an action at any time. It also ends when the two are more than 5 miles apart. The brain can maintain up to ten links at once.
Sense Thoughts. Choose a creature linked by Psychic Link. The brain learns its emotional state and most immediate thoughts, including its worries, loves, or hates.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The brain has 3 legendary actions. Spend the listed cost immediately after another creature’s turn. It regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It can use these actions only when able to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using one.
Break Concentration (1 action). Choose a linked creature within 120 ft. End its concentration on a spell it cast and deal 2 (1d4) psychic damage per level of that spell.
Psychic Pulse (1 action). Choose a linked creature within 120 ft. The target and the brain’s enemies within 30 ft. of the target take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Sever Psychic Link (1 action). End the link with one linked creature within 120 ft. That creature has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn.
Tentacle (2 actions). Make one Tentacle attack.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
While in its lair, the brain can use one option on initiative count 20, losing ties. It must be able to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using an option. It cannot repeat the same option in consecutive rounds.
Force Wall. Cast Wall of Force.
Psionic Anchor. Choose a creature the brain can sense within 120 ft. On a failed DC 18 Charisma save, its speed becomes 0 and it cannot teleport. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Psychic Inspiration. Choose a friendly creature the brain can sense within 120 ft. It gains advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw of its choice before the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Use one or more of these effects around the lair. They end as soon as the brain dies.
Paranoia. Creatures within 5 miles feel they are being followed.
Psychic Whispers. A linked creature hears faint, unintelligible fragments of the brain’s thoughts and those of its other linked creatures.
Telepathic Eavesdropping. The brain can overhear telepathic conversations within 5 miles. When contact begins, its initiator makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a success, the initiator notices the eavesdropping without learning who is listening.

gm.title: Description
lines: An elder brain lives in a brine pool at the heart of a mind flayer colony. It coordinates the colony and reaches other minds across great distances.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands Common, Deep Speech, and Undercommon. It communicates through telepathy with a range of 5 miles and cannot speak aloud.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Creature Sense. Detect creatures within 5 miles whose Intelligence is at least 4. The elder brain knows their direction, distance, and Intelligence score. Mind Blank, Nondetection, and similar magic defeat this sense.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The elder brain can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. The elder brain has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Telepathic Hub. The elder brain can hold up to ten simultaneous telepathic conversations. It may let the connected creatures hear one another telepathically.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (4d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage. A creature of Huge size or smaller is grappled (escape DC 15) and takes 9 (1d8 + 5) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns until the grapple ends. The elder brain can grapple up to four targets.
Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6). Release magical psychic energy and choose creatures within 60 ft. Each must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence save or take 32 (5d10 + 5) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute. A stunned target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Psychic Link. Link with one incapacitated creature detected by Creature Sense. The elder brain perceives what the target senses until the link ends. The target notices the link once it is no longer incapacitated. It can use an action on its turn to make a DC 18 Charisma save, breaking the link and taking 10 (3d6) psychic damage on a success. The brain can end the link without an action. Separation of more than 5 miles ends the link with no consequences for the target. The elder brain can maintain up to ten psychic links.
Sense Thoughts. Read a linked creature's reasoning, emotions, and foremost thoughts. The elder brain can plant a false belief or feeling by making a Charisma (Deception) check with advantage, contested by the target's Wisdom (Insight). If the elder brain wins, the target believes the deception for 1 hour or until presented with evidence of the lie.

gm.title: Innate spellcasting (psionics)
lines:
Use Intelligence (spell save DC 18). These spells require no components.
At will. Detect Thoughts, Levitate.
1/day each. Dominate Monster, Plane Shift (self only).

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The elder brain has 3 legendary actions. It can spend one to use one option at the end of another creature's turn. Spent uses return at the start of its turn. It cannot use legendary actions while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using one.
Tentacle (1 action). Make one Tentacle attack.
Break Concentration (1 action). Choose a linked creature within 120 ft. End its concentration on a spell it cast. It takes 1d4 psychic damage per level of the spell.
Psychic Pulse (1 action). Choose a linked creature within 120 ft. Each enemy of the elder brain within 10 ft. of that target takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Sever Psychic Link (1 action). End a psychic link with a creature within 120 ft. The creature has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
While fighting in its lair, the elder brain can use one option at initiative count 20, losing ties. It cannot use the same option in consecutive rounds. It must be able to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using a lair action.
Force Wall. Cast Wall of Force.
Psychic Inspiration. Pick a friendly creature the elder brain can sense within 120 ft. It gains advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes by the end of its next turn. The benefit expires if unused.
Psionic Anchor. Pick a creature the elder brain can sense within 120 ft. On a failed DC 18 Charisma save, the target is unable to leave its current space. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more effects around the lair. All end immediately when the elder brain dies.
Paranoia. Creatures within 5 miles feel that someone is following them.
Telepathic Eavesdropping. The elder brain can overhear any telepathic conversation within 5 miles. When contact first begins, the creature that initiated it makes a DC 18 Wisdom (Insight) check. A success reveals an eavesdropper without identifying it. The elder brain can join only if it has a psychic link with the initiator.
Psychic Whispers. Creatures linked to the elder brain hear faint, incomprehensible traces of its thoughts and the thoughts of others in the link.

gm.title: Description
lines: An elder brain takes control of a captive dragon and uses the host’s mobility to lead an illithid army. Its brine breath can turn victims into mind flayers.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (4/day). The dragon can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Siege Monster. The dragon deals double damage to objects and structures.
Unusual Nature. The dragon needs neither air nor sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite, two Claw attacks, and one Tentacle attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (1d6 + 8) slashing damage.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. A hit deals 12 (1d8 + 8) psychic damage. A Huge or smaller target is also grappled (escape DC 18). The dragon can grapple up to four creatures with its tentacles at once.
Tadpole Brine Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a line 120 ft. long and 15 ft. wide makes a DC 22 Constitution save. Failure deals 55 (10d10) psychic damage. Success halves the damage. Either result infests the creature with illithid tadpoles unless it is a Construct or an Undead.
Infestation. An infested creature starts each of its turns by taking 16 (3d10) psychic damage. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, clearing the infestation after three successes. Magic that ends a curse or restores at least 40 hit points to the creature kills the tadpoles and ends the infestation immediately.
Ceremorphosis. If an infested Humanoid drops to 0 hit points, it is stable and remains unconscious for 6d12 hours. It then becomes a Mind Flayer with full hit points. Casting Wish on it while unconscious ends the infestation and prevents the transformation.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The dragon has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It can use one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Tentacle (1 action). Make one Tentacle attack.
Shatter Concentration (2 actions). Choose a creature the dragon has grappled. Its concentration on a spell or ability ends, and it takes 19 (3d12) psychic damage.

gm.title: Description
lines: An oblex steals memories and uses them to imitate people. Its doubles can pass for their originals, apart from a faint sulfur smell.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amorphous. The oblex can move through a gap as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Aversion to Fire. After taking fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.
Unusual Nature. The oblex does not need sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Pseudopod attacks and use Eat Memories.
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (4d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage.
Eat Memories. Choose one visible creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. Constructs, Oozes, Plants, and Undead succeed automatically. On a failure, the target takes 44 (8d10) psychic damage and is memory drained. A short or long rest, Greater Restoration, or Heal ends the drain. While drained, the target subtracts a d4 roll from each ability check and attack roll. Each further drain increases the die by one size through d6, d8, d10, d12, then d20. When the die reaches d20, the target falls unconscious for 1 hour, then the effect ends. The oblex learns all the drained creature’s languages and gains all its skill proficiencies.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Spellcasting (Psionics). As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 18). No components are required.
At will. Charm Person (cast at 5th level), Detect Thoughts.
3/day each. Dimension Door, Dominate Person, Hypnotic Pattern, Telekinesis.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Sulfurous Impersonation. Form a double of a Medium or smaller creature whose memories the oblex stole. The double looks, sounds, and feels like the original but smells faintly of sulfur. The oblex can imitate 2d6 + 1 different creatures. Each double is part of the oblex, which occupies both its own space and the double’s space. A strand up to 120 ft. long connects each double to the body. The strand is immune to damage. The strand severs if no opening at least 1 inch wide connects the double and the body. The double then disappears.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 199.

gm.title: References
lines: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 199 · https://5e.tools/bestiary.html#elder%20oblex_mpmm

gm.title: Description
lines: An elder oblex feeds on memories and sends lifelike copies of its victims to lure more prey or infiltrate a settlement.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion and prone.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amorphous. It can pass through gaps at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.
Aversion to Fire. After taking fire damage, the oblex has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks through the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Innate Spellcasting
lines:
Intelligence sets the save DC at 18. The oblex needs no material components.
At will. Charm Person (cast at 5th level), Detect Thoughts, Hold Person.
3/day each. Confusion, Dimension Door, Dominate Person, Fear, Hallucinatory Terrain, Hold Monster, Hypnotic Pattern, Telekinesis.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Sulfurous Impersonation. Form a copy of one Medium or smaller creature whose memories the oblex stole. The copy looks, feels and sounds like the original but smells faintly of sulfur. The oblex can impersonate 2d6 + 1 different creatures. A strand of slime up to 120 ft. long joins each copy to the main body. The oblex occupies its own space and each copy’s space at the same time. The strand is immune to damage. If the route between the body and copy has no opening at least 1 inch wide, the strand breaks and the copy vanishes.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Pseudopod attacks and use Eat Memories.
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (4d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
Eat Memories. Choose a visible creature within 5 ft. Constructs, oozes, plants and undead automatically succeed on the DC 18 Wisdom save. On a failed save the target takes 44 (8d10) psychic damage and becomes memory drained until it finishes a short or long rest or receives Greater Restoration or Heal. It subtracts a d4 from its ability checks and attack rolls. Each further drain raises the penalty die in order from d4 to d6, d8, d10, d12 and d20. At d20 the target becomes unconscious for 1 hour, after which the effect ends. Whenever the oblex drains a target’s memories, it learns the target’s languages and gains its proficiencies except saving throw proficiencies.

gm.title: Description
lines: An immense serpent made of wind, cloud, and lightning. A storm travels with it, flooding the ground beneath its flight.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Air Form. The tempest can enter and stop in a hostile creature’s space. It can move through a gap as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach provokes no opportunity attack.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the tempest fails a saving throw, it can succeed instead.
Living Storm. A storm 1d6 + 4 miles across stays centered on the tempest. Heavy rain or snow lightly obscures the area. Heavy rain puts out open flames and imposes disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing. Strong winds throughout the storm impose disadvantage on ranged attack rolls, put out open flames, and disperse fog.
Siege Monster. The tempest deals double damage to objects and structures.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Thunderous Slam attacks.
Thunderous Slam. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (4d6 + 9) thunder damage.
Lightning Storm (Recharge 6). Each creature within 120 ft. makes a DC 21 Dexterity save, taking 27 (6d8) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more is also stunned until the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The tempest has 3 legendary actions. Spend the listed cost immediately after another creature’s turn. It regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It can use these actions only when able to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using one.
Move (1 action). Move up to its speed.
Lightning Strike (2 actions). Strike a point on the ground anywhere under the storm. Each creature within 5 ft. of that point makes a DC 21 Dexterity save, taking 16 (3d10) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
Screaming Gale (3 actions). Blast a 300-ft. line, 20 ft. wide. Objects in the line take 22 (4d10) thunder damage. Each creature in the line makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d10) thunder damage and is thrown up to 60 ft. away from the line. Hitting an immovable object or another creature deals the thrown creature 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 ft. traveled before impact. A creature struck by the thrown creature makes a DC 19 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes the same impact damage and falls prone.

gm.title: Description
lines: A titan of the Elemental Chaos. It moves through earth, air, and water and can set off a different disaster each time it attacks with Cataclysmic Event.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Thunder.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned, Unconscious.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Earth Glide. The cataclysm can burrow through unworked, nonmagical earth and stone without disturbing the material.
Legendary Resistance (4/day). On a failed saving throw, the cataclysm can spend one use to succeed.
Siege Monster. The cataclysm deals double damage to objects and structures.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Elemental Burst attacks.
Elemental Burst. Melee or ranged attack, +15 to hit, reach 30 ft. or range 150 ft. A hit deals 25 (5d6 + 8) damage. The cataclysm chooses Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder for that hit.
Control Weather. Cast Control Weather using Constitution and no spell components.
Cataclysmic Event (recharge 4–6). Roll 1d4 for one effect.
1. Clinging Flames. Center a 60-ft.-radius sphere on a visible point within 150 ft. Each creature inside makes a DC 23 Dexterity save. Failure deals 45 (13d6) Fire damage. Success halves the damage. The creature starts Burning either way.
2. Freezing Waves. Each creature in a 90-ft. cone makes a DC 23 Strength save. Failure deals 22 (5d8) Bludgeoning plus 22 (5d8) Cold damage and knocks it Prone. Success halves the damage and avoids the fall. Either way, the creature's Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.
3. Raging Storm. Center a 60-ft.-radius sphere of storm cloud on a visible point within 150 ft. It lasts for 1 minute or until the cataclysm uses Cataclysmic Event again. Creatures wholly inside are Blinded and Deafened and cannot cast spells with Verbal components. A creature that first enters the cloud on a turn or starts its turn there makes a DC 23 Dexterity save. Failure deals 18 (4d8) Lightning plus 18 (4d8) Thunder damage. Success halves the damage.
4. Swallowing Earth. Choose a point on the ground within 150 ft. Each creature in a 90-ft. cube originating there makes a DC 23 Strength save. Failure deals 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning plus 18 (4d8) Acid damage, knocks it Prone, and buries it under rubble. Success halves the damage and avoids the fall and burial. A buried creature is Restrained and suffocating and has Total Cover. The buried creature or another creature within 5 ft. of it can take an action to free it with a successful DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
3 uses. Spend one immediately after another creature's turn to select one option. The cataclysm recovers spent uses at the start of its turn and cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Eruption. Make one Elemental Burst attack.
Rumbling Movement. Move up to the cataclysm's Speed, Fly Speed, or Swim Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature it comes within 5 ft. of during the move makes one DC 23 Constitution save or falls Prone. The cataclysm cannot use this option again until the start of its next turn.

gm.title: Description
lines: An elemental lich fights up close to channel Ravenloft’s fire, mist, grave earth and blood. Its phylactery lies hidden beneath a mist-shrouded grave.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Medium undead (augmented humanoid), 10th-level human wizard example

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Touch +5 melee (see powers below), dagger +5 melee for 1d4/19–20, or dart +3 ranged for 1d4/×2. The touch and other natural weapons count as magical.
Conjure Dread Elemental (Su). Each day it may call one 8 HD blood, grave, mist and pyre elemental. Each serves willingly.
Fear Aura (Su). A creature under 5 HD that looks at it within 60 ft. must make a DC 18 Will save against fear. Success gives immunity to this aura for 24 hours. Caster level equals the lich's level.
Touch of Blood (Su). A hit deals 1d8 + 5 HP damage. DC 18 Fortitude or permanent paralysis and 1d4 damage each round. Remove paralysis or curse removal ends paralysis. DC 20 Spot or DC 15 Heal reveals the paralyzed victim is alive.
Touch of the Grave (Su). DC 18 Fortitude. Success means 1d8 + 5 HP damage. Failure means death unless heal is cast on the victim within one round.
Touch of the Pyre (Su). Hit for 1d10 damage, then clothing and armor save or ignite. The magic fire deals 1d10 each round until dispelled or the victim is burned to ash, typically within 1d4 rounds.
Touch of Mist (Su). No HP damage. DC 18 Will or the victim becomes chaotic evil and serves the lich, which can contact it telepathically up to 10 miles away. Remove curse cast by someone of the victim’s former alignment frees it and restores that alignment.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Sample DR 15/bludgeoning and magic. Immune to elemental attacks, electricity, involuntary polymorph, and mind-affecting effects. Undead traits and +3 turn resistance. It cannot control undead.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +6. AC +2 Dex, +5 natural, +3 bracers, +2 protection ring. Touch 17, flat-footed 10 as printed. BAB/grapple +5/+5, space/reach 5 ft./5 ft., Fort +3, Ref +5, Will +11.

gm.title: Spells prepared
lines: DC 15 + spell level. 0: detect magic, flare, ray of frost, read magic. 1st: burning hands, chill touch, comprehend languages, expeditious retreat, magic missile, true strike. 2nd: continual flame, flaming sphere, fog cloud, gust of wind, whispering wind. 3rd: dispel magic, explosive runes, fireball, slow. 4th: fire trap, remove curse, wall of fire, wall of ice. 5th: cone of cold, passwall.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Concentration +15, Decipher Script +10, Hide +18, Knowledge (arcana) +15, Knowledge (engineering) +10, Listen +18, Move Silently +26, Spellcraft +15, Spot +12. Combat Casting, Craft Wondrous Item, Improved Initiative, Scribe Scroll, Still Spell, Toughness.

gm.title: Phylactery encounter
lines: The lich buries its phylactery in a grave near the lair, where a rite calls mist over the site. Approaching creatures make a DC 18 Will save or wander away in confusion. Digging above it alerts the lich, which usually arrives in 1d10 rounds.

gm.title: Applying the encounter template
lines: Use a humanoid able to create the phylactery. Type becomes undead; keep size, BAB, saves and skill points. HD becomes d12, natural AC becomes +5 or remains higher, and Int, Wis and Cha increase by 2. Add one touch per round and the listed powers. Add +8 racial on Hide, Listen, Move Silently, Search, Sense Motive and Spot. CR increases by 2; save DC is 10 + half HD + Cha modifier. The sample carries +3 bracers, potions of invisibility and gaseous form, and a brooch of shielding.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Roll 10d12 + 3 because the sample does not print a fixed HP total. Keep sample touch and flat-footed AC despite the printed breakdown. The sample’s DR includes magic, but the template lists only bludgeoning. Pyre does not specify the item save category.

gm.title: Description

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Fledgling sample, 5th-level elf ranger. Initiative +12. Touch AC 18, flat-footed AC 15. BAB +5, grapple +9. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +5, Ref +12, Will +5.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Choose slam +9 melee (1d6 + 4 and 1d4 Charisma drain to a living creature), +1 longsword +10 melee (1d8 + 4, 18–20), or +1 mighty composite longbow +14 ranged (1d8 + 4, ×3). A target below Charisma 3 gains the book’s lost-one madness effect. At Charisma 0 or less the victim dies within 2d6 hours.
Wretched Gaze (Su). Anyone within 30 ft. who sees its face makes a DC 11 Will Horror save or freezes. The victim is flat-footed and unable to act until 1d4 rounds after losing sight of its face.
Black Thumb (Su). A plant touched by its bare skin makes a DC 11 Fortitude save or takes 1d4 HP damage per minute until it dies. This cannot be suppressed. Destroying the vampire ends the effect.
Spell-like abilities. At caster level 12, 3/day each entangle, snare, spike growth and warp wood. 1/day each antilife shell, giant vermin and wall of thorns. Save DC 9 + spell level.
Children of the Night (Su, 1/day). Call 5d10 hawks, 3d10 eagles, 3d6 wolves, or 6d10 HD of Tiny or Diminutive mammals. They arrive in 2d6 rounds and serve up to 1 hour.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DR 10/cold iron and magic, cold and electricity resistance 20, turn resistance +2, fast healing 4, undead traits, favored enemy (goblinoids +2, elves +1), Track. Plantwalk uses tree stride at will as a standard action and exposes both trees to Black Thumb. Alternate Form uses an eagle or giant eagle. As a standard action assume the listed animal form. Lose the slam and domination, gain the animal’s natural weapons and extraordinary attacks, and retain this form until the next sunrise or another change.

gm.title: Spawn
lines: An elf or half-elf who dies from the madness caused by the drain rises as spawn 1d4 days after burial. A victim killed by draining Charisma to 0 or less rises as spawn at 4 HD or fewer and as an elven vampire at 5 HD or more. The creator controls them until it dies. Elven spawn retain 1d4 Charisma drain, Plantwalk, 2 HP fast healing, DC 14 Horror gaze, and DC 14 Black Thumb limited to 10 rounds.

gm.title: Repelling and slaying
lines: An unbroken line of fragrant petals plucked within 1 day stops it. Music forces a Will save matching the Perform check or it stops to listen, with another save each minute. An attack ends the effect. Underground it takes 1d4 damage per round and loses fast healing and supernatural and spell-like powers. Between sunset and sunrise it must be in its coffin or can take only standard actions before being destroyed on the next round. Running water has no power over it. Fresh sap burns like holy water. A charcoal stake kills it while left through its heart. For permanent destruction, the book has its severed head burned with flowers and flowering shrubs for at least 24 hours. At 0 HP it retreats via Plantwalk and is destroyed if caught outside a tree for more than 2 consecutive rounds before reaching its coffin. After 1 hour in the coffin it reaches 1 HP and resumes healing.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Bluff +10, Hide +20, Handle Animal +7, Knowledge (nature) +9, Listen +15, Move Silently +20, Search +11, Sense Motive +11, Spot +15, Survival +11. Alertness, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot.

gm.title: Encounter adaptation
lines: Apply the strain to the 3.5 vampire template. Retain unmodified abilities, size, BAB, saves and skill points. The base vampire uses undead d12 Hit Dice and has no Constitution score. Keep an existing swim speed and ignore vulnerability to immersion in running water if the base creature can swim. Use save DC 10 + half HD rounded down + Charisma modifier unless specified. Age rows replace one another. Apply only to an elf. Age DR requires cold iron and magic. The Outcast Rating (OR) adjustment applies when dealing with non-elven vampires.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Gem Awakening (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). When the greatwyrm would drop to 0 hit points, it instead resets to 400 hit points, recharges Breath Weapon and recovers all spent Legendary Resistance uses. It can use Mass Telekinesis for the next hour. Defeating it after Gem Awakening grants an extra 90,000 XP, for 180,000 XP total.
Legendary Resistance (4/day). The greatwyrm can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Unusual Nature. The greatwyrm needs no food or drink.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) force damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (2d8 + 9) slashing damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 19) and restrained while grappled. The greatwyrm can hold only one creature with its Claw.
Breath Weapon (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 300-ft. cone makes a DC 25 Dexterity save. A failure deals 71 (11d12) force damage and knocks the creature prone. Success halves the damage and prevents the knockdown. On either result its speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.
Mass Telekinesis (Gem Awakening Only, Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). Choose any number of visible creatures or objects within 120 ft., each weighing up to 4,000 lb. Worn or carried objects are ineligible. Each chosen creature must pass a DC 26 Strength save or be restrained by the grip. It can repeat this save at the end of each of its turns to escape. At the end of each of the greatwyrm’s turns, it can move each creature or object still in the grip up to 60 ft. in any direction, within 120 ft. of itself. It can also deal 45 (7d12) force damage to each creature it chooses that remains restrained by the grip.
Spellcasting (Psionics). As an action, cast a listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 26, +18 to hit with spell attacks) and no components. Dispel Magic, Forcecage, Plane Shift, Reverse Gravity, and Time Stop are each usable once per day.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines:
Change Shape. Magically take the shape of a Small or Medium creature. The greatwyrm retains its game statistics apart from size. The change ends at 0 hit points or when the greatwyrm spends a bonus action to end it.
Psychic Step. Magically teleport to a visible unoccupied space within 60 ft.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The greatwyrm has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn.
Claw (1 action). Make one Claw attack.
Psionics (2 actions). Use Psychic Step or Spellcasting.
Psychic Beam (3 actions). Each creature in a line 90 ft. long and 10 ft. wide makes a DC 26 Intelligence save. Failure deals 27 (5d10) psychic damage. Success halves the damage.

lines: A titan descended from a deity of the Upper Planes. It may champion its patron's cause or set out to earn an honor of its own.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (4/day). When the empyrean fails a saving throw, it can spend one use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. The empyrean has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Sacred Weapon and Divine Ray.
Sacred Weapon. Melee attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 31 (6d6 + 10) Force damage, and the target is Stunned until the start of the empyrean's next turn. The target can choose to take 21 extra Force damage in place of the Stunned condition. The extra damage bypasses Resistance and Immunity.
Divine Ray. Ranged attack, +15 to hit, range 600 ft. A hit deals 35 (6d8 + 8) damage. The empyrean chooses Necrotic or Radiant.
Spellcasting. Charisma is the spellcasting ability (save DC 23). Cast the following spells without Material components. At will, Calm Emotions, Greater Restoration, Pass without Trace, and Water Breathing. Once per day each, Commune, Dispel Evil and Good, and Plane Shift.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
3 uses, regained at the start of the empyrean's turn. Spend one use at the end of another creature's turn to take one option. The creature cannot take legendary actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Bolster. The empyrean gains 10 Temporary Hit Points. It and each ally within 30 ft. gain Advantage on D20 Tests until the end of the empyrean's next turn. The empyrean cannot use Bolster again until the start of its next turn.
Shockwave of Glory. Every creature in a 30-foot Emanation from the empyrean makes a DC 23 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 27 (6d8) Force damage and falls Prone. On a success, it takes half the damage. The empyrean cannot use Shockwave of Glory again until the start of its next turn.
Smite. Make one Divine Ray attack.

lines: fire, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks, psychic

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Saving Throws Int +5, Wis +9, Cha +9 Damage Immunities fire, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing (from nonmagical attacks), psychic Condition Immunities charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned Senses blindsight 120 ft., passive Perception 10

gm.title: Traits
lines: Legendary Resistance (3/Day). If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. Magic Resistance. The tarrasque has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. Reflective Carapace. Any time the tarrasque is targeted by a magic missile spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll a d6. On a 1 to 5, the tarrasque is unaffected. On a 6, the tarrasque is unaffected, and the effect is reflected back at the caster as though it originated from the tarrasque, turning the caster into the target. Siege Monster. The tarrasque deals double damage to objects and structures.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. The tarrasque can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes five attacks: one with its bite, two with its claws, one with its horns, and one with its tail. It can use its Swallow instead of its bite. Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 20). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the tarrasque can’t bite another target. Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) slashing damage. Horns. Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) piercing damage. Tail. Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. Frightful Presence. Each creature of the tarrasque’s choice within 120 feet of it and aware of it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the tarrasque is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the tarrasque’s Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours. Swallow. The tarrasque makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target takes the bite’s damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the tarrasque, and it takes 56 (16d6) acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque’s turns. If the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque. If the tarrasque dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 30 feet of movement, exiting prone.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines: The tarrasque can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn. The tarrasque regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn. Attack. The tarrasque makes one claw attack or tail attack. Move. The tarrasque moves up to half its speed. Chomp (Costs 2 Actions). The tarrasque makes one bite attack or uses its Swallow.

gm.title: Description
lines: The youngest Hourglass Coven hag rules Yon from her mountaintop theater. She shows visitors terrible futures in exchange for a piece of their free will and believes she will die during a solar eclipse.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Boon of Immortality. Endelyn cannot age through any effect or die of old age.
Eclipsed Doom. Endelyn dies at 0 hit points only during a solar eclipse or within 60 ft. of a symbolic solar eclipse. Otherwise, at 0 hit points she vanishes in inky smoke with all worn and carried items, then returns 24 hours later at the same spot or the nearest open space.
Uncanny Awareness. Endelyn cannot be surprised.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Puppeteer’s Lash attacks.
Puppeteer’s Lash. Melee or ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. On a hit, deal 17 (4d6 + 3) psychic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, Endelyn telekinetically moves it up to 10 ft. in any horizontal direction.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell with Charisma (save DC 14) and no material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Mage Hand.
2/day each. Augury, Polymorph.
1/day. Plane Shift (self only).

gm.title: Hourglass Coven
lines: While Endelyn, Bavlorna Blightstraw, and Skabatha Nightshade are all within 30 ft. of one another, any of them can spend an action to cast Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Finger of Death, Glibness, Locate Creature, or Mass Suggestion without material components (save DC 14). Each spell has one shared use until the next dawn.

gm.title: Motherhorn
lines: Glister of the Selenelion Twin act can stage a symbolic eclipse by standing behind the theater’s wooden moon prop while wearing her sun mask. The twins can also embody the sun and moon together. When threatened, Endelyn can flee on her Ornithopter of Flying. If the coven has regrouped and risks capture or death, the hags flee for the Palace of Heart’s Desire.

gm.title: Orrery of Tragedies (M14)
lines:
Creatures on the balcony and on the floor below have three-quarters cover against attacks from the other level. Touching the central lightning rod, entering the device’s space for the first time on a turn, or starting a turn there triggers a DC 15 Dexterity save. Take 44 (8d10) lightning damage on a failed save or half on a success. Make the save with disadvantage in metal armor.
At least eight components must be destroyed to wreck the device. Each is a Large object with AC 19, 27 HP, and immunity to lightning, poison, and psychic damage. The central rod has eight segments, each AC 17 and 25 HP with the same immunities. Destroying a segment drops the ones above it. If at least three are lost, the orrery shuts down after 1 minute until the rod is rebuilt. Antimagic Field suppresses the device while in contact. Dispel Magic (DC 19) shuts it down for 1 minute, but it stays charged.
